Andaman & Nicobar Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be made through a Physical Endurance Test consisting of three different levels. Candidates participating in Level-I, II & III Tests shall furnish an undertaking that they are physically fit & mentally sound to undertake the test. Candidates failing any test shall not be given a second chance under any circumstances.

Level-I Test (Running Test): Qualifying for short-listing

  • Male: Must complete 10 km
  • Female: Must complete 8 km
  • 15 times the number of vacancies shall be shortlisted.

Level-II Test (Long Jump): Qualifying in nature (to be cleared within three attempts)

Category Male Female
General & OBC 12 feet 9 feet
ST 9 feet 7 feet

Level-III Test (Weight Carrying Test): For final selection/merit

  • Male: Carry 30 kg weight for 500 meters
  • Female: Carry 20 kg weight for 500 meters

Merit list shall be prepared for exact number of vacancies + wait list (maximum 10% of vacancies notified) based on Level-III performance. ST/OBC/EWS candidates selected on merit without relaxed standards will be accommodated against unreserved vacancies. Reserved vacancies will be filled from eligible ST/OBC/EWS domiciled in A&N Islands.

Final selection is subject to verification of certificates, character & antecedents, and medical examination. Selected candidates will undergo 2 years probation.

How to Apply

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Andaman Forest Department Mazdoor Recruitment 2026 through the official recruitment portal.

A. Online Application Process

  1. The candidate should register their full particulars of the Application through online only at https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in
  2. The online application will be accepted from 16/03/2026 (from 11:00 Hrs) to 29/04/2026 (up to 23:59 Hrs).
  3. Candidates should provide all the mandatory details in the online portal. Failing which the application will not be accepted by the website.
  4. Photograph to be uploaded should be:
    • 8-bit JPEG format
    • Size between 10 Kb to 50 Kb
    • Resolution 100 × 200 pixels
  5. It is advised to enable JavaScript in the browser (Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome, etc.) for successful upload.
  6. The website will allow the applicant to take printout forthwith of the submitted application. Those who fail to take printout immediately can download the filled-in form later also.
  7. All candidates who have registered their name in the local Employment Exchange as unemployed must enter their registration number in the appropriate box while filling the online application.

B. Documents to be submitted at the time of Document Verification (after Physical Test)

Candidates shortlisted after the Physical Test must bring:

  • One copy of recent passport-size photograph
  • Self-attested copies of:
    • Essential Qualification Certificate (10th Pass or ITI in relevant trade)
    • 10th Pass Certificate (showing Date of Birth)
    • OBC/ST/EWS/MSP Certificate (if applicable)
    • Meritorious Sports Person Certificate (if applicable)
    • Employment Registration Certificate/Card (if registered)
    • Printed copy of the Online Application Form

Important Notes from PDF

  • Applications received without the prescribed fee (₹100 for General/OBC/EWS/MSP) shall be summarily rejected.
  • Women candidates and ST candidates are exempted from fee payment.

General Instructions

  • Candidates must read the full notification carefully before applying.
  • Candidature is purely provisional at all stages. Detailed scrutiny of eligibility will be done later.
  • Age is reckoned as on the closing date i.e. 29-04-2026.
  • Candidates must have good physique and meet all physical standards.
  • For Mill Division technical posts (Raftman, Grader, Asst. Sawyer, etc.), a separate Grade-specific Trade Test will be conducted later by DCF, Mill Division, Chatham.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the Physical Test.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • The decision of the Department of Environment & Forests, A&N Administration in all matters shall be final and binding.
  • Any dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts/Tribunals in A&N Islands only.
  • All updates (Admit Card, Physical Test schedule, Result) will be available only on https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in.
  • Candidates found using mobile phones or electronic gadgets in the test centre will be disqualified.
  • In case of any difficulty, contact Helpline: 03192-255228 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days).

Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Selection Process 2026

The Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 selection process consists of multiple stages such as shortlisting, online assessment, psychometric evaluation, and personal interview. These stages are designed to select the most suitable candidates for wealth management roles.

Shortlisting & Application Scrutiny:

In the initial stage, applications will be scrutinised based on eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, relevant work experience, domain expertise, and other parameters decided by the bank. Only candidates shortlisted as per the bank’s internal norms will be called for further stages. Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting for the Bank of Baroda WMS selection process.

Online Test & Psychometric Assessment:

The selection process may include an online test followed by a psychometric assessment or other suitable evaluations. These tests are conducted to assess the candidate’s personality, communication skills, problem-solving ability, efficiency, innovation, and willingness to work anywhere in India. The bank reserves the right to conduct or waive the online test and/or psychometric test depending on recruitment requirements.

Personal Interview (PI):

Candidates shortlisted from earlier stages will be invited for a Personal Interview. During the interview, candidates will be evaluated on domain knowledge, relationship management skills, leadership qualities (especially for higher roles), communication skills, and overall suitability for wealth management positions. Candidates must secure a minimum of 60% marks (55% for reserved categories) or as decided by the bank.

Final Merit & Provisional Selection:

The final merit list will be prepared based on the candidate’s performance in the online test (if conducted), psychometric test, and personal interview, as per the weightage decided by the bank. Only those candidates who qualify in all stages and rank high in the merit list, subject to vacancy and category norms, will be provisionally selected. The decision of the bank in all matters related to selection will be final and binding.

How to Apply for Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026

Interested and eligible candidates must apply online through the official website of Bank of Baroda within the specified dates. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Step 1 – Visit Official Website:

Visit the official website and navigate to the “Careers → Current Opportunities” section. Then click on the link for Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/08).

Step 2 – Read Detailed Notification:

Download and carefully read the official notification PDF to understand vacancy details, eligibility criteria, age limit, experience requirements, selection process, application fee, and instructions.

Step 3 – Online Registration:

Click on “Apply Online” and complete the registration by entering basic details such as name, mobile number, and email ID. Generate your registration ID and password. Ensure your contact details remain active throughout the recruitment process.

Step 4 – Fill Online Application Form:

Log in using your credentials and fill out the application form with accurate personal, educational, and professional details. Verify all information carefully before final submission, as no corrections will be allowed afterward.

Step 5 – Upload Photograph, Signature & Documents:

Upload a recent passport-size photograph, signature, and required documents such as educational certificates, experience letters, and category certificates in the prescribed format and size.

Step 6 – Pay Application Fee Online:

Pay the application fee through available online modes such as debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI. After successful payment, download the e-receipt and application form.

Step 7 – Final Submission & Print:

Submit the application form and take a printout of the final submitted form and fee receipt for future reference, especially for interview and document verification.

General Instructions for Bank of Baroda WMS Recruitment 2026

Applicants for Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 must adhere to all general instructions issued by the bank to ensure smooth processing of their applications and avoid disqualification at any stage.

Single Valid Application: Candidates should submit only one valid online application for a post; in case of multiple applications, only the latest complete application will be considered and all fees paid for previous registrations will stand forfeited. Multiple appearances for a single post in the selection process will lead to cancellation of candidature.

Accuracy of Information: All information furnished in the Bank of Baroda WMS online application form 2026 must be true, complete and correct. If any discrepancy, false information, or suppression of material facts is found at any stage (before or after appointment), the candidate’s candidature will be cancelled and, if already engaged, services may be terminated without notice.

Document Verification & Category Proof: Candidates must produce original documents (age proof, educational certificates, experience proofs, category certificates for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD, NOC from employer, etc.) along with self‑attested photocopies at the time of interview or whenever called by the bank. No change of category will be permitted after online registration, and results will be processed based on the category declared in the application.

Email & Communication: All communication regarding Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 including call letters, schedule of tests/interviews, and any updates will be sent to the registered email ID and/or published on the Bank of Baroda website. The bank will not be responsible for non‑receipt of email due to incorrect email ID, spam filtering or technical issues.

Eligibility & Disqualification: Candidates are responsible for ensuring that they meet the eligibility criteria regarding nationality, age, qualification, experience and credit history. Applications from candidates with unsatisfactory credit reports, pending or adverse disciplinary/criminal records, or those not meeting the criteria at any stage are liable to be rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

Jurisdiction & Bank’s Decision: Any dispute related to BOB WMS Recruitment 2026 will fall under the jurisdiction of courts/tribunals in Mumbai only. The decisions of Bank of Baroda regarding shortlisting, selection, eligibility, conduct of online test/PI and all other aspects of the recruitment process will be final, binding and not open to challenge by candidates.

Selection Process

The selection will be made through a Competitive Examination in three stages:

(A) Stage – I: Preliminary (Screening) Examination [Objective Type (MCQ)]

  • Paper-I:
    • Part-1: General Studies – 100 Marks
    • Part-2: Engineering Aptitude – 100 Marks
    • Duration: 2 Hours
  • Paper-II: Civil Engineering – 300 Marks
    • Duration: 3 HoursTotal: 500 Marks

Note:

  • This is only a screening test.
  • Marks obtained in Preliminary will NOT be counted for final merit.
  • Approximately 15 times the number of vacancies will be called for the Main Examination.

(B) Stage – II: Main Written Examination [Descriptive (Conventional) Type]

  • Paper-I: Gujarati Language – 100 Marks (2 Hours)
  • Paper-II: English Language – 100 Marks (2 Hours)
  • Paper-III: Civil Engineering – I – 200 Marks (3 Hours)
  • Paper-IV: Civil Engineering – II – 200 Marks (3 Hours)
  • Paper-V: Civil Engineering – III – 200 Marks (3 Hours) Total: 800 Marks

(C) Stage – III: Interview (Personality Test) – 100 Marks

Final Merit: Marks obtained in Main Written Examination (800) + Interview (100) = 900 Marks (The Preliminary marks are not added.)

  • Category once filled cannot be changed later.

  • In case of any dispute, the decision of the Gujarat Public Service Commission shall be final.

GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Ayurvedic Nursing i.e. Ayurved Nursing Course Certificate obtained from Gujarat Ayurvedic Nursing Faculty established by the Government of Gujarat.   • Registration: The candidate shall be required to get registered with the Gujarat Board of Ayurvedic and Unani System of Medicine at the time of application for direct selection, if not already registered.
  • Age Limit: Candidates must be minimum 18 years and maximum 45 years as on 13/04/2026. Age relaxation is available as follows: General category women get 5 years relaxation; Reserved category males get 5 years; Reserved category females get 10 years; General PwD males get 10 years; General PwD females get 15 years; Reserved PwD males get 15 years; Reserved PwD females get 20 years; Ex-Servicemen get relaxation equal to their service period plus 3 additional years — all within the maximum limit of 45 years.

GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Class-3 Recruitment 2026 will initially be appointed on a fixed pay of Rs. 40,800/- per month for the first five years along with other admissible allowances as per Government of Gujarat orders.
  • Pay Scale Details: After satisfactory completion of five years of service, candidates will be eligible for regular appointment in the 7th Pay Commission pay scale of Rs. 29,200/- to Rs. 92,300/- (Level-5). This is subject to the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in SLP No. 14124/2012 and SLP No. 14125/2012.

GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per Gujarat Government norms, the examination fee for GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 500/- for Unreserved (General) category candidates and Rs. 400/- for Reserved category candidates (including all category women, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD and Ex-Servicemen).
  • Fee Payment: Candidates must pay the fee online only through the OJAS portal using Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallets. Fee must be paid by 16 Apr 2026 (11:59 PM). Candidates must download and keep the fee payment receipt. Applications without fee payment will not be accepted. Fee is refundable only to candidates who appear for the examination.

GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The online application process for GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Class-3 Recruitment 2026 will be conducted through the OJAS portal. Eligible candidates must visit https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in, open the link for Advertisement No. 377/202526 and complete their online application between 30 Mar 2026 (2:00 PM) and 13 Apr 2026 (11:59 PM).

Candidates should carefully enter personal details, educational qualifications, category, domicile status and reservation claims as per their original certificates. Upload photograph (5 cm height × 3.6 cm width, white background, within 1 year) and signature (2.5 cm height × 7.5 cm width) in JPG format (max 15 KB each). After confirming the application, save the Confirmation Number and download/print the application form immediately as it cannot be downloaded after the last date.

GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Class-3 Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted through a single-stage competitive written examination followed by certificate verification and merit list preparation.
  • Written Examination: A single MCQ-based competitive examination will be conducted in CBRT (Computer Based Response Test) / OMR mode with a total of 210 questions for 210 marks in 3 hours (180 minutes). The paper is divided into two parts — Part-A (90 marks) covering Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (30 marks), Constitution of India & Current Affairs & Comprehension (30 marks); and Part-B (120 marks) covering subject-specific questions related to Ayurvedic Nursing qualifications. Minimum qualifying standard is 40% in both Part-A and Part-B separately for all categories. Negative marking of 1/4 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Merit List & Selection: After the provisional result, candidates who qualify in both parts will be shortlisted for certificate verification at approximately 2x the number of vacancies category-wise. Final selection lists will be prepared based on total marks secured in the competitive examination, with separate category-wise lists and implementation of horizontal reservation for women and ex-servicemen. Widows get an additional 5% marks added to their exam score. Recognized sports persons (National/Inter-University/SGFI level) also get an additional 5% marks added.

How to Apply for GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible candidates for GSSSB Staff Nurse (Ayurveda) Class-3 Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the OJAS portal within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit OJAS Portal: Go to https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in and click on "Online Application" → Apply → Select GSSSB.
  • Step 2 – Select Advertisement: Click on Advertisement No. 377/202526 – Staff Nurse (Ayurveda), Class-3 and click "Apply Now." Read all the details carefully before proceeding.
  • Step 3 – Fill Personal Details: Enter all personal details (name, date of birth, gender, category, address, mobile number, email ID, marital status, widow/sports/ex-servicemen/PwD status etc.) carefully as per your original certificates. Fields marked with red asterisk (*) are mandatory.
  • Step 4 – Fill Educational Details: Enter educational qualification details as per your certificates including Ayurvedic Nursing Diploma, computer knowledge certificate details and other required information.
  • Step 5 – Upload Photo & Signature: Upload passport-size photograph (white background, within 1 year, JPG, max 15 KB) and signature (JPG, max 15 KB) in the prescribed dimensions. The same photo must be used throughout the recruitment process.
  • Step 6 – Confirm & Pay Fee: Review all entries, confirm the application and note the Confirmation Number. Pay examination fee online (Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI/Wallet) by 16 Apr 2026. Download and save the fee receipt. Print a copy of the application form immediately and keep it safely for certificate verification and further stages.

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (UR) 11-04-1992 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (SC/ST) 11-04-1987 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

  • All Other Degree Posts: General Knowledge (40 Marks) + Mental Ability (40 Marks) = 80 Marks
  • Office Subordinate: General Knowledge (50 Marks) + Mental Ability (30 Marks) = 80 Marks
  • Total Questions: 80 (Each 1 mark)
  • Duration: 90 Minutes
  • Language: English and Telugu (English version final)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 40% (OC/EWS), 35% (BC), 30% (SC/ST/PwBD)

Stage 2: Skill Test (For Selected Posts Only)

  • Applicable for: Senior System Officer, Computer Operator, U.D. Stenographer, Stenographer, Typist, Copyist, Data Entry Operator
  • Computer Based Examination marks used for screening only (not added to final merit)
  • Final selection based ONLY on Skill Test performance
  • Skill Test mode and particulars will be uploaded on aphc.gov.in

Merit List Preparation

  • For Section Officer, Assistant Librarian, Librarian Gr.-II, Assistant, Examiner, Office Subordinate: Merit based on Computer Based Examination marks
  • For Senior System Officer, Computer Operator, U.D. Stenographer, Stenographer, Typist, Copyist, DEO: Merit based ONLY on Skill Test marks
  • Tie-breaker: Age (elder first) → Higher educational qualification → Highest marks in prescribed qualification
  • Score normalization for multi-shift examinations will be applied

AP High Court Salary 2026

Selected candidates will receive the following monthly salary as per AP State Pay Scales:

  • Section Officer: ₹57,100 - ₹1,47,760
  • Senior System Officer: ₹44,570 - ₹1,27,480
  • Computer Operator: ₹40,970 - ₹1,24,380
  • Assistant Librarian: ₹40,970 - ₹1,24,380
  • Librarian Grade-II: ₹35,570 - ₹1,09,910
  • U.D. Stenographer: ₹34,580 - ₹1,27,480
  • Assistant/Examiner/Typist/Copyist/Data Entry Operator/Stenographer: ₹25,220 - ₹80,910
  • Office Subordinate: ₹20,000 - ₹61,960

This appointment shall be covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme.

How to Apply for AP High Court Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for AP High Court Recruitment 2026 by following the steps given below.

  1. Visit official AP High Court website [aphc.gov.in](https://aphc.gov.in)
  2. Navigate to Recruitment section and click on Notification No. 01/2026/Estt.
  3. Read the complete notification carefully
  4. Click on "Apply Online" link (available from 30.03.2026)
  5. Complete registration with valid email ID and mobile number
  6. Login and fill all mandatory details in the application form (Personal Information, Educational Qualifications, Upload Documents, Payment)
  7. Upload required documents:
    • Pass certificates and marksheets
    • Date of Birth certificate (SSC/10th certificate)
    • Caste certificate (if applicable - SC/ST/BC/EWS)
    • Non-Creamy Layer certificate (for BC candidates - issued in 2025 or 2026)
    • EWS Certificate (issued in 2025 or 2026 showing annual family income below ₹8,00,000)
    • PwBD Certificate (issued in 2025 or 2026 by Medical Board)
    • Ex-Servicemen Discharge Certificate (if applicable)
    • No Objection Certificate from employer (if employed)
    • Recent passport size photograph and signature
  8. Pay application fee online:
    • OC/EWS/BC candidates: ₹800 per post
    • SC/ST/PwBD candidates: ₹400 per post (only AP recognized SC/ST)
  9. Choose examination center preference (3 preferences)
  10. Verify all details and click Final Submit before 19.04.2026 (11:59 PM)
  11. Take printout of the submitted application for future reference

Important Instructions

  • Only online applications will be accepted; no other mode entertained
  • Candidates must pay separate fee for each post applied
  • Application fee once paid is non-refundable
  • BC candidates must upload latest non-creamy layer certificate issued in 2025 or 2026, otherwise considered under Open Category
  • EWS candidates must upload latest certificate issued in 2025 or 2026 showing annual family income below ₹8,00,000
  • PwBD candidates must upload latest disability certificate issued in 2025 or 2026 by Medical Board
  • 33.13% posts reserved for women as per G.O.Ms.No.77 dated 02.08.2023

  • Persons convicted for moral turpitude not eligible

NARL Scientist, Engineer & JRF Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates must satisfy the NARL eligibility criteria 2026 in terms of educational qualification and age limit for the respective posts as on the closing date 27.04.2026.

The NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Selection Process 2026 is primarily based on shortlisting and interview as per the respective notifications.

Candidates have to apply online for NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Recruitment 2026 through the official website within the given dates.

  • Step 4 - Submit application before last date: Submit the NARL online application form on or before 27 April 2026 (23:59 hrs); applications through any other mode will be summarily rejected.
  • Step 5 - Preserve registration number & follow updates: Note the online registration number for future reference and regularly check your email and the NARL website for interview call letters, schedule, and any corrigendum regarding NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Recruitment 2026.

IRB GD Constable Physical Standards

Physical Standards – Height (Male):

  • General: 165 cm
  • APST (other than Tirap, Changlang & Longding): 160 cm
  • APST (Tirap / Changlang / Longding districts): 152 cm
  • APST Ex-Servicemen: 157 cm

Physical Standards – Chest (Male)

  • All categories: 79 cm (normal) and 84 cm (expanded).

Vision Standards

  • Distant vision: better eye 6/6 (corrected), worse eye 6/12 (corrected); near vision J1/J2 (corrected); no colour blindness and must qualify medical fitness test.

IRB GD Constable Selection Process 2026

  • Stage I – Written Examination (Objective Type MCQ): All eligible candidates will appear for a 2‑hour written exam of 200 marks covering General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability and Test of English Language & Comprehension; candidates must score at least 33% aggregate marks to qualify.
  • Stage II – Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Shortlisted candidates will undergo height and chest measurement followed by PET events such as 100 m and 1500 m race, high jump and long jump; only those meeting prescribed standards and timings will be considered further.
  • Stage III – Trade Test / Medical Fitness (as applicable): For Constable Band and Constable Bugler posts, a trade test in playing band/bugle will be conducted, and all candidates must also qualify the medical fitness test including eye‑sight norms and absence of colour blindness.
  • Final Merit List: The final IRB GD Constable merit list 2026 will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination, subject to qualifying PST, PET, trade test and medical examination, and considering reservation rules for APST, UR and Ex‑Servicemen categories.
  • Document Verification: Before appointment, candidates must produce original certificates for age, education, category, experience (if any) and other claims; any mismatch or false information will lead to cancellation of candidature.

How to Apply for IRB GD Constable Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates must apply online only for IRB GD Constable Recruitment 2026 through the official APSSB website apssb.nic.in; applications submitted by any other mode will be rejected.
  • The IRB GD Constable online application link will be active from 23 March 2026 (11:00 AM) to 10 April 2026 (03:00 PM); candidates should complete registration, form fill‑up and fee payment within this window.
  • Applicants have to register with a valid mobile number and email ID, fill in personal details, educational qualification, category, post preferences and upload required documents (photo, signature and certificates) in the prescribed format.
  • After verifying all details, candidates must pay the examination fee online (₹150 for APST candidates and ₹200 for UR candidates, non‑refundable) and submit the IRB GD Constable application form 2026; only successfully submitted forms with fee payment will be accepted.
  • Candidates are advised to take a printout of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference during written exam, PET/PST, trade test and document verification.

APPSC TGT Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the APPSC TGT Eligibility Criteria 2026 in terms of nationality, age limit and educational qualification. APPSC TGT Age Limit 2026

APPSC TGT Educational Qualification 2026

  • Candidates must possess a Second‑Class Bachelor’s Degree in Arts, Science or Commerce from a recognised university.

  • Students who are still in the final year/final semester of Bachelor’s Degree or B.Ed are not eligible to apply for APPSC TGT 2026.
  • Each candidate is allowed to apply for only one TGT (Secondary) post/subject under this recruitment.

APPSC TGT Selection Process 2026

The APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 selection process is conducted in two main stages – a Written Examination (Objective) followed by Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching. Candidates must qualify the APPSC TGT Written Exam 2026 by securing the prescribed minimum marks to be shortlisted for the APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce round.

Stage 1 – APPSC TGT Written Examination 2026

  • The APPSC TGT Written Examination (Objective) consists of two parts – a General paper and a Concerned Subject paper, together carrying a total of 450 marks.
  • Paper 1 – General English, General Studies, Aptitude & Pedagogy (Objective): 150 marks.
  • Paper 2 – Concerned Subject (Objective): 300 marks in the relevant TGT subject (e.g. English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, etc.).
  • There is negative marking in the APPSC TGT exam – 1/6th of the marks allotted to the question will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • To qualify the written exam, a candidate must secure at least the minimum qualifying marks prescribed in the notification (overall aggregate as well as subject‑wise), only then they will be considered for the next stage of the APPSC TGT selection process 2026.

Stage 2 – APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce & Classroom Teaching 2026

  • Candidates who qualify in the written examination will be shortlisted in order of merit in a ratio of about 3 times the number of advertised TGT vacancies for the Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching test.
  • The APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching carries 50 marks and is conducted on the premises of the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission.
  • This stage evaluates the candidate’s subject knowledge, teaching skills, communication ability, classroom handling and overall suitability for the Trained Graduate Teacher post.

Final Merit List – APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher 2026

  • The final selection for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 is made on the basis of total marks obtained out of 500 marks (450 marks in Written Examination + 50 marks in Viva‑Voce & Classroom Teaching).
  • Candidates who fail to meet the minimum qualifying marks in the written exam or are found ineligible at document verification will not be considered for final appointment as APPSC TGT, even if they appeared in the examination.

How to Apply for APPSC TGT Recruitment 2026

The application process for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Eligible candidates must first complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the APPSC portal and then submit the APPSC TGT Application Form 2026 within the specified dates.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission at www.appsc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: Click on the “One Time Registration (OTR)” link and complete the registration by entering basic details to generate your Login ID and password (if already registered, skip this step and log in directly).
  • Step 3: After successful OTR, log in with your registered User ID and password and open the online application link for Advertisement No. 02/2026 – Trained Graduate Teacher Examination 2026 (Secondary Level).
  • Step 4: Fill in the APPSC TGT online application form with accurate personal details, contact information, TGT subject/post, category, educational qualifications and B.Ed details as per your certificates.
  • Step 5: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport‑size photograph, signature and required documents (photo ID, APST certificate, PwBD certificate, etc.) in the prescribed format and file size.
  • Step 6: Pay the APPSC TGT application fee 2026 online – ₹150 for APST candidates and ₹200 for other candidates, while PwBD candidates are exempted from fee payment.
  • Step 7: Carefully review all details entered in the APPSC TGT Application Form 2026; submit only a single, fully completed application. In case of multiple forms, the one with the highest Registration ID and complete details will be considered.
  • Step 8: Click on “Submit” to finalise the form and download/print the submitted APPSC TGT application form and fee receipt for future reference, written examination and document verification.

Applicants are advised to complete the APPSC TGT online form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last‑minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.

DD Guwahati Casual Assignee Selection Process 2026

The Doordarshan Kendra Guwahati Casual Assignee Selection Process 2026 is purely for empanelment on assignment basis and involves shortlisting and skill assessment of eligible candidates who apply for different categories.

  • DDK Guwahati will first scrutinise the received applications and shortlist candidates based on eligibility criteria such as age, educational qualification, technical qualification, relevant experience and other prescribed conditions.
  • Only the shortlisted candidates will be called for the next stage of the DD Guwahati Casual Assignee selection process, which may include written tests, practical/skill tests and/or interviews.
  • The written or skill tests can be conducted in various formats such as objective (multiple choice), descriptive, computer‑based tests, group discussions, one‑on‑one interviews, or software‑based practical tests (for example, video editing or graphics software proficiency).
  • These tests and interactions will assess the candidate’s skills, suitability, efficiency and personality for the specific casual assignee category (Resource Person, Video Assistant, Video Editor, Website/Social Media, Camera Assistant, CG Operator, Library/Archive Assistant).
  • No TA/DA will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the skill tests, written tests or interviews conducted as part of the DD Guwahati Casual Assignee Selection Process 2026.
  • After the completion of assessments, a panel (empanelment list) of suitable candidates will be prepared for each category; inclusion in the panel does not guarantee regular employment and engagement will be purely on assignment basis.
  • Empanelled casual assignees may be given assignments by DDK Guwahati for DD Assam on an “as and when required” basis, with a maximum of 7 assignments per month, as per the prevailing Prasar Bharati fee structure.
  • The validity of the DD Guwahati Casual Assignee panel is typically fixed for a specific period (e.g. 2 years), after which it may be reviewed or reconstituted as per the organisation’s requirement.

BVFCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

All qualifications must be full time from UGC/AICTE recognized universities/institutes; qualifications obtained through distance learning mode will not be accepted. Where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, equivalent percentage must be produced as per university norms at the time of document verification.

Educational Qualification & Experience

  • Sr Manager (Finance): Graduate with CA or ICWA with minimum 12 years post professional qualification executive experience in line in a PSU/large private sector organization, out of which 4 years in managerial position; experience in financial accounting, costing, budgeting, taxation, audit, liaison with banks/FIs; SAP knowledge desirable.
  • Dy Manager (Finance): Graduate with CA or ICWA with minimum 8 years post qualification executive experience in finance/accounts in a PSU/large private sector organization; SAP knowledge desirable.
  • Officer (Finance): Graduate with CA or ICWA with minimum 3 years post qualification executive experience in finance/accounts in a PSU/large private sector organization.
  • Safety Officer: Full time B.E/B.Tech in Fire Engineering with minimum 3 years post qualification executive experience in Safety in a PSU/large private sector industry; specific physical standards and vision criteria as per advertisement.
  • Engineer (Production): Full time B.E/B.Tech in Chemical Engineering with minimum 3 years post qualification executive experience in line in a PSU/large private sector chemical industry; preference for fertilizer/chemical industries.
  • Engineer (Mechanical): Full time B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 3 years post qualification executive experience in mechanical maintenance in a PSU/large process industry; preference for fertilizer/chemical industries.
  • Engineer (Instrumentation): Full time B.E/B.Tech in Instrumentation / Electronics & Instrumentation / Electronics & Communication with minimum 3 years post qualification executive experience in instrumentation maintenance in a PSU/large process industry; exposure to DCS/PLC systems preferred.
  • Engineer (Civil): Full time B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering with minimum 3 years post qualification experience in RCC/steel structures, building/road maintenance, civil projects, sanitary & fire water lines, tendering in PSU/large private sector; fertilizer/chemical/refinery experience preferred.
  • Dy Manager (HR): Full time MBA / 2-year PG Degree or Diploma in Personnel Management & Industrial Relations / Labour & Social Welfare with minimum 8 years post qualification executive experience in HR in PSU/large private sector; Law degree desirable.
  • Officer (HR): Full time MBA / 2-year PG Degree or Diploma in Personnel Management & Industrial Relations / Labour & Social Welfare with minimum 3 years post qualification executive experience in HR in PSU/large private sector; Law degree desirable.

Age Limit (as on 01.03.2026)

  • Sr Manager (Finance): Maximum 51 years
  • Dy Manager (Finance) / Dy Manager (HR): Maximum 48 years
  • Officer (Finance/HR), Safety Officer, Engineer posts: Maximum 40 years

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/Ex-servicemen is applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

BVFCL Recruitment 2026 Salary & Contract Terms

  • Basic Pay as per respective IDA scales with 3% increment, with DA (for FTC employees) as per corporation rules notified in the advertisement.
  • Approximate CTC ranges from about ₹8.94 lakh per annum for E1-level posts to about ₹17.90 lakh per annum for Sr Manager (Finance).
  • Engagement is purely on Fixed Term Contract basis for 2 years, extendable by a further 2 years (total not exceeding 4 years), and does not confer any right to regular/permanent employment.
  • Statutory benefits and leave as per applicable labour laws and BVFCL rules; other benefits only if specifically extended to FTC employees.

BVFCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Shortlisting based on eligibility and relevant experience as per advertisement.
  • Selection through Personal Interview; BVFCL may conduct screening test/written test/skill or trade test depending on the number of applications.
  • Document verification with original certificates; candidature is liable to cancellation in case of any discrepancy or false information.

BVFCL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • UR / OBC / EWS: ₹200/- (payable online through internet banking/credit/debit card as per portal instructions).
  • SC / ST / PwBD candidates: Exempted from fee, subject to valid certificate.

Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IRFC Recruitment 2026 Notification Overview

The Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) has officially released a recruitment notification for Assistant, Assistant Manager. For all details regarding the recruitment process, eligibility, and application procedure, refer to the official notification. Eligible candidates can download it from the link below.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification, Interview (only for Post Code-02) and Medical Test.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT): Single stage consisting of Part A & Part B (100 MCQs, 90 minutes duration; 120 minutes for eligible PwBD with Scribe).
    • Part A (50 marks): Mathematics/Numerical Ability (20), General Awareness (10), Logical Reasoning (10), Knowledge about Railways/IRFC (10).
    • Part B (50 marks): Subject-specific (Corporate Accounting, Finance, Taxation, etc.).
    • Negative marking: 1/4th marks deducted for wrong answer.
    • Qualifying Marks: UR/EWS – 40%, SC/OBC-NCL – 30%, ST – 25%.
    • Normalization applied if CBT held in multiple shifts.
    • Candidates up to 3 times the vacancies (community-wise) will be called for next stage based on CBT merit.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will produce original documents/certificates for verification.
  • Interview (only for Assistant Manager/Finance – E1 Level): Weightage 20% in final merit (CBT 80% + Interview 20%).
  • Medical Test: Candidates must be medically FIT as per IRFC standards (C1 category).

Final merit prepared strictly as per CBT marks + Interview (where applicable) + extant reservation rules. Selected candidates will be on 1 year probation.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through IRFC official website

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official IRFC website and register online.
  2. Fill the online application form with all mandatory details.
  3. Upload scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and required certificates.
  4. Pay the application fee online (if applicable).
  5. Submit the form and take printout of the application for record.
  6. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications.
  7. Regular employees of IRFC are not required to produce NOC but must bring Vigilance & D&AR Clearance at Document Verification.
  8. No documents to be sent by post; everything is online.

General Instructions

  • Candidates must read the full notification carefully before applying.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee selection.
  • Age is reckoned as on 01-01-2026.
  • Candidates must possess the prescribed essential qualifications as on the closing date.
  • Reservation benefits are applicable as per Government of India rules.
  • PwBD candidates (minimum 40% disability) can avail scribe facility and compensatory time.
  • Ex-Servicemen candidates must produce Discharge Certificate/NOC.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending CBT/Interview/Document Verification/Medical Test.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • IRFC reserves the right to cancel/modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts in Delhi only.
  • All information/updates will be available only on the official IRFC website.
  • Selected candidates will execute a Service Bond (Rs. 2 Lakh + GST for Assistant; Rs. 3 Lakh + GST for Assistant Manager) to serve IRFC for minimum 2 years.
  • Appointment is subject to verification of antecedents and being found medically FIT.

Step 2 – Login and Search Establishment: For candidates with Technical/Engineering subjects, apply through the Establishment user ID NDLNOC000005 (INMAS/Institute of Nuclear Medicine and Allied Sciences) on the portal www.mhrdnats.gov.in.

Step 3 – Verify Eligibility: Before applying, ensure that you fulfill all eligibility criteria including the qualifying course, pass-out year (2022 or later), regular candidate status, and that you do not hold a post-graduation degree or prior training/job experience of 1 year or more in the relevant field.

Step 4 – Fill and Submit Application: Fill in all required personal details, educational qualification details, discipline, category, and reservation claims carefully and submit the application online before 30 April 2026.

Step 5 – Keep Records: Save a copy of the submitted application for future reference. Selected candidates will be required to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining and execute a contract for 12 months of training as per the Apprentices Act 1961.

  • Phase IV – Verification of Original Documents & Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Shortlisted candidates will undergo document verification followed by Detailed Medical Examination. Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo Review Medical Examination (RME) by giving written consent within 24 hours.

Selection Process – Executive Officer

For Executive Officer posts (all domains), the selection process includes a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by interview.

  • Mode: CBT with Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ) plus Descriptive questions.
  • Medium: English.
  • Total marks: 150 marks, duration 150 minutes.

Structure for Executive Officer CBT:

  • General Section – Part A (MCQ): 30 questions, 30 marks.
  • General Section – Part B (Descriptive): 2 questions, 30 marks.
  • Technical Section (MCQ): 90 questions, 90 marks.
  • Negative marking: 0.25 mark for each wrong MCQ answer; no negative marking for descriptive questions.

The technical syllabus differs by domain code (2602–2608) and covers domain-specific topics such as Accounting Standards, auditing, tax laws, company law, sustainability, economics, infrastructure engineering, and IT, as detailed in the annexure to the notification

How to Apply for DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026

The notification invites dynamic and experienced candidates for Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C), Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C), Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C) and Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C) with postings in North, West and South Zones including New Delhi, Chandigarh, Ferozepur, Pathankot, Rawatbhata, Mumbai, Kakrapar, Bengaluru, Kaiga, Kudankulam, Kalpakkam and Chennai.

Engagement will be purely on contract basis for an initial period of one year, extendable up to four years (two years for one Kudankulam PE‑C category) based on project requirements and performance, with consolidated monthly emoluments up to Rs. 55,000 for Project Engineers and other benefits like medical insurance reimbursement, PF and TA/DA as per rules.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Advertisement

Notification PDF for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 is available on the ECIL careers page under the title “Walk‑in Selections for various Contract Posts (Advt. No. 07/2026)”. Candidates should download and read the ECIL notification carefully to check detailed post‑wise qualifications, experience, age limits, reservation, salary, selection criteria and complete instructions for appearing in the walk‑in.

Document Download Link
ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF (Advt. 07/2026) Download Notification PDF
ECIL Contract Application Form 2026 (PE‑C / TO‑C / APE‑C / SA‑C) Download Application Form

ECIL Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL), a Govt. of India (DAE) enterprise, Miniratna Category‑I 
Advertisement Number & Date Advt. No. 07/2026, dated 26.03.2026 
Post Names (on contract) Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer, Senior Artisan
Tenure Initial 1 year, extendable up to 4 years (including initial term) depending on project requirement & performance; one PE‑C post at Kudankulam extendable up to 2 years 
Work Locations/Zones New Delhi & Chandigarh & Ferozepur & Pathankot & Rawatbhata (North Zone); Mumbai & Kakrapar (West Zone); Bengaluru & Kaiga (South Zone); Kudankulam, Kalpakkam & Chennai (South Zone) 
Qualification B.E./B.Tech., Diploma, ITI
Upper Age Limit (UR) 30 and 33 Years
Selection Method Walk‑in registration & document verification,
Application Mode Walk‑in only – candidates must download application form from www.ecil.co.in, fill and carry with original & self‑attested documents to venue; no online form submission 
Official Website https://www.ecil.co.in (Careers/Recruitment section, Advt. No. 07/2026) 

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy 2026 Details

A total of 27 vacancies will be filled for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan posts under the ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026) on fixed tenure contract basis across North, West and South Zones. Check ECIL post wise contract vacancy details in the table below.

Post ECIL Vacancy 2026
Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C) 14
Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C) 08
Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C) 03
Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C) 07
Total ECIL Contract Posts 32

ECIL Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates (walk‑in schedule)

ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 Events Important Dates & Details
Date of ECIL Advt. 07/2026 notification 26 March 2026 
Walk‑in date – Mumbai (West Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, #1207, Veer Savarkar Marg, Dadar (Prabhadevi), Mumbai – 400028 
Walk‑in date – New Delhi (North Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, D‑15, DDA Local Shopping Complex, A‑Block, Ring Road, Naraina, New Delhi – 110028 
Walk‑in date – Bengaluru (South Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, #1/1, 2nd Floor, LIC Building, Sampige Road, Malleswaram, Bengaluru – 560003 
Walk‑in date – Chennai (South Zone) 18 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, Economist House, S‑15, Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai – 600032 
Walk‑in registration time at venues 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs; candidates reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be allowed to register 
Cut‑off date for age & post‑qualification experience Date of selection (respective walk‑in date) 

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, ECE, ETC, EEE, E&I, CSE, IT, CSIT, Mechanical/Electrical with NDT Level‑II (for Kudankulam) along with a minimum of 3 years post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship in the relevant field up to 1 year is also counted as experience.
  • Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/ETC/EEE/E&I/CSE/IT and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship up to 1 year is countable towards experience.
  • Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C): Diploma with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in ECE/ETC/Electronics/EEE/Instrumentation and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience including relevant apprenticeship.
  • Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C): ITI passed in Electronics, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Instrumentation or Radio & TV trades with minimum 2 years post‑qualification experience (including up to 1 year apprenticeship) in maintenance/repair of electronics, instrumentation systems, communication gadgets or computers.
  • Age Limit (UR): Project Engineer – maximum 33 years; Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan – maximum 30 years. Age relaxation is 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, an additional 10 years for PwBD (40% and above) over category relaxation, and 5 years for candidates domiciled in J&K from 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 will receive consolidated monthly emoluments based on the post and contract year, along with limited benefits as per ECIL rules.
  • Consolidated Emoluments: Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there is no mention of any application or examination fee in the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

There is no online application process for ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026); candidates have to attend walk‑in selections as per the notified schedule. Eligible applicants must visit the official ECIL website ecil.co.in, download the prescribed ECIL contract application form 2026, fill it carefully and report at the concerned zonal walk‑in venue on the respective date within the registration time slot.

Candidates must carry the duly filled ECIL application form, updated resume, original certificates and one set of self‑attested photocopies for age, qualification, experience, category, disability, ex‑servicemen and identity proof along with recent passport size photographs. Registration and document verification will be done at the venue before the personal interview under ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026.

Click to Download ECIL Contract Application Form 2026

Download ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 07/2026)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 selection for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan will be based on walk‑in registration, document verification and personal interview with a weighted merit system.
  • Shortlisting & Evaluation: After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks.
  • Final Merit & Offer: Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.

How to Apply / Attend ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 07/2026) must appear personally at the designated zonal venues on the scheduled walk‑in dates with the prescribed application form and documents.

  • Step 1 – Download ECIL Application Form: Visit the official ECIL website www.ecil.co.in, open the Careers/Recruitment section and download the application form for Advt. No. 07/2026. Take a printout and fill it neatly with all required details including post category, zone and location preference.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Documents: Keep ready original and one set of self‑attested copies of 10th certificate (DOB proof), all qualification certificates and marksheets, CGPA‑to‑percentage conversion (if applicable), complete experience certificates with from‑to dates and post held, appointment order and recent payslips (if currently employed), caste (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) certificate, non‑creamy layer OBC certificate (not older than one year), PwBD certificate, Ex‑servicemen/ J&K domicile proof and valid government ID (Aadhaar/Passport etc.).
  • Step 3 – Reach Walk‑in Venue in Time: Report to the respective ECIL Zonal Office (Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru on 09 April 2026; Chennai on 18 April 2026) within the registration time 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs. Late reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Step 4 – Registration & Document Verification: Submit the filled ECIL application form 2026, resume and document set at the registration desk. After successful verification, candidates will be allowed to attend the personal interview as part of the selection process.
  • Step 5 – Attend Interview & Wait for Result: Appear for the interview as scheduled at the venue. Final selection will be based on the combined weightage of qualification, experience and interview performance. Shortlisted candidates will receive joining instructions from ECIL and must be prepared for posting at project locations anywhere in India.

SSB Paramedical Eligibility Criteria 2026

Eligibility criteria include age limit, educational qualification, professional qualification and experience. All conditions must be met by the closing date of receipt of applications.

Category Age Relaxation beyond Upper Age Limit

SSB Paramedical Educational & Professional Qualification 2026

Post-wise essential educational and professional qualifications are as follows:

Post Essential Educational & Professional Qualification
Head Constable (Laboratory Assistant) (i) 12th class pass with Biology as a subject from a recognized Board.
(ii) Certificate course of minimum one year in Laboratory Assistant Course from a recognized institution.
(iii) Working experience of minimum one year as Lab Assistant in a Laboratory Diagnostic Centre or hospital or institution lab recognized by Central/State Government.
Head Constable (Physiotherapy Assistant) (i) 12th class pass from a recognized Board.
(ii) Certificate course of minimum one year in Physiotherapy from a recognized institute.
(iii) Experience of minimum one year as Physiotherapy Assistant from a Physiotherapy Centre or minimum 100-bedded hospital or institute recognized by Central/State Government.
Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic) (i) 10th class pass from a recognized Board.
(ii) First Aid Certificate course from St. John's Ambulance Organization or Red Cross Society of India.
(iii) Experience of minimum one year as Nursing Assistant in a minimum 50-bedded Hospital or Institution recognized by Central/State Government.

SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026

The SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026 consists of the following stages:

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET):
    • HC (Lab Assistant) & HC (Physiotherapy Assistant): Male – 1.6 km in 6 min 30 sec; Female – 800 m in 4 min
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): Male – 4.8 km in 24 min; Female – 2.4 km in 18 min
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET
  • Stage I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Height and chest measurement as per category-wise norms (General/UR/OBC/EWS: Male 165 cm, Female 155 cm; chest for males 75–80 cm; relaxations for ST, NE States, Garhwali, Kumaoni, Dogra, Maratha, J&K/Ladakh candidates).
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test):
    • HC (Lab Assistant & Physiotherapy Assistant): 150 marks, 3 hours, 150 MCQs – Part I (50 marks): GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi; Part II (100 marks): Technical Subject. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): 100 marks, 2 hours, 100 MCQs – GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
  • Stage III – Documentation & Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): Top 3 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) from written exam will be called. Final merit list drawn on written exam marks.

How to Apply for SSB Paramedical Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official SSB Recruitment website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ or https://ssb.gov.in/ and read all instructions carefully before filling the application.
  2. Fill Part-I of the online application: Post name, personal details (name as per matriculation certificate), father's/mother's name, date of birth, gender, nationality, religion, marital status, category.
  3. Fill Part-II: Upload passport-size coloured photograph (JPG, 4–12 KB, 100×120 pixels, white background, 75% face) and signature (JPG, 4–12 KB, 140×80 pixels, blue/black ink).
  4. After successful upload, a Registration Number will be generated – note it down or take a printout.
  5. Fill remaining details: Aadhaar number/photo ID, identification marks, mobile number (mandatory), email ID (mandatory), education qualification, postal/permanent address, criminal case declaration, and create a password.
  6. Proceed to Part-III: Pay examination fee (if applicable) through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI.
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
  8. Report to the recruitment venue on the date mentioned in the Admit Card with all original documents, certificates, Aadhaar Card, etc.

Important Instructions

  • A candidate can apply for only ONE post from the three posts mentioned.
  • Only online applications will be accepted; applications through any other mode will be rejected.
  • All educational/professional certificates must be possessed by the closing date of receipt of applications.
  • Date of Birth and name as recorded in Matriculation certificate are final; no subsequent change will be considered.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in recruitment tests; candidates must arrange their own stay for at least one week. Unemployed SC/ST candidates appearing in written test will be reimbursed fare as per rules.
  • Biometric attendance, digital photograph, signature and thumb impression will be taken at all stages.
  • Once category is registered, no change of category will be entertained.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates fulfilling UR eligibility criteria may apply against unreserved vacancies where no reserved vacancies exist.
  • EWS certificate must be valid for 2026–2027; OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate should be within three years of the closing date.
  • Persons employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSUs must apply through proper channel and submit NOC at documentation stage.
  • Calculator, digital diary, mobile phone, pager, whitener, blade etc. are prohibited at the recruitment venue.
  • DG, SSB reserves the right to increase/decrease/cancel vacancies or postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • All updates and amendments will be available only on the SSB Recruitment website; candidates must visit regularly.

SSB Constable Selection Process 2026

The SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Selection Process 2026 comprises multiple stages, and only those candidates who qualify each stage as per SSB norms will be considered for final appointment.

  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will undergo PST where height and chest (for male candidates) are measured as per category and region-wise standards; those not meeting minimum standards are rejected.
  • Written Examination: Objective-type written test as per SSB pattern for Constable posts (detailed scheme to be provided on official website/notification).
  • Trade/Skill Test: Practical trade test for Tradesman posts and driving/maintenance test for Driver post to assess hands-on skills.
  • Documentation & Medical Examination: Verification of original documents, certificates, category proofs followed by medical examination as per SSB medical standards.

Selection Process

  • The selection process consists of Stage I – INET (Indian Navy Entrance Test) followed by Stage II (Physical Fitness Test, Written Examination and Recruitment Medical) and Pre-Enrolment Medicals.
  • Stage I – INET is a computer-based examination with 100 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • The Stage I question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness.
  • The standard of Stage I question paper is that of 10+2, and syllabus and sample papers are available on the official website.
  • The duration of Stage I examination is one hour, and candidates are required to pass in all sections as well as in aggregate; pass marks in each section and aggregate are determined by the Indian Navy.
  • Negative marking is applicable in Stage I – one fourth (0.25) marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Centre allocation for INET (online examination) is at the discretion of the Indian Navy.
  • In case of extraneous circumstances causing non-conduct of INET or as per service requirement, Indian Navy reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on marks obtained in qualifying examinations (10th/12th board exams).
  • Results of Stage I – INET (Pass/Fail) along with marks scored will be uploaded on the candidate’s online dashboard.
  • Candidates eligible for Stage II as per age criteria will be shortlisted for SSR (Medical) 02/2027 batch based on marks obtained in Stage I – INET 2026.
  • Shortlisting for Stage II will be carried out state wise, and cut-off marks for next stage will vary from state to state as vacancies are allotted state-wise.
  • If candidates with the same percentage exceed required numbers, shortlisting will be done based on Date of Birth, with earlier DOB (fewer chances) given priority.
  • Sponsor candidates and NCC ‘C’ certificate holders who upload original sponsor and NCC certificates during Stage I application and whose certificates are verified will be exempted from Stage I – INET and will be directly issued call-up for Stage II based on eligibility.
  • Stage II begins with Physical Fitness Test (PFT), which is mandatory; candidates undergoing PFT do so at their own risk.
  • PFT standards for male candidates are: 1.6 km run in 6 min 30 sec, 20 Squats (Uthak Baithak), 15 Push-ups and 15 Bent Knee Sit-ups.
  • The Stage II written exam is conducted only for candidates who qualify the PFT and consists of 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each.
  • The Stage II written exam question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness, with 10+2 level standard and one-hour duration.
  • Candidates must pass in all sections and in aggregate in the Stage II written exam; pass marks are set by the Indian Navy.
  • Recruitment Medical Examination is carried out for candidates who qualify PFT; candidates who qualify Recruitment Medical are considered for the merit list.
  • Candidates found medically unfit in Recruitment Medical may appeal for review at a designated military hospital within 5 days; medical certificates from other hospitals are not accepted and no further review/appeal is permissible.
  • Provisional Select List is prepared based on performance in Stage II written exam, subject to qualification in PFT and Recruitment Medical; merit list for SSR (Medical) is state-wise and cut-off for call-up to INS Chilka varies by state.
  • Pre-Enrolment Medical formalities are conducted at INS Chilka and induction is subject to qualifying these formalities; candidates not qualifying pre-enrolment medicals will be rejected.
