  • Qualifications – Head Constable (Electrician):
    • Matriculation or equivalent from a recognized Board.
    • Two years work experience in respective trade; OR
    • One year certificate course from a recognized Industrial Training Institute or Vocational Institute with at least one year experience in the respective trade; OR
    • Two years Diploma from a recognized Industrial Training Institute in the respective trade or similar trade; AND
    • Must qualify trade test.
  • Qualifications – Head Constable (Veterinary):
    • 12th class pass with Science and Biology as main subject from a recognized Board.
    • Two years Diploma Course in Veterinary and Livestock Development or Veterinary Stock Assistant Course or Animal Husbandry Course from an institution recognized by the Central Government or State Government.
  • Nationality: Only Indian citizens are eligible. No person who is not a citizen of India shall be appointed except with prior written permission of the Central Government. Subjects of Nepal or Bhutan may be appointed in the Force.
  • Crucial Date for Age & Eligibility: The closing date for receipt of applications i.e. 30 (thirty) days from the date of publication of this advertisement in the Employment News will be the crucial date to determine age and all eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions for the applied post and be in possession of all certificates as on the last date of receipt of applications.

Salary / Stipend

  • Post: Head Constables (Steward, Communication, Electrician and Veterinary)
  • Pay Scale (7th CPC): Level-4 Pay Matrix – Basic Pay ₹25,500/- to ₹81,100/- Per Month
  • Other Allowances: Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and any other allowances as admissible in SSB from time to time as per Government orders.
  • Pension: Selected candidates will be covered under Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (New Pension Scheme) OR Unified Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (UPS) as applicable for new entrants to Central Government services w.e.f. 01st January 2004 or 01st April 2025 respectively, as per prevailing government rules and organizational policies.

Age Limit 

  • Head Constable (Steward): Between 18 and 27 Years
  • Head Constable (Communication): Between 18 and 27 Years
  • Head Constable (Electrician): Between 18 and 25 Years
  • Head Constable (Veterinary): Between 18 and 27 Years
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC/ST: 5 years
    • OBC: 3 years
    • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years after deduction of military service rendered from actual age
    • Departmental Candidates (Central Govt. Employees): Up to 40 years (UR), 43 years (OBC), 45 years (SC/ST)
    • Candidates domiciled in J&K and Ladakh during 01-01-1980 to 31-12-1989 (UR): 5 years; (OBC): 8 years; (SC/ST): 10 years
    • Children and dependents of victims killed in 1984 riots (UR): 5 years; (OBC): 8 years; (SC/ST): 10 years
  • Age relaxation is NOT admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of ex-servicemen.
  • Date of Birth (D.O.B.) and name as recorded in Matriculation certificate will be accepted for determining the age and name. No subsequent request for change in date of birth and name will be considered.

Application Fee

  • UR, EWS and OBC Candidates: ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) – Non-Refundable
  • Exempted (Fee = Nil): SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen and Female candidates are exempted from payment of examination fees.
  • Payment Mode: Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI
  • No amount will be refunded in any case. Candidates are advised to avoid making multiple payments against a single registration as payments are non-refundable.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Published in Employment News 21–27 March 2026
Last Date for Receipt of Online Applications 30 days from date of publication of advertisement in Employment News
Crucial Date for Age & Eligibility Determination Closing date for receipt of applications (30 days from publication)

Selection Process

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST):
    • PET – Male: 1.6 Km run in 6 Minutes 30 Seconds; Female: 800 Meter race in 4 minutes.
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear in PST, Written Examination, Skill Test (as applicable), Documentation and Medical Examination.
    • PST – Candidates must meet prescribed height and chest standards (post-wise and category-wise as per notification).
    • General (UR/EWS/OBC): Male – 165 cm height, 75–80 cm chest; Female – 155 cm height (Head Constable Steward). Different standards apply for SC/ST, NE States, J&K and other specified categories.
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test – CBT):
    • Paper-I Common Entrance Test: 3 hours duration, 150 marks, 150 multiple-choice objective type questions.
    • Part-I (50 Marks): General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi.
    • Part-II (100 Marks): Technical Subject.
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for Gen/EWS/OBC/Ex-SM; 45% for SC/ST.
    • Final Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written examination.
  • Stage III – Skill Test (Only for Head Constable Electrician):
    • Skill test will be conducted for up to 20 times the vacancies (category-wise) for the post of Head Constable (Electrician).
    • Skill test carries 50 marks; minimum qualifying marks for all categories including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 60%.
    • Skill test is qualifying in nature. Marks of skill test will not be included in the final merit list.
  • Stage IV – Document Verification (DV) and Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME):
    • Candidates shortlisted up to 3 times the vacancies (category-wise) will be called for Documentation and DME/RME.
    • All original documents will be verified by detailed BOOs of SSB.
    • Candidates declared unfit in DME may prefer an appeal for Review Medical Examination (RME). The decision of RME Board will be final and no 2nd appeal will be entertained.
  • Final Selection: Final selection list will be prepared in order of merit, category-wise, after completion of Review Medical Examination. Where equal marks are obtained: candidate with more marks in Part-II (Technical Subject) will rank higher; if still equal, senior in age will rank higher; if date of birth is also same, priority based on alphabetical order of names in English.

General Information / Instructions

  • Posts are temporary but likely to continue. Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or outside the Territory of India and will be governed by SSB Act & Rules and other Rules amended from time to time.
  • A candidate can apply for only one post from amongst the posts mentioned in the notification.
  • Applications received through any mode except Online Mode shall not be accepted and rejected straightway.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who fulfill eligibility criteria of unreserved category may apply against the unreserved category for posts where no vacancies are reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS.
  • OBC Non-Creamy Layer status should have been obtained within three years of the closing date of receipt of applications.
  • EWS certificate should be valid for 2026-27 as per Annexure-III. Family gross annual income must be below ₹8,00,000/-.
  • Biometrics of both thumbs (Left & Right) of candidates will be taken for verification in all stages after attendance.
  • Persons employed in Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertakings should apply through proper channel and submit NOC from their employer at the time of documentation.
  • Name, Father's Name & Date of Birth should be mentioned exactly as recorded in the Matriculation certificate.
  • Candidates should be prepared for a stay of at least one week at the recruitment venue at their own arrangement. No TA/DA will be admissible.
  • Unemployed SC/ST candidates appearing in the written test will be reimbursed fare as admissible under relevant Rules subject to production of Rail/Bus tickets, original caste certificate and Non-employment certificate issued by MP or MLA or any Gazetted Officer.
  • Persons with bigamy/marriage to a person with a living spouse are disqualified. Conviction by court of law or dismissal from Government service also leads to disqualification.
  • Calculator, Digital Diary, Cellular Phone, pager, Whiteners, blade etc. are prohibited in the recruitment venue.
  • The DG, SSB has full right to make changes/cancel/postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • There will be no provision of reserve merit list/panel. If vacancies remain unfilled after declaration of final result, the same will be carried forward for the next recruitment.
  • Any amendment in the schedule/condition/process of recruitment will be available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ only.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are advised to go through the instructions and detailed advertisement available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ carefully before filling up the application form.
  • Applications must be submitted through Online Mode Only. Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted.
  • Fill all fields in the application form including: Post applied, Candidate's Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Birth (in DD/MM/YYYY format as per matriculation certificate), Gender, Nationality, Religion, Marital Status, Category, Education Qualification, Postal/Permanent Address, Aadhaar Number (or valid Photo Identity Card number), Identification Marks, Mobile Number, E-mail ID, Criminal Cases Declaration.
  • Upload passport size coloured photograph in JPG format (less than 12 KB and greater than 4 KB, resolution 100 pixel width × 120 pixel height, white background with 75% face visible).
  • Upload signature in JPG format (less than 12 KB and greater than 4 KB, resolution 140 pixel width × 60 pixel height).
  • Pay the requisite fee of ₹100/- (for UR/EWS/OBC) through Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI. SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Women candidates are exempted from fee payment.
  • After successful submission, note down the Registration Number generated and take a printout of the application form/acknowledgement for future reference.
  • Application form can be edited by clicking "Edit Details" button till the closing/last date of receipt of online application form. After submission, no request for change/correction will be entertained.
  • Reporting to Recruitment Venue: Admit Cards can be downloaded from the SSB Recruitment website. Candidates must report to the venue on the date mentioned in the Admit Card with all original documents including Identity certificate, educational qualification certificates, Caste Certificates, Aadhaar Card etc.

    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Technical Assistant – Shikshashastra/Education Lab. (Level-5):
    • Bachelor's Degree with minimum 3 years of working and maintenance/operation experience of Scientific Instruments in the Laboratory in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or Private Organization with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
  • Technical Assistant – Computer Lab. (Level-5):
    • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Computer Science and Technology/Information Technology from any recognised University/Institute; OR Master's Degree in Computer Science/Technology/MCA.
    • At least 2 years' experience in relevant field in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or Private Organization with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
  • Stenographer (Level-4):
    • Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute.
    • Proficiency in Stenography in English or Hindi at minimum 80 wpm.
    • Proficiency in Typing in English @ 35 wpm or Hindi @ 30 wpm.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
    • Skill Test: Dictation 10 minutes @ 80 wpm; Transcription: 50 minutes (English)/65 minutes (Hindi).
    • Desirable: Proficiency in English and good communication skills.
  • Upper Division Clerk – UDC (Level-4):
    • Bachelor's Degree from any recognised University/Institute.
    • 2 years' experience as LDC/equivalent posts in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or equivalent in reputed private companies/corporate banks with minimum annual turnover of Rs. 200 Crores.
    • Speed in English Typing @ 35 wpm OR Hindi Typing @ 30 wpm.
    • Proficiency in Computer Operations.
  • Library Assistant (Level-4):
    • Bachelor's Degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent from a recognised University.
    • Typing speed of 30 words per minute in English.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Lower Division Clerk – LDC (Level-2):
    • Bachelor's Degree from any recognised University/Institute.
    • English Typing @ 35 wpm OR Hindi Typing @ 30 wpm (35 wpm and 30 wpm correspond to 10500 KDPH/9000 KDPH on an average of 5 key depressions for each word).
    • Proficiency in Computer Operations.
  • Driver (Level-2):
    • 10th Pass from any recognised Board.
    • Valid Commercial Driving License for Light/Medium/Heavy Vehicles issued by Competent Authority with no adverse endorsement.
    • Knowledge of motor mechanism (ability to remove minor defects in vehicles).
    • At least 5 years' driving experience in an organization.
  • Multi-Tasking Staff – MTS (Level-1):
    • 10th Pass from a recognised Board; OR ITI Pass.
  • Library Attendant (Level-1):
    • 10+2 or equivalent from a recognised Board.
    • Certificate Course in Library Science from a recognised Institution.
    • 1 year experience in a University/College/Educational Institution Library.
    • Basic knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Medical Attendant / Dresser (Level-1):
    • 10+2 or equivalent with Science from a recognised Board.
    • 1 year experience as Attendant in related field in any Government/recognised hospitals/diagnostics centres/accredited centres.
    • Knowledge of Computer.

Salary/Stipend

  • Registrar: Pay Level-14 – Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200 (as per 7th CPC)
  • Assistant Registrar & System Analyst: Pay Level-10 – Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500
  • Section Officer & Nursing Officer: Pay Level-07 – Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400
  • Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant: Pay Level-06 – Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400
  • Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab. & Computer Lab.): Pay Level-05 – Rs. 29,200 to Rs. 92,300
  • Stenographer, Upper Division Clerk & Library Assistant: Pay Level-04 – Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100
  • Lower Division Clerk & Driver: Pay Level-02 – Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200
  • Multi-Tasking Staff, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser: Pay Level-01 – Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900

Age Limit (as on 16.04.2026)

  • Registrar: Preferably below 57 years.
  • Assistant Registrar & System Analyst: Not exceeding 40 years.
  • Section Officer, Nursing Officer, Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant: Not exceeding 35 years.
  • Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra & Computer Lab.), Stenographer, UDC, Library Assistant, LDC, Driver, MTS, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser: Not exceeding 32 years.
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and other eligible reserved categories.
  • Regular employees of Central/State Govt./Central Universities/UGC maintained Institutions/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies: Age relaxation as per Govt. of India rules.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Upper age limit for Group 'C' posts is relaxable up to 40 years (General) and 45 years (SC/ST) for candidates who have rendered 3 years continuous regular service.
  • Deputation candidates for posts below Pay Level-14: Must be less than 56 years of age; for Pay Level-14 and above: less than 58 years of age.

Application Fee

Pay Level Posts General / OBC / EWS SC / ST / PwBD
Level-10 to Level-14 Registrar, Assistant Registrar & System Analyst Rs. 3,000/- Rs. 1,500/-
Level-6 to Level-9 Section Officer, Nursing Officer, Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant Rs. 2,000/- Rs. 1,000/-
Level-1 to Level-5 Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab.), Technical Assistant (Computer Lab.), Stenographer, UDC, Library Assistant, LDC, Driver, MTS, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser Rs. 1,000/- (including Ex-Servicemen) Rs. 500/-
  • Fee payment mode: Online only through the SAMARTH portal link: https://sanskritnt.samarth.edu.in/
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.
  • Separate fee is required for each post applied for.
  • Applications submitted without requisite fee shall be rejected.
  • Any other mode of payment except online shall not be accepted.

Selection Process

  • Most posts will be filled through Direct Recruitment; certain posts through Deputation or Direct Recruitment failing which by Deputation.
  • Eligible candidates will undergo a Written Test (OMR Based / Descriptive) in the first instance.
  • Candidates shortlisted through Written Test will be called for Skill Test and/or Interview (as applicable to the post).
  • Examination Centres: Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata & Bengaluru (candidate may choose one city).
  • Examination Schedules (to avoid conflicts):
    • Schedule 1: System Analyst, Junior Engineer, Assistant, Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab.), Driver.
    • Schedule 2: Section Officer, Technical Assistant (Computer Lab.), Personal Assistant, Professional Assistant, Multi-Tasking Staff.
    • Schedule 3: Assistant Registrar, Upper Division Clerk, Library Assistant, Stenographer, Medical Attendant/Dresser, Library Attendant.
    • Schedule 4: Nursing Officer, Guest House Manager, Lower Division Clerk.
  • Candidates applying for multiple posts within the same Schedule cannot appear for both simultaneously.
  • For Registrar post: Direct/Deputation for tenure of 5 years or till superannuation (62 years), whichever is earlier.
  • Detailed Scheme of Examination and Syllabus available at: https://www.sanskrit.nic.in/scheme_of_exam.php

General Information / Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted Online through the SAMARTH Link: https://sanskritnt.samarth.edu.in/ available on the University's website www.sanskrit.nic.in under "Recruitment/Notification".

  • Hard copy for all other posts to be sent to: The Registrar, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
  • Mere possession of eligibility conditions does not entitle a candidate to be called for written/skill tests.
  • Candidates must apply separately for each post with separate requisite fee.
  • The University posts belong to All-India Cadre — once appointed, transfer requests will not be considered for a minimum lock-in period of 10 years.
  • Candidates currently in service (State/Central Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies) must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer at the time of document verification/interview.
  • PwBD candidates with less than 40% benchmark disability must submit a valid Disability Certificate uploaded with the application.
  • OBC NCL certificate must be issued on or after 01.04.2025 to be considered valid for this advertisement.
  • EWS certificate (current financial year) must be valid on or before the last date of online application submission.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid technical issues.

How to Apply

SSB ASI Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 must ensure that they fulfil the required age limit and educational qualification for the Assistant Sub Inspector posts in the paramedical cadre.

  • Age Limit: 18 to 27 years as on 20 April 2026 (last date of application). Upper age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, Ex-servicemen and other reserved categories as per Government rules.
  • Nationality: The applicant must be a citizen of India.

Post Wise SSB Assistant Sub Inspector Qualification

  • ASI (Radiographer): 12th pass with Science + 2 years Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology / Radiography from a recognised institute + minimum 1 year experience as Radiographer in a recognised Radiology Imaging Centre or 100 bedded hospital.
  • ASI (Pharmacist): 12th pass with Science + 2 years Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognised institution + registered as Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act, 1948 + minimum 1 year experience as Pharmacist in a 100 bedded hospital.
  • ASI (Operation Theatre Technician): 12th pass from a recognised board + Diploma in Operation Theatre Technology from a recognised institute + relevant experience as OT Technician/Assistant in a recognised hospital.
  • ASI (Dental Technician): 12th pass with Science + Diploma/Certificate in Dental Technician/Mechanic course from a recognised institute + experience in dental lab/department of recognised hospital as per notification.

SSB ASI Salary 2026

Candidates selected through SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 will be appointed as Assistant Sub Inspector in the paramedical cadre and will receive salary as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. All posts under SSB Assistant Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 carry the same pay level in the pay matrix.

Post Name Pay Level SSB ASI Salary 2026 (Basic Pay)
ASI (Radiographer) Level-5 ₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-
ASI (Pharmacist) Level-5 ₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-
ASI (Operation Theatre Technician) Level-5 ₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-
ASI (Dental Technician) Level-5 ₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-

Along with the basic pay, SSB ASI paramedical staff are entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Ration Money, Transport Allowance, dress allowance and other admissible benefits as per SSB and Central Government rules, making the in-hand SSB ASI salary 2026 approximately in the range of ₹40,000 to ₹50,000 per month depending on posting location and allowances.

SSB ASI Selection Process 2026

The selection process for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 will be conducted in multiple stages to assess the physical fitness, knowledge and medical standards of the candidates. Only those who qualify each stage of the SSB Assistant Sub Inspector selection process 2026 will be considered for final appointment.

  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Measurement of height, chest and weight as per SSB ASI paramedical standards. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed physical standards will be disqualified at this stage.
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Running and other endurance events as per Sashastra Seema Bal norms for Assistant Sub Inspector posts (pattern similar to other SSB non‑GD posts; details are given in the notification).
  • Written Examination: Objective type written test/CBT consisting of questions from General Knowledge, Reasoning, Numerical Ability, General English/Hindi and technical/paramedical subject related to the ASI post.
  • Skill/Trade Test (if applicable): Practical test to assess professional skills for posts like Radiographer, Pharmacist, OT Technician and Dental Technician as per SSB ASI recruitment rules.
  • Document Verification: Verification of original documents such as educational certificates, diplomas, experience certificates, caste certificate, age proof, identity proof and other required documents.
  • Medical Examination: Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME), if required, to check fitness as per SSB medical standards for paramilitary service.
  • Final Merit List: Preparation of final merit list of candidates qualified in all stages, based on marks in written/technical tests and subject to qualifying PET, PST and medical standards.

  • Step 1: Visit the official SSB recruitment website – recruitment.ssb.gov.in or go to ssb.gov.in and open the recruitment/advertisement section.
  • Step 2: Find and click on the link for “SSB Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI) Recruitment 2026” and read the notification PDF carefully to check eligibility, age limit and other conditions.
  • Step 3: Click on the “Apply Online” / “New Registration” button and complete the registration using a valid mobile number and email ID.
  • Step 4: Login with your registration details and fill the SSB ASI application form 2026 with correct personal information, communication details and category details as per your matriculation certificate.
  • Step 5: Enter post wise educational qualification, diploma, experience details for Radiographer / Pharmacist / OT Technician / Dental Technician as applicable.
  • Step 6: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport size photograph, signature and required documents in the prescribed format and size mentioned in the SSB ASI notification 2026.
  • Step 7: Pay the SSB ASI application fee 2026 online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI (fee exempted categories need not pay).

NaBFID Senior Analyst Eligibility Criteria 2026

Age Limit (as on 28.02.2026)

Minimum age: 21 years | Maximum age: 40 years. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.03.1986 and not later than 28.02.2005.

Educational Qualification & Experience

All qualifications must be regular full-time from a Government-recognised University/Institution and results must have been declared on or before 28.02.2026. A minimum of 4 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant function is mandatory for all positions.

Stream Educational Qualification Experience Required
Legal LLB from recognised university (Masters in Law desirable) 4 years; preferred in corporate/project finance law
Risk Management PG/MBA (Finance/Banking) / ICWA / CFA / CA (FRM desirable) 4 years in corporate credit appraisals / risk management
Internal Audit PG/MBA (Finance) / CA / ICWA (CIA / IIBF certification desirable) 4 years in Banking/FI Audit
IS Audit BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA in CS/Cybersecurity/IT (CISA/CISSP desirable) 4 years in IS/IT Audit; RBI-regulated entity preferred
Administration PG in Commerce/Accounts 4 years in accounts dept. with vendor invoicing/GST exposure
Human Resources PG/MBA in HR/IR/Personnel Management 4 years in HR functions in financial/corporate sector
Company Secretariat Company Secretary (ICSI member) 4 years as CS in listed companies
Vigilance PG/MBA / CA / ICWA / CFA 4 years in financial sector; 2 years in Vigilance/Compliance
Lending Operations PG/MBA (Finance) / ICWA / CFA / CMA / CA 4 years; 2 years in corporate credit appraisals/operations
Investment & Treasury PG/MBA (Finance/Forex) / ICWA / CA / CFA (Treasury/Forex cert. desirable) 4 years; 2 years in treasury/investment/forex
IT – Business Analyst BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech (CS/IT/AI) with PMP/BPM/Agile cert. or MBA with CS graduation 4 years in IT Project Management/Business Analyst in BFSI
IT – Cloud Infrastructure BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech with AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle cloud certification 4 years managing cloud infrastructure
Compliance MBA (Finance) / CA / ICWA / PG (Finance) 4 years; 2 years in Audit/Compliance in RBI-regulated entity
Corporate Strategy (Contract) CA / PG (Economics) / MBA (Finance/Strategy/Sustainability) 4 years in financial sector/consultancy; strategy experience preferred

NaBFID Senior Analyst Salary 2026

For Regular Basis positions, the annual fixed compensation for Senior Analyst grade is approximately ₹24.81 lakh. In addition, variable pay (performance bonus) of up to 20% on fixed compensation may be paid based on performance, as decided by the Bank from time to time. Compensation may be revised at suitable intervals as approved by the Board. Group Insurance (Medical, Accidental & Term Life) will be provided over and above the compensation.

For Contract Basis positions, remuneration will be offered based on qualification, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. The Fixed Term engagement will be for a minimum of 5 years, which may be renewed at NaBFID's discretion.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Selection Process 2026

The selection process differs for Regular and Contract basis appointments as follows.

Regular Basis: The selection process comprises an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview. If fewer applications are received for any stream, the Bank may change the process to Shortlisting-cum-Interview. The online exam consists of 50 objective-type questions (Professional Knowledge) carrying 100 marks to be completed in 60 minutes. There is a negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% for UR/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates. Final selection is based on Online Exam (70% weightage) and Interview (30% weightage).

Contract Basis: The selection process is Shortlisting-cum-Interview. If a large number of applications are received, the Bank may conduct an Online Exam. A Psychometric Test and Group Discussion may also be conducted as additional assessment tools. Interviews will be held at Mumbai only.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Application Fee 2026

Category Application Fee
General / EWS / OBC ₹800 + applicable taxes
SC / ST / PwBD ₹100 + applicable taxes (Intimation charges only)

Fee is non-refundable. Payment can be made through Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Mobile Wallets, or UPI. Bank transaction charges and GST are to be borne by the candidate.

Important Instructions

  • The application process is complete only when the application fee is successfully deposited online on or before 08.04.2026.
  • All candidates must ensure they fulfil the eligibility criteria as on the cut-off date 28.02.2026 before applying.
  • Candidates must upload all required documents - Brief Resume, ID Proof, Age Proof, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates, and Caste/EWS/PwBD Certificate (if applicable) - in PDF format, failing which the candidature will not be considered.
  • No candidate is permitted to apply for more than one position. If multiple applications are submitted, only the latest valid registration (higher registration number) will be retained and fees paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check https://nabfid.org/careers for updates. No separate intimation will be issued for any change or update - all corrigenda will be hosted only on the Bank's website.
  • Call letters for examination and interviews will be available only on the Bank's website. All communications will be sent by email only - no hard copy will be dispatched.
  • Interviews for both Regular and Contract positions will be held at Mumbai only.
  • Candidates called for Interview will be reimbursed actual travel expenses up to a maximum of IInd AC rail fare of mail express train, upon submission of to & fro tickets.
  • Selected candidates may be posted at Mumbai, New Delhi, or anywhere in India as per the Bank's discretion. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Candidates serving in Govt./Quasi-Govt./PSU/Nationalised Banks/Financial Institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview.
  • All educational qualifications must be regular full-time. MBA/PG Diploma must be 2-year full-time; MCA must be 3-year full-time (or 2-year full-time if admitted on or after 2020-21 as per UGC guidelines).
  • The offer to join NaBFID is subject to verification of original documents at any stage after qualifying the exam/shortlisting/interview/date of joining.
  • If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage - even after appointment - the candidature/services will be cancelled/terminated without notice.
  • Candidates must carry original photo identity proof (PAN Card/Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/Aadhar etc.) along with a photocopy at the time of examination/interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid identity proofs.
  • The handwritten declaration must be written in the candidate's own handwriting in English only on white paper with black ink; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification. No correspondence will be entertained by any ineligible or non-selected candidate.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai. Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • No change in category of any candidate is permitted after registration of online application.

How to Apply for NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026 from 18.03.2026 to 08.04.2026 by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official NaBFID website at https://nabfid.org/careers and click on the "APPLY ONLINE" link for the relevant advertisement (Regular or Contract).
  2. Click on "Click here for New Registration", enter your Name, Contact details and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and sent to your registered email/mobile.
  3. Fill in all personal, educational and professional details in the online application form. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save your progress. No changes are permitted after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION".
  4. Upload scanned copies of your Photograph (4.5cm×3.5cm, 20–50 KB), Signature (10–20 KB), Left Thumb Impression (20–50 KB), Handwritten Declaration (50–100 KB), and all required documents in PDF format (max 500 KB each).
  5. Also capture a live photograph using webcam or mobile QR scan as required by the application system.
  6. Proceed to the payment tab and pay the application fee online through the available digital payment methods.
  7. Submit the form and download the e-Receipt and a printout of the completed application for future reference.

IIFCL Grade A & Grade B Eligibility Criteria 2026

For both IIFCL Assistant Manager (Grade A) and IIFCL Manager (Grade B) posts, candidates must be citizens of India and meet the age, educational qualification and post‑qualification experience as on 28 February 2026.

Age Limit

  • Assistant Manager (Grade A): 21 to 30 years as on 28 February 2026 (candidate must have attained 21 years and must not have attained 30 years).
  • Manager (Grade B): Upper age limit 40 years as on 28 February 2026 (candidate must not have attained 40 years).
  • Relaxations in upper age limit for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, PwBD, Ex‑Servicemen and children/family members of 1984 riots victims are applicable as per Government of India rules.

Educational Qualification & Experience (Common pattern)

  • Generalist Streams (Grade A & Grade B): Postgraduate degree/diploma in any discipline or professional qualifications such as LLB/BA+LLB, Chartered Accountant (CA), Company Secretary (CS), CMA/ICWA, B.Tech/B.E. with required post‑qualification officer‑cadre experience in Banks/Financial Institutions/PSUs/government or reputed organisations.
  • Environment & Social Safeguard Streams: Engineering or Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in Environmental Management, Environmental Sciences, M.Sc. or Post‑Graduation in Social Work, Sociology, Anthropology, Economics Development Services etc. with specified post‑qualification experience in environment and social impact assessment and safeguards.
  • Experience requirement: At least 2 years’ officer‑cadre experience for Grade A; overall 7 years officer/executive experience (including minimum 2 years in relevant areas) for Grade B or equivalent grade in another FI/Bank/PSU.
  • Candidates must have degrees from recognised universities/institutions (UGC/AICTE/Government approved) and possess strong communication, analytical, drafting and computer/IT skills.

IIFCL Grade A & Grade B Selection Process 2026

The IIFCL Grade A & Grade B Selection Process 2026 is identical for both posts and consists of two phases – an online examination followed by a technical and behavioural interview.

  • Phase I – Online Examination: Objective type, 200 marks, with two tests – Test I (Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, Current Affairs related to Financial Sector – 100 marks) and Test II (Domain Knowledge – 100 marks). Total 150 questions, 120 minutes with sectional time limits, and negative marking of 1/4th of the marks for each wrong answer.
  • Phase II – Interview: Candidates shortlisted based on Phase I performance will be called for an interview of 100 marks, which may be conducted in Hindi or English at IIFCL’s office in New Delhi.
  • Final Merit List: Prepared by combining marks of Online Examination (Phase I) and Interview (Phase II) with a weightage of 40:60 respectively; candidates must qualify both stages and rank sufficiently high in merit to be selected.
  • IIFCL may additionally conduct Group Discussion, psychometric tests or other assessment tools, and reserves the right to change the selection procedure or exam structure as notified on its website.

Application Fees

For IIFCL Assistant Manager & Manager Recruitment 2026, the application fee structure is the same for both Grade A and Grade B posts.

  • For UR / OBC / EWS & other categories: ₹600 total (₹500 examination fee + ₹100 intimation charges).

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

  • 1.6 Km Run

  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Data Centre) – RG/10/26: Installing, configuring, tuning, and monitoring Windows Server and Linux servers; IIS, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V configuration; Windows-based scripting for task automation; Remote server administration; VMware vSphere (ESXi and vCenter) and Hyper-V; SAN, backup and storage; batch scripts; infrastructure capacity and performance analysis; regular system maintenance, hardware/software upgrades, physical to virtual migrations; VMware ESXi and Hyper-V virtual machine management; enterprise backup software; hardware and software troubleshooting; rack cabling (power, Cat-6, fiber); power, space, and cooling management; monitoring of network devices, precision air-conditioners, UPS, and Building Management System (BMS) in Data Centre.

RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted in three stages:

Stage 1 – Written Test (60% Weightage): There will be 125 objective type questions carrying 1 mark each for a duration of 2.5 hours. There is no negative marking. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for UR/EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). PwBD candidates are eligible for compensatory time of 50 minutes. The written test will be conducted at 6 cities across India: Delhi/Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Mumbai, Bhubaneswar, and Guwahati (all centres except Delhi/Gurgaon are tentative). Candidates must give two centre preferences at the time of online application.

Stage 2 – Document Scrutiny: Based on written test results, documents submitted by shortlisted candidates will be scrutinized by RITES Limited. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview preceded by verification of original documents.

Stage 3 – Interview (40% Weightage): Candidates will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies. Weightage: Technical & Professional Proficiency – 30 marks; Personality, Communication & Competency – 10 marks. Minimum qualifying marks in interview: 60% for UR/EWS (50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). There are no minimum qualifying marks required in the aggregate. Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to medical fitness examination as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness.

RG/09/26 (IT/Programming): Programming Fundamentals and OOP Concepts; Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC); Relational Database Management Systems (SQL, ACID properties); Problem Solving and Logical Programming; SAP S/4HANA, ABAP and FIORI; Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

RG/10/26 (IT/Data Centre): Server Installation, Configuration and Administration; Windows Server Services and Automation; Virtualization Technologies (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V); Storage, Backup and Disaster Recovery; Infrastructure Monitoring, Maintenance and Performance Management; Data Centre Infrastructure and Hardware Management; Data Centre Facility Systems Monitoring (BMS, UPS, precision AC); Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Customer Service Officer (Field Officer):

  • The CSO’s primary job role is addition of customer and increasing sustainable portfolio for the branch. CSO is to identify new business locations, sourcing and addition of potential customers. Post disbursement he/she has to collect the instalments on scheduled dates from the customers.
  • Qualification: Minimum qualification – PUC/10+2 completed.
  • Experience: Fresher’s are eligible to apply
  • Valid driving license and ownership of a two wheeler is mandatory.
  • Candidates must be fluent in the local language.

Branch Head:

  • The Branch Head would be responsible for business development, operations management, training, staff management for his branch. He would be reporting to the Cluster Head and Regional Manager and would have a team of CSE's and CSO's and MIS-officer reporting to him. In addition to this, he will also be responsible for providing compliance towards audit observations in his branch.
  • 3 years’ and above of work experience in microfinance institution.
  • Knowledge of local language and willingness to travel extensively is mandatory.

 Age Limit

  • Maximum Age limit for Branch Head: 37 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 – Job Role

Customer Service Officer (Field Officer): The CSO's primary responsibility is the addition of customers and growing a sustainable portfolio for the branch. The CSO must identify new business locations, source and add potential customers. Post-disbursement, the CSO is responsible for collecting instalments on scheduled dates from customers.

Branch Head: The Branch Head is responsible for business development, operations management, training, and staff management for the branch. The Branch Head reports to the Cluster Head and Regional Manager, with a team of CSEs, CSOs, and an MIS Officer reporting to them. The Branch Head is also responsible for ensuring compliance with audit observations at the branch level.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Written Test followed by Document Scrutiny.

  • Written Test: 125 objective type questions carrying 1 mark each (total 125 marks). Duration: 2.5 Hours. No negative marking.
  • PwBD candidates will be given compensatory time of 50 minutes.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 50% for UR/EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts).
  • Weightage: 100% for Written Test.
  • Document Scrutiny: After declaration of Written Test result, only the documents uploaded by candidates during online application will be scrutinized by RITES Ltd.
  • Candidates must upload all required documents at the time of online application. No additional documents will be accepted later.
  • Final selection is subject to verification of original documents, medical fitness, and fulfillment of all eligibility criteria.
  • Offer of appointment is purely on contract basis (initially 1 year, extendable subject to performance and project requirement).
  • Posting can be anywhere in India (including North-Eastern region) as per company requirement.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Only Online through RITES website

  • Visit the Career Section on http://www.rites.com and register.
  • Fill the online application form carefully and note down the generated Registration No.
  • Upload all required documents (listed below) in the “Upload Document” section.
  • Make online payment of application fee in the “Make Payment” section.
  • Download and keep a printout/soft copy of the final submitted application for future reference.
  • Candidates must carry the printed application and original documents at the time of selection (if called).

Documents to be Uploaded (mandatory):

  • High School certificate (Date of Birth proof)
  • All academic certificates & mark sheets (10th, 12th, Diploma/Degree)
  • Percentage conversion certificate (if applicable)
  • Experience certificates (in single PDF, chronological order with offer letter, relieving letter, salary slips etc.)
  • Category certificate (EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD) in prescribed format
  • Proof of Identity & Address (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID etc.)
  • Any other supporting document claimed in the application

General Instructions

  • Management reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify the recruitment process at any stage without notice.
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease.
  • Departmental candidates and candidates working in Govt./PSU must be properly relieved before joining.
  • Age, experience and all eligibility criteria are reckoned as on 27-04-2026.
  • Candidates must satisfy themselves about their eligibility before applying.
  • Any false information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage.
  • Corrigendum/Addendum, if any, will be published only on www.rites.com.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.
  • Legal jurisdiction in case of any dispute will be Delhi only.
  • All communications will be sent to the registered email ID only. Candidates must regularly check the RITES website.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee selection.

    • General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs - 10 questions
    • Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric Standard - 25 questions

    • General category candidates: 45% marks (petGEN-UR)
    • Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Other Backward Classes candidates: 40% marks

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Supervisor (Assay/T.O.-Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy): Candidates must possess a 1st class full-time Diploma in Engineering in the relevant stream (Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy) from a recognized institution, or higher qualification i.e. B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. (Engineering) in the relevant discipline.
  • Engraver (Sculpture/Metal Works): Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts (Sculpture or Metal Works) with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution.
  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 25 years for Jr. Technician posts, 28 years for B-3/B-4 level posts, and 30 years for Supervisor posts, as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10–15 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on regular posts with pay scales as per the company's pay structure along with applicable allowances.
  • Pay Scale Details: Supervisor posts carry Level S-1 pay matrix ₹27,600–95,910; Engraver and Jr. Office/Bullion Assistant/Lab Assistant posts carry Level B-3 ₹21,540–77,160 or Level B-4 ₹23,910–85,570; and Junior Technician posts carry Level W-1 ₹18,780–67,390. Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).
  • SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee but are required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹200/- towards service expenses.
  • Payment can be made online through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The online application process for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 will start from 28th March 2026 and the last date to submit the IGM online application form is 27th April 2026. Candidates must visit the official website igmnoida.spmcil.com, open the career page and complete their IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form within the given dates.

While filling the India Government Mint application form 2026, candidates should register with a valid email ID and mobile number, enter personal and educational details, upload scanned documents, pay the examination fee (if applicable) and finally submit and download the IGM online form for future reference.

How to Apply for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for the India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 must submit their application forms through the online mode only within the specified dates. Follow the step-by-step process given below to fill the IGM online application form correctly.

  • Eligible candidates for IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the company's official website within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to http://igmnoida.spmcil.com, click on "Discover SPMCIL" and navigate to the CAREERS page to find the IGM Recruitment 2026 link.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create login credentials, and proceed to the IGM online application form 2026.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form: Enter personal details, address, educational qualifications, category, unit preference (Mumbai/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Noida), and post applied for carefully, ensuring all data matches your original certificates.

  • Step 5 – Pay Fee & Submit: Complete the online fee payment (where applicable) through Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. PGT (History/Geography/Political Science/Economics): Two years integrated PG MA course of NCERT in the relevant subject; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% in the relevant subject; AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Commerce): Two years integrated PG MA course of NCERT in Master's Degree in Commerce; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% in Commerce (Note: M.Com in Applied/Business Economics holders are not eligible); AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Computer): At least 50% marks in any of: B.E./B.Tech (CS/IT) plus PG Diploma in Computer Applications or B/C Level Diploma from DOEACC with 1 year teaching experience; OR M.Sc. (Computer Science)/MCA plus 1 year teaching experience; OR Master of Engineering/M.Tech (Computer Science/IT).

TGT (Arts/Language-English): Graduation in English and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation or Post-Graduation in English and B.Ed.; OR Graduation in English with 45% marks and 1-year B.Ed. as per NCTE norms; OR Senior Secondary with 50% and 4-year B.El.Ed.; OR Senior Secondary with 50% and 4-year B.A./B.Sc.Ed. or B.A.Ed./B.Sc.Ed.; OR Graduation in English with 50% and 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education); OR Post-Graduation in English with 55% marks and three-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

TGT (Arts/Language-Bengali): Same pattern as TGT English above but in Bengali subject.

TGT (SST): Graduation in History, Geography, Political Science, Economics and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation/Post-Graduation in the relevant subjects and B.Ed.; OR with 45% marks and 1-year B.Ed. as per NCTE norms; OR other equivalent combinations as per RBE norms; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

TGT (Phy. Chem. Bio): Graduation in Physics, Chemistry, Biology and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation/Post-Graduation in the relevant subjects and B.Ed.; OR other equivalent combinations as per RBE norms; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

TGT (Phy. Chem. Maths): Graduation in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation/Post-Graduation in the relevant subjects and B.Ed.; OR other equivalent combinations as per RBE norms; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

TGT (Hindi): Graduation in Hindi and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation or Post-Graduation in Hindi and B.Ed.; OR other equivalent combinations as per RBE norms; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

Physical Instructor: Graduate with Bachelor's in Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) or equivalent; AND competency in imparting Physical Education in English/Hindi medium.

CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 Remuneration

Selected candidates under CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 will receive the following consolidated monthly remuneration on a contractual and part-time basis. No additional allowances, benefits, or facilities shall be admissible.

Post Monthly Remuneration
Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) – All Subjects Rs.27,500/- per month
Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – All Subjects Rs.26,250/- per month
Physical Instructor Rs.26,250/- per month

Payment will be made on a monthly basis. No payment will be made during school vacations. Pro-rata payment will apply for broken months and periods of less than one month (Consolidated Pay × Number of days worked / 30 days).

CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

As per the CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates appearing in the Walk-in-Interview.

CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The CLW Chittaranjan Contractual Teacher Recruitment 2026 selection will be through a Walk-in-Interview process.

Walk-in-Interview: Candidates must report between 09:30 Hrs and 13:30 Hrs on the scheduled date at Hindi Library/GM Office Building, CLW/Chittaranjan, Distt: Paschim Bardhaman, WB-713331. If candidate turnout is high, interviews may continue on the next working day.

Medical Examination: Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination (CEE-TWO, C-2). Candidates not meeting the required medical standard will have their candidature cancelled.

Document Verification: Candidates must carry original documents along with self-attested xerox copies at the time of the Walk-in-Interview. Character and Antecedent certificates from two Gazetted Officers must be produced at the time of entering into contract.

Documents Required for CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026

Candidates must bring original documents and self-attested xerox copies of the following at the Walk-in-Interview: Date of Birth proof, valid caste/PwBD certificate (if applicable) issued by Central Govt., educational and technical qualification certificates, experience certificate (if any), identity proof (Aadhaar card/PAN card/Passport/Voter ID/Driving License etc.), NOC from employer (if employed), and two recent passport-size coloured photographs with white background.

How to Apply for CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates for CLW Chittaranjan Contractual Teacher Recruitment 2026 must appear for the Walk-in-Interview on the scheduled date for their respective post.

Step 1 – Read Official Notification: Visit the official CLW website at clw.indianrailways.gov.in and carefully read the complete notification to verify your eligibility for the post applied for.

Step 2 – Fill Application Form: Download the application form from the official notification (enclosed with the notification). Fill in all required details including post applied for, personal details, educational qualifications, teaching experience, medium of instruction, and community details carefully.

Step 3 – Affix Photograph: Affix a recent passport-size coloured photograph with white background, duly attested, in the space provided on the application form.

Step 4 – Prepare Documents: Arrange original documents and self-attested xerox copies of all required certificates including Date of Birth proof, caste certificate, educational qualifications, experience certificates, identity proof, NOC (if employed), and two passport-size photos.

Step 5 – Appear for Walk-in-Interview: Report at Hindi Library/GM Office Building, CLW/Chittaranjan, Distt: Paschim Bardhaman, WB-713331 between 09:30 Hrs and 13:30 Hrs on the scheduled date for your post. Ensure hands are clean for biometric/identity verification. Keep a copy of the filled application form for future reference.

SDSUV Application Form 2026

The online application process for Sri Dev Suman Uttarakhand University Professor Recruitment 2026 has started on 11th March 2026 and the last date to submit the SDSUV Professor application form online is 10th April 2026 (05:00 PM). Candidates must visit the official Samarth recruitment portal sdsuvrec.samarth.edu.in via the university website sdsuv.ac.in and complete their SDSUV Application Form 2026 within the stipulated time.

Click to Apply for SDSUV Professor, Assistant Librarian and More Recruitment 2026

SDSUV Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Candidates applying for Sri Dev Suman Uttarakhand University Professor, Assistant Librarian and More Recruitment 2026 must meet the minimum eligibility criteria prescribed in UGC Regulations 2018 regarding academic qualifications, research output and teaching/research experience.
  • Educational Qualification: Applicants must be eminent scholars with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline and a strong research record, including a minimum number of research publications in peer‑reviewed or UGC‑CARE listed journals and a prescribed research score as per UGC norms for Professors.
  • Experience Requirement: Candidates should have at least 10 years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor and/or equivalent research experience at recognized national‑level institutions, with evidence of successfully guiding doctoral candidates, or be outstanding professionals with a Ph.D. and significant contribution to the discipline with at least 10 years’ experience.

SDSUV Salary 2026

  • Assistant Professor: Pay Scale: Rs. 57,700.00 - 1,82,400.00
  • Assistant Librarian: Pay Scale: Rs. 57,700.00 - 1,82,400.00
  • Associate Professor: Pay Scale: Rs.1,31,400.00 to 2,17,100.00
  • Professor: Pay Scale: Rs. 1,44,200.00 to 2,18,200.00

SDSUV Application Fees 2026

Candidates applying online for Sri Dev Suman Uttarakhand University Professor, Assistant Librarian and More Recruitment 2026 must pay a non‑refundable application fee according to their category through the online payment facility on the recruitment portal.

For Professor & Associate Professor

  • Fee for UR/OBC/EWS: Applicants belonging to Unreserved (UR), OBC and EWS categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 2000/- for each Professor post they apply for.
  • Fee for SC/ST: Candidates from SC/ST categories must pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/-. Applicants who have already paid the fee for the same category and same post against the university’s previous Professor advertisement may apply again without paying the fee, provided they enclose valid proof of earlier payment.

For Assistant Professor & Assistant Librarian

  • Fee for UR/OBC/EWS: Applicants belonging to Unreserved (UR), OBC and EWS categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/- for each Professor post they apply for.
  • Fee for SC/ST: Candidates from SC/ST categories must pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-. Applicants who have already paid the fee for the same category and same post against the university’s previous Professor advertisement may apply again without paying the fee, provided they enclose valid proof of earlier payment.

SDSUV Selection Process 2026

  • The SDSUV Professor, Assistant Librarian and More Recruitment 2026 selection process will follow UGC Regulations and university screening guidelines based on academic and research credentials, followed by interview.
  • Screening & Shortlisting: Applications will be screened using the UGC‑prescribed Academic/Research Score system, considering research publications, projects, Ph.D. guidance, invited lectures and other scholarly activities to prepare a merit‑ordered shortlist of candidates for interview.
  • Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview before the duly constituted selection committee, where their teaching, research contributions and suitability for the Professor, Assistant Librarian and More post in the concerned subject will be assessed. Final selection will be based on the interview performance and overall academic/research profile.

How to Apply for SDSUV Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates who satisfy the eligibility norms for Sri Dev Suman Uttarakhand University Professor, Assistant Librarian and More Recruitment 2026 must complete both online and offline steps of the application process.
  • Step 1 – Online Registration: Visit the university website www.sdsuv.ac.in, open the recruitment section and click on the Samarth recruitment link sdsuvrec.samarth.edu.in. Register yourself by providing basic details and create a login for the SDSUV Professor, Assistant Librarian and More online application 2026.
  • Step 2 – Fill Online Application Form: Log in and fill the Professor, Assistant Librarian and More application form with accurate personal information, academic qualifications, teaching and research experience, publication details and other required data. Upload all supporting documents such as degrees, marksheets, experience certificates and publication proofs in the prescribed format.
  • Step 3 – Pay Application Fee: Pay the applicable SDSUV Professor, Assistant Librarian and More application fee 2026 (UR/OBC/EWS: Rs. 2000, SC/ST: Rs. 1000) via the integrated online payment gateway. Ensure that the transaction is successful and keep a copy of the payment receipt for your records.
  • Step 4 – Submit and Print Application: After verifying all entries and successful fee payment, submit the online form. Download and print the duly filled online application and attach self‑attested photocopies of all uploaded documents as per the checklist.
  • Step 5 – Send Hard Copy to University: Place the printed application and documents in an envelope, clearly superscribing Advertisement No., date, post name and subject, and send it by Registered/Speed Post, Courier or by hand to the Registrar, Sri Dev Suman Uttarakhand Vishwavidyalaya, Badshahithaul, Tehri Garhwal – 249199 so that it reaches on or before 24th April 2026, 05:00 PM.

Tumakuru Pourakarmika Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the eligibility criteria regarding nationality, age limit, service conditions and language before submitting the application form at the respective Urban Local Body (ULB) offices.

Nationality: The applicant must be an Indian citizen to be eligible for Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026 in Tumakuru City Corporation, Tiptur City Municipal Council and Sira City Municipal Council.

Age Limit: As per the public notification, candidates must have completed a minimum age of 18 years and should not have crossed a maximum age of 50 years as on the date of publication of the Tumakuru Pourakarmika notification. The date of birth recorded in Aadhaar card, voter ID, ESI/PF records or other accepted documents will be considered for verifying age.

Experience as Pourakarmika / Sanitation Worker: Applicants must be currently working in the concerned local body on outsourced, daily wage or contract basis for at least one year as Pourakarmika, loader, UGD helper, cleaner, helper, waste processing unit worker, public toilet sanitation worker or zero‑waste management unit sanitation worker with ESI and PF benefits to be eligible for Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026.

Family members of deceased Pourakarmikas: Candidates who are family members of Pourakarmikas that died while working on outsourced/daily wage/contract basis due to Covid‑19 or other reasons in the concerned ULB may also be considered eligible for Tumakuru Pourakarmika posts, subject to production of proper proof and certification from the competent authority.

Manual Scavenger Victims: Persons identified as victims under the Manual Scavengers Act or their family members, duly certified by the competent authority, are also eligible to apply for Pourakarmika posts under this Tumakuru Recruitment 2026 drive.

Knowledge of Kannada: Candidates must have the ability to speak Kannada and basic knowledge of Kannada language for effective discharge of duties as Pourakarmika in Tumakuru district urban local bodies. A self‑declaration regarding knowledge of Kannada has to be enclosed with the application form.

Clean Service Record: Applicants should not be involved in any criminal case and should not have been dismissed or removed from service due to disciplinary action in any previous employment. Candidates must meet all conduct and character requirements as laid down in the Tumakuru Pourakarmika notification 2026.

Tumakuru Pourakarmika Salary 2026

Candidates selected through the Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026 will be appointed as Pourakarmikas under the direct payment system in Tumakuru City Corporation, Tiptur City Municipal Council and Sira City Municipal Council.

Salary under Direct Payment System: Selected Pourakarmikas will receive monthly wages directly from the concerned Urban Local Body as per the Government of Karnataka norms and prevailing minimum wage rates for civic sanitation workers. Detailed pay and allowances will be governed by applicable government orders and Poura Seva Vrunda & Recruitment Rules.

Service Benefits: As direct payment Pourakarmikas, workers will continue to be covered under ESI and PF and other welfare schemes notified by the State Government for civic workers from time to time. However, this recruitment does not automatically grant them regular government employee status unless specifically regularised by separate government orders.

Tumakuru Pourakarmika Application Fees 2026

The official Tumakuru Pourakarmika Direct Payment Recruitment 2026 notification primarily focuses on eligibility, experience and procedure for submission of application forms through the respective ULB offices.

ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the post wise eligibility criteria for Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’, Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ and Medical Officer ‘SC’ before filling the online application form.

Nationality: The applicant must be a citizen of India to be eligible for ISRO URSC Scientist/Engineer and Medical Officer posts under Advertisement No. URSC:01:2026.

Age Limit (as on 12.04.2026): For Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’, the maximum age limit is 28 years, while for Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ and Medical Officer ‘SC’, the upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxations in the upper age limit for SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, Ex‑servicemen and departmental candidates as per Government of India rules.

Educational Qualification – Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech or equivalent degree in Industrial Production, Industrial Engineering, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering & Management, Production Engineering or allied branches with a minimum of 65% aggregate marks (average of all semesters) or at least 6.84 CGPA on a 10‑point scale from a recognized university or institution.

Educational Qualification – Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’: Applicants should have a Ph.D. in Thin Films, Material Science, Applied Optics or Metallurgy along with mandatory pre‑eligibility qualifications such as M.Sc. in Physics/Material Science or M.Tech in Material Science/Metallurgical Engineering/Applied Optics, and B.E./B.Tech in relevant physical streams/Metallurgical Engineering/Material Science or B.Sc in Physics/Chemistry/Material Science, with at least 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA at the M.Sc./M.Tech and B.Sc levels and prescribed minimum marks/CGPA in B.E./B.Tech as per the notification.

Educational Qualification – Medical Officer ‘SC’: Candidates must have an MBBS degree with compulsory rotatory internship, passed with at least second class, recognized by the National Medical Commission (previously Medical Council of India), along with 2 years of post‑registration experience in clinical practice and a valid registration with the National Medical Commission or State Medical Council.

Minimum Marks & Course Duration: The essential qualifications at graduation and post‑graduation level must be completed within the stipulated duration of the course as prescribed by the university, and where both percentage and CGPA are mentioned, at least one of them must meet the minimum marks criteria prescribed for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026.

Medical Fitness & Other Conditions: Selected candidates must be medically fit as per ISRO norms and should satisfy all other conditions mentioned in the URSC Scientist Engineer and Medical Officer notification, including good character, clean disciplinary record and submission of all required certificates in original during document verification.

ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Salary 2026
