Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ Salary: Selected Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ at URSC will be placed in Pay Level 10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) with an initial basic pay of Rs. 56,100 per month plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance/leased accommodation, Transport benefits and other ISRO‑specific perks.

Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ Salary: Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ will be appointed in Pay Level 11 (Rs. 67,100 – 2,08,700) with an approximate starting basic pay of Rs. 67,700 per month plus admissible allowances as per Government of India rules.

Medical Officer ‘SC’ Salary: Medical Officer ‘SC’ will also be in Pay Level 10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) with basic pay of Rs. 56,100 per month along with allowances and an additional Non‑Practicing Allowance (NPA) @ 20% of basic pay as per medical cadre norms.

Other Benefits: ISRO URSC employees are covered under National Pension System/Unified Pension Scheme and are eligible for benefits like LTC, Group Insurance, medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidised canteen, transport facility/transport allowance and housing benefits as per ISRO/DoS policies.

ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Application Fees 2026

Applicants for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 (Post Codes 01 & 03) are required to pay a partially refundable processing fee as specified in the advertisement.

Processing Fee: All candidates applying for Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 01) and Medical Officer ‘SC’ (Post Code 03) must initially pay Rs. 750/- per application as processing fee through the prescribed online payment gateway.

Application Fee Component: Out of the above amount, Rs. 250/- is treated as non‑refundable application fee for these posts, and the remaining portion of the processing fee is eligible for refund as per the category‑wise conditions mentioned in the notification.

Refund Rules: Women candidates, SC/ST candidates, PwBD and Ex‑servicemen who appear in the written test/interview are generally eligible for full refund of Rs. 750/-, while other candidates who appear in the written test/interview are eligible for partial refund (typically Rs. 500/-), subject to validity of their application and actual attendance.

No Fee for Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’: For Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Code 02), there is normally no application fee; candidates only need to register and apply through the ISRO Live Register portal.

ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Selection Process 2026

The ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 selection process differs slightly for each post, combining written examination, shortlisting and interview as per the post code.

Selection – Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 01): Eligible applications are first screened based on academic performance and other criteria; shortlisted candidates are called for a Written Test at Bengaluru, and those who qualify in the written test will be further shortlisted for a personal interview, with final merit prepared on overall performance.

Selection – Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Code 02): Candidates register on the ISRO Live Register portal; an initial screening is carried out using qualifications, research profile and other parameters, and shortlisted candidates are called directly for interview, where the final selection is made based on interview performance.

Selection – Medical Officer ‘SC’ (Post Code 03): For Medical Officer posts, applications are screened on the basis of MBBS qualification, registration and experience; shortlisted candidates are invited for interview, and selection is made purely on the basis of interview and verification of credentials.

Document Verification & Medical Fitness: At the time of interview/joining, candidates must produce all original certificates for verification and also satisfy the prescribed medical fitness standards of ISRO URSC.

How to Apply for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026

Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 only through the online mode within the specified dates; no offline applications will be accepted.

Step 1 – Visit Official Websites: Go to the official ISRO website (www.isro.gov.in) or URSC website (www.ursc.gov.in) and open the careers/recruitment page to find the link for “URSC:01:2026 – Recruitment of Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’, Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ & Medical Officer ‘SC’”.

Step 2 – Read Notification: Download and carefully read the ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Notification 2026 to understand eligibility, important dates, post‑wise qualifications, selection process, fee details and instructions for online application.

Step 3 – Online Registration (Post Code 01 & 03): For Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ and Medical Officer ‘SC’, click on the online registration link, enter basic personal details, contact information and create your login; candidates registered on the National Career Service (NCS) portal must still complete this registration process on the ISRO/URSC site.

Step 4 – Fill Online Application Form: Log in with your credentials and fill the ISRO URSC application form with accurate details of personal information, educational qualifications (with marks/CGPA), experience (for Medical Officer), category, PwBD status and communication details as per your certificates.

Step 5 – Upload Documents: Upload recent passport size colour photograph, signature and required certificates (educational mark sheets and degrees, NMC/State Medical Council registration, experience certificates, caste/ESWS/PwBD/Ex‑serviceman certificates, AIU equivalence for foreign degrees, etc.) in the prescribed file format and size.

Step 6 – Pay Application/Processing Fee: Pay the Rs. 750/- processing fee (where applicable) through the integrated online payment gateway using net banking, debit/credit card or UPI, and ensure that the transaction is successful; later verify the payment status using the “Payment Status” link provided on the site.

Step 7 – Submit and Print Application: After verifying all entries, submit the online form; note down the online registration number and take a printout or save a PDF copy of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference and for producing at the time of interview/document verification.

Step 8 – For Post Code 02 (Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’): Candidates must register and apply through the dedicated ISRO Live Register portal, update their academic and research details before the last date, and keep a copy of the generated registration for future reference.

General Instructions for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026

Candidates applying for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 must follow all general instructions given in the advertisement to ensure that their applications are accepted and considered for selection.

Accuracy of Information: Applicants are solely responsible for ensuring that they fulfil all eligibility criteria and that the details entered in the online form are correct; once the online application is finally submitted, it cannot be edited, so all information should be verified carefully before submission.

Multiple Applications: If any changes are needed after submission, candidates may submit a fresh application; in case of multiple applications, only the latest application for which fee is successfully paid will be treated as valid, and candidates should avoid unnecessary multiple submissions for the same post.

Email ID & Communication: A valid and active email ID must be provided, as all communication including call letters for written test/interview will be sent only by email, and no separate hard copy will be dispatched by post.

No Objection Certificate: Candidates employed in Central/State Government, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies must apply with prior intimation to their employer and must produce an original No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview; without NOC, they will not be allowed to appear and no TA will be paid.

Document Upload & Verification: Applications without uploading clear scanned copies of the required documents will be rejected; the uploaded documents will be verified at the time of interview, and mere receipt of call letter does not guarantee selection.

Fee Payment & Refund: Application/processing fee must be paid only through the authorised online payment gateway; ISRO/URSC will not be responsible for failed or pending transactions due to incorrect bank details, and refund of processing fee will be strictly as per rules only to eligible candidates.

Compliance with Rules: All appointments are subject to Government of India rules, verification of original documents, character & antecedent verification and medical fitness; ISRO also encourages women and transgender candidates to apply as part of its commitment to gender‑balanced workforce.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, ECE, ETC, EEE, E&I, CSE, IT, CSIT, Mechanical/Electrical with NDT Level‑II (for Kudankulam) along with a minimum of 3 years post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship in the relevant field up to 1 year is also counted as experience.
  • Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/ETC/EEE/E&I/CSE/IT and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship up to 1 year is countable towards experience.
  • Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C): Diploma with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in ECE/ETC/Electronics/EEE/Instrumentation and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience including relevant apprenticeship.
  • Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C): ITI passed in Electronics, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Instrumentation or Radio & TV trades with minimum 2 years post‑qualification experience (including up to 1 year apprenticeship) in maintenance/repair of electronics, instrumentation systems, communication gadgets or computers.
  • Age Limit (UR): Project Engineer – maximum 33 years; Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan – maximum 30 years. ECIL Recruitment 2026 Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 will receive consolidated monthly emoluments based on the post and contract year, along with limited benefits as per ECIL rules.
  • Consolidated Emoluments: Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there is no mention of any application or examination fee in the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

There is no online application process for ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026); candidates have to attend walk‑in selections as per the notified schedule. Eligible applicants must visit the official ECIL website ecil.co.in, download the prescribed ECIL contract application form 2026, fill it carefully and report at the concerned zonal walk‑in venue on the respective date within the registration time slot.

Candidates must carry the duly filled ECIL application form, updated resume, original certificates and one set of self‑attested photocopies for age, qualification, experience, category, disability, ex‑servicemen and identity proof along with recent passport size photographs. Registration and document verification will be done at the venue before the personal interview under ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026.

Click to Download ECIL Contract Application Form 2026

Download ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 07/2026)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 selection for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan will be based on walk‑in registration, document verification and personal interview with a weighted merit system.
  • Shortlisting & Evaluation: After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks.
  • Final Merit & Offer: Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.

How to Apply / Attend ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 07/2026) must appear personally at the designated zonal venues on the scheduled walk‑in dates with the prescribed application form and documents.

  • Step 1 – Download ECIL Application Form: Visit the official ECIL website www.ecil.co.in, open the Careers/Recruitment section and download the application form for Advt. No. 07/2026. Take a printout and fill it neatly with all required details including post category, zone and location preference.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Documents: Keep ready original and one set of self‑attested copies of 10th certificate (DOB proof), all qualification certificates and marksheets, CGPA‑to‑percentage conversion (if applicable), complete experience certificates with from‑to dates and post held, appointment order and recent payslips (if currently employed), caste (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) certificate, non‑creamy layer OBC certificate (not older than one year), PwBD certificate, Ex‑servicemen/ J&K domicile proof and valid government ID (Aadhaar/Passport etc.).
  • Step 3 – Reach Walk‑in Venue in Time: Report to the respective ECIL Zonal Office (Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru on 09 April 2026; Chennai on 18 April 2026) within the registration time 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs. Late reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Step 4 – Registration & Document Verification: Submit the filled ECIL application form 2026, resume and document set at the registration desk. After successful verification, candidates will be allowed to attend the personal interview as part of the selection process.
  • Step 5 – Attend Interview & Wait for Result: Appear for the interview as scheduled at the venue. Final selection will be based on the combined weightage of qualification, experience and interview performance. Shortlisted candidates will receive joining instructions from ECIL and must be prepared for posting at project locations anywhere in India.

Eligibility Criteria – FCRI Walk-In Interview 2026

1) Trainee Graduate Engineers (Level‑1 & Level‑2) – Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation

  • Educational Qualification​

    • Full‑time degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant discipline (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation / Electrical Sciences).

    • Degree must be from UGC/AICTE‑recognized Universities/Institutions.

    • Either 4‑year regular bachelor’s degree programme, or Engineering degree through lateral entry after full‑time Engineering Diploma in relevant discipline from recognized Polytechnic.

    • Minimum First Class with 60% or more aggregate in qualifying degree (and in diploma, if applicable).

  • Experience​

    • Level‑2:

      • Minimum 1 year experience in relevant areas as specified for each discipline (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Instrumentation/Electrical Sciences) – e.g. calibration/testing, construction & maintenance, O&M of substations, calibration of electro‑technical parameters, etc.

    • Level‑1:

      • Less than 1 year experience in relevant areas, including candidates with at least 2 months of relevant internship / practical exposure.

2) ITI/NCVT Trades (Level‑1 & Level‑2) – Machinist / Fitter / Welder / Plumber / Electrician / AC & Refrigeration

  • Educational Qualification​

    • ITI with NCVT in relevant trade: Machinist, Fitter, Welder, Plumber, Electrician, AC & Refrigeration.

    • Minimum 55% marks or more in ITI/NCVT.

  • Experience​

    • Level‑1:

      • Freshers or candidates with less than 1 year experience in relevant trade areas (shop floor, fabrication, installation/maintenance, troubleshooting, etc.).

    • Level‑2:

      • Minimum 1 year experience in relevant trade areas as described (workshop/machining, plumbing & piping systems, electrical fault rectification, AC & refrigeration systems, etc.).

No explicit upper age limit is mentioned in these walk‑in notifications; selection is primarily based on qualification, relevant experience and performance in the walk‑in interview / test.

How to Apply

Candidates must register as per 'ONE TIME REGISTRATION ' with the Official Website of Kerala Public Service Commission 'www.keralapsc.gov.in' before applying for the post. Candidates who have registered can apply by logging on to their profile using their User-ID and password. Candidates must click on the 'Apply Now' button of the respective posts in the Notification Link to apply for a post.

Candidates who create new Profile should upload their Photograph taken within a period of 6 months. Name of the candidate and the date of photograph taken should be printed legibly at the bottom portion. The photograph once uploaded meeting all requirements shall be valid for 10 years from the date of uploading. .

There is no change in other instructions regarding the uploading of photographs. No application fee is required. Candidates are responsible for the correctness of the personal information and secrecy of password. Before the final submission of the application on the profile candidates must ensure correctness of the information in their profile. They must quote the User-ID for further communication with the Commission. Application submitted is provisional and cannot be deleted or altered after submission. Candidates are advised to keep a printout or soft copy of the online application for future reference.

Candidates can take the printout of the application by clicking on the link 'My applications' in their profile. All correspondences with the Commission, regarding the application should be accompanied with the printout of the application. The application will be summarily rejected if noncompliance with the notification is found in due course of processing. Documents to prove qualification, age, Community etc. have to be produced as and when called for.

Candidates who have AADHAAR card should add AADHAAR Card as ID Proof in their profile.

Selection Process

  • The selection process will be conducted as per the rules and regulations of Travancore Titanium Products Ltd.
  • If a Written / OMR / Online Test is conducted as part of the selection, only candidates possessing the requisite qualifications will be allowed to appear.
  • Candidates will be advised from the Ranked List prepared in the order of merit.
  • The Ranked List will remain in force for a minimum period of one year and a maximum period of three years.
  • Kerala PSC reserves the right to cancel the advice for appointment of any candidate if any mistake is found later.
  • Final selection is subject to verification of original documents and medical fitness.

General Information/Instructions

  • Aadhaar Card must be added as ID proof in the profile.
  • Candidates must read and follow the General Conditions given in Part II of the Gazette Notification.
  • Rule 10 a (ii) of Part II KS & SSR is applicable.
  • Provisional hands working in the concern are eligible for age relaxation up to a maximum of 5 years (subject to conditions).
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • The selection is subject to the rules and regulations of Travancore Titanium Products Ltd.
  • Any false information or suppression of facts will lead to rejection of candidature at any stage.
  • For any clarification, refer to the official notification or contact Kerala PSC.

Selection Process

Selection will be made based on the Marks scored in NCTVT (NAC) and Trade Test / Practical Test only, in the order of Merit.

  • Priority & Preference Order:
    1. First Preference: AOCP Trade apprentices of Ordnance Factories and AOCP Trade apprentices from Government/Private Organizations having Government affiliation.
    2. Second Preference: Feeder trade candidates (IMCP, MMCP, PPO, Fitter, Machinist, Turner, etc.) who have experience of working as DBW/CPW on tenure basis and possess certificate of 03 months training (1 month extensive in-house training w.r.t. Safe Handling of explosives, ammunitions, safety norms, Do’s & Don’ts + 2 months On-Job training) from any MIL group of Ordnance Factories.
    3. Third Preference: Feeder trade candidates (IMCP, MMCP, PPO, Fitter, Machinist, Turner, etc.) from Ordnance Factories / Government/Private Organizations having Government affiliation but without 03 months training certificate.
  • Merit List Preparation:
    • Weightage: 80% NCTVT (NAC) Exam + 20% Trade Test / Practical Test.
    • Cut-off percentage for calling candidates for Trade Test will be decided by Ordnance Factory Khamaria based on NAC marks.
    • Merit list prepared category-wise / discipline-wise.
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in NCTVT (NAC) + Trade Test will be called for Document Verification in order of merit. Number of candidates called will be limited to the number of posts notified. Additional candidates will be called in case of rejections.
  • Tie Resolution (in this order):
    1. Ex-Trade Apprentice of AOCP Trade.
    2. Ex-Trade Apprentice of Ordnance Factories.
    3. Higher marks in NAC issued from NCVT.
    4. Date of Birth (elder candidate preferred).

Note: After selection, AOCP candidates (non-Ordance Factory apprentices) and all feeder trade candidates will undergo compulsory 1 month extensive in-house training (and additional 2 months On-Job training for feeder trades) on safe handling of explosives before deployment.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Offline only

Steps to Apply:

  1. Download the Application Form from the official website.
  2. Fill the application form in BLOCK LETTERS only.
  3. Affix one recent passport-size photograph (self-attested) on the form.
  4. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (see checklist in the notification).
  5. Put two extra photographs (self-attested on the back with Name & Date of Birth).
  6. Place the filled application and enclosures in an envelope superscribed as: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TENURE BASED DBW PERSONNEL ON CONTRACT BASIS”
  7. Send the application by post only to the address given below.

Address: The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Khamaria, District: Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh – 482005

General Instructions

  • Candidates must read the full notification carefully before applying.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee issue of call letter for Trade Test.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through e-mail for Trade Test / Practical Test.
  • Self-attested copies of all educational, NAC, caste, experience certificates etc. must be enclosed.
  • Submission of false / incorrect / incomplete information or bogus documents will lead to disqualification.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • No correspondence / enquiry through phone or messenger will be entertained.
  • Ordnance Factory Khamaria will not be responsible for any postal delay or non-receipt of application / call letters.
  • E-mail ID and mobile number must be kept active till completion of the entire recruitment process.
  • SC/ST candidates appearing for Document Verification will be paid 2nd class TA (on production of tickets & caste certificate). SC/ST candidates appearing for Trade Test will travel at their own expense.
  • The engagement is purely on contract basis initially for 1 year, extendable up to maximum 4 years based on requirement and performance.
  • This engagement does not confer any right for regular absorption in the factory.
  • Performance will be evaluated half-yearly / annually. Poor performance may lead to termination after 3 months’ notice period.
  • Personnel will be entitled to EPF, Bonus (if applicable), Risk Allowance, Night Duty Allowance (as per rules), 30 days leave per year, 1 Casual Leave per month etc.
  • They will not be entitled to OT Allowance, LTC, Medical facilities (except emergency), promotions, loans, school fee reimbursement, study leave etc.
  • The employment can be terminated by either party by giving one month’s notice or payment in lieu thereof.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of courts / tribunals in Jabalpur only.
  • The Competent Authority reserves the right to cancel / modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.

Eligibility Criteria

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.

  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 10-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

    • Ex-Servicemen: Age reduced by length of defence service; resultant age must not exceed upper age limit by more than 3 years.
    • Intercaste married couple (Anusuchit Jati-Savarna) under Promotion Scheme: 5 years.
    • Vikram Puraskar awardee sportspersons: 5 years.

Selection Process

  • Written Examination (OMR Based):
    • Objective type questions on OMR sheet will be conducted.
    • Negative Marking (Rnnatmak Mulyankan) is applicable.
    • Exam centres: Indore, Bhopal, Jabalpur and Gwalior.
    • Exam Plan and Syllabus will be published on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in in due course.
    • Candidates up to a maximum of three times the notified vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for interview based on written exam marks.
  • Interview (Viva Voce / Saakshaatkar):
    • Candidates shortlisted from the written examination will be called for interview.
    • Interview total marks: 100. Minimum qualifying marks for Unreserved category: 41; for Reserved categories and Divyangjan: 31.
    • Final selection will be based on the merit order of aggregate marks (written examination + interview).
    • Candidates absent from interview will be considered ineligible for selection.
  • If total applicants are less than 500: Selection will be based on interview only. Candidates will be shortlisted directly for interview as per the following ratio: 1 post – up to 12 candidates; 2–3 posts – up to 24; 4–6 posts – up to 36; 7–9 posts – up to 48; 10 posts and above – up to 50 candidates or 5 times the vacancies.
  • Post-Answer Key Process: Provisional answer key will be published on the Commission's website after the exam. Objections can be submitted within 05 days at ₹150/- per question (plus ₹40/- portal charge). Final answer key will be published after expert committee review. No objections will be entertained after publication of the final answer key.

General Information / Instructions

  • All amendments/instructions issued by the Government from time to time regarding age, domicile, employment exchange registration, reservation etc. will be incorporated into the final selection result.
  • The syllabus is attached in Bhaag-"H" of the notification and will be published on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in.
  • Cut-off marks of written exam and interview will not be disclosed prior to final selection.
  • If a computer or clerical error is noticed after declaration of result, the Commission reserves the right to correct it.
  • Reserved category seats (SC/ST/OBC) and age relaxation benefits are available only to Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates. Candidates from other states will be considered as Unreserved.
  • In any reserved category, if no eligible female candidate is available, the reserved seats will be filled by male candidates of the same category.
  • Divyangjan (Persons with Disabilities) candidates must attach the latest valid disability certificate issued by the District Medical Board constituted as per Ministry notification F-8-1-Satreh-Medi-2, dated 09.01.2009. Disability certificate issued after 01.06.2021 must be from the UID portal http://www.swavlambancard.gov.in. Manually issued certificates after that date will be invalid. Minimum 40% permanent disability is required to claim reservation and other benefits.
  • Candidates who are in Government service (temporary, daily wage, contractual, or under public undertakings) must submit an Undertaking that they have informed their Head of Department/office about applying for this post.
  • All information published regarding this recruitment notification including result will be available only on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Commission will not communicate through Email/letters/phone individually.
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Section) certificate valid for financial year 2026-27 must be held by the candidate by the last date of online application i.e. 20.05.2026.
  • OBC candidates must ensure they are not in the Creamy Layer. Non-Creamy Layer declaration as per the prescribed proforma must be submitted.
  • Final selection result for OBC reservation is subject to the pending court cases SLP 8764/2023 and WP5596/2024 and related matters. The result will be declared in Main Part (87%) and Provisional Part (13%) as per MP Govt. order dated 29.09.2022.
  • Disqualifications under MP Civil Services Rules 1961: Candidates convicted of crimes against women, candidates with more than 2 living children (where one was born on or after 26 January 2001) are not eligible for appointment.

How to Apply

  • Online applications must be submitted at www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Applications through any other means will not be accepted.
  • Online application window: 21-04-2026 to 20-05-2026.
  • Before filling the form, prepare a recent passport-size colour photograph scan and signature scan file as per instructions in the notification.
  • Fee can be paid via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or at M.P. Online authorized kiosks in cash.
  • After filling the form, a popup window will display basic information (name, parents' names, date of birth, category, gender) for verification. If any error is found, click Cancel to go back and correct. Click OK to submit. After successful submission, the application number will be generated (status will be Unpaid until fee is paid).
  • After submitting, click "Proceed for Payment" to complete fee payment. After successful payment, the application will be received and "Payment Done" will be displayed. Take a printout of the application form and preserve the application number for future reference.
  • Error Correction Facility: Online application correction can be done from 26.04.2026 to 22.05.2026 (till 12:00 midnight) at ₹50/- per correction. Applications submitted with late fee: corrections allowed up to 28.10.2026 at ₹50/- per correction.
  • Category/Gender/Date of Birth cannot be changed after the error correction period ends.
  • Candidates must ensure their signature is consistent across all documents; mismatch of signatures on various documents will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • No documents need to be uploaded at the time of online application. However, before the interview, attested self-certified documents must be submitted to the Commission as per the detailed checklist in Annexure/Parishisht-01 of the notification.
  • For any query or complaint regarding online application filling: Helpline – 0755-6720220; Email – [email protected].

Eligible candidates with B.Sc/Forensic Science/Computer Science/Computer Application degree for Lab Technician, 12th (Science) for Lab Assistant and 10th/12th (Science) for Lab Attendant can submit their MP FSL Recruitment 2026 online application through the MP Online portal without any application fee.

MP FSL Laboratory Technician, Assistant & Attendant Vacancy 2026 Details

A total of 126 vacancies will be filled for Laboratory Technician, Laboratory Assistant and Laboratory Attendant posts under the MP FSL Recruitment 2026 in the State Forensic Science Laboratory, Home (Police) Department, Madhya Pradesh. Check MP FSL post wise vacancy details in the table below.

MP FSL Lab Technician, Assistant & Attendant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates

MP FSL Recruitment 2026 Events Important Dates
Start date for MP FSL online application 2026 18 Mar 2026
Last date to submit MP FSL online application form 2026 06 Apr 2026
Date of Stage‑1 shortlisting (5x candidates) To be calculated after last date based on qualifying marks; notified separately by FSL HQ
Date of MP FSL written exam 2026 To be notified later by FSL HQ Bhopal; 2‑hour exam for each post 

MP FSL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Laboratory Technician: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Forensic Science or Computer Science or Computer Application from a recognized university.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (12th) with Science subjects from MP Board or any recognized board/institution.
  • Laboratory Attendant: Candidates must have passed High School/10th or Higher Secondary (old pattern) with Science or 10+2 with Science from MP Board/recognized institution.
  • Age Limit: Applicants should be at least 18 years old and not more than 40 years for unreserved male candidates of Madhya Pradesh as on 1st January of the recruitment year, while women, reserved category candidates, government employees, Vikram Awardees and certain inter‑caste marriage cases from MP domicile get upper age relaxation up to 45–50 years as per state rules.

MP FSL Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under MP FSL Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on permanent non‑gazetted posts with pay scales as per the 7th Central Pay Commission along with state‑admissible allowances.
  • Pay Scale Details: Laboratory Technician posts carry Level‑7 pay matrix Rs. 28,700–91,300, Laboratory Assistant posts carry Level‑4 Rs. 19,500–62,000 and Laboratory Attendant posts carry Level‑3 Rs. 18,000–56,900. During the initial three‑year period, candidates will receive 70%, 80% and 90% of the minimum of the pay scale in the 1st, 2nd and 3rd year respectively as stipend, in addition to applicable allowances as per MP government orders.

MP FSL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the MP FSL Recruitment 2026 advertisement, no application fee is prescribed for candidates applying for Laboratory Technician, Laboratory Assistant and Laboratory Attendant posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates can fill and submit the MP FSL online application form 2026 through the MP Online portal without paying any examination or application fee, but they may have to bear normal MP Online portal/service charges if applicable at the time of form submission.

MP FSL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The online application process for MP FSL Laboratory Technician, Laboratory Assistant & Laboratory Attendant Recruitment 2026 will be conducted through the MP Online portal as per the schedule notified in the advertisement. Eligible candidates must visit the MP Online portal, open the link for MP Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026 and complete their MP FSL online application form 2026 within the stipulated dates mentioned on the portal/notification.

Candidates should carefully enter their personal details, category, domicile status, educational qualifications and reservation claims, upload the required documents and then submit the MP FSL Lab Technician, Lab Assistant and Lab Attendant Application Form 2026 online. After final submission, applicants must download and print the submitted application form and keep it safe for document verification and further recruitment stages.

Click to Apply for MP FSL Recruitment 2026

Download MP FSL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

MP FSL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The MP FSL Laboratory Technician, Assistant & Attendant Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted in two main stages – shortlisting for written exam and a written examination, followed by category‑wise merit list preparation and document verification.
  • Stage 1 – Shortlisting (5x rule): Based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination (B.Sc for Lab Technician, 12th for Lab Assistant and 10th/12th for Lab Attendant), a merit list will be prepared and top 5 times the number of advertised vacancies for each post will be shortlisted for the written examination. All candidates securing marks equal to the cut‑off will also be called even if the number exceeds 5x of vacancies.
  • Stage 2 – Written Exam & Final Merit: A 2‑hour written exam of 100 marks will be conducted for each post with 80 marks for subject‑specific General Science and 20 marks for General Knowledge. To qualify, UR/OBC/EWS candidates must score at least 50% and SC/ST candidates at least 40%. Final selection lists for each post will be prepared solely on written exam marks with separate category‑wise lists and implementation of horizontal reservation for women and ex‑servicemen.

How to Apply for MP FSL Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible candidates for MP FSL Lab Technician, Lab Assistant & Lab Attendant Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the MP Online portal within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit MP Online Portal: Go to the official MP Online website and search for the link related to MP Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026 under the recruitment/departmental examinations section.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create a login ID and password, and then proceed to the MP FSL online application form 2026.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form: Enter personal details, address, educational qualifications, category, domicile status, reservation claims and post preferences (Lab Technician/Lab Assistant/Lab Attendant) carefully, ensuring data matches your certificates.
  • Step 4 – Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and all required certificates (educational, caste, domicile, ex‑serviceman, PwD, etc.) in the prescribed format and size as per instructions given in the MP FSL notification 2026.
  • Step 5 – Final Submit & Print: Review all entries, submit the form online and download the confirmation page/filled application form. Take a printout of the MP FSL application form 2026 and keep it safely for document verification, written exam and joining formalities.

Candidates Should Posses 12TH, 10TH, 8TH Pass 

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

  • Note: Women who are widowed, divorced or legally separated are also eligible provided they do not have any children subject to fulfilling all other eligibility criteria. Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

  • Last Date for Apply Online: 10-04-2026

  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (UR) 11-04-1992 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (SC/ST) 11-04-1987 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the detailed Young Professional eligibility criteria including age limit, educational qualification and preferred skills before submitting the application form.

Nationality: The applicant must be an Indian national to be eligible for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026.

Age Limit: Candidates should not exceed 35 years of age as on the date of advertisement for Income Tax Young Professional 2026. Relaxation in upper age limit, if any, will be as per Government of India rules as applicable to the Income Tax Department.

Essential Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Law from recognized Universities, Colleges and Institutions of national or international repute and/or be a qualified Chartered Accountant for Income Tax Young Professional posts.

Minimum Marks Requirement: Candidates should have secured at least 50% marks in their 3-year LLB or 5-year integrated LLB degree programme or in their Post Graduation degree in Law, or must be a qualified Chartered Accountant with the prescribed professional qualification.

Preferred Qualification – Experience in Taxation: Chartered Accountants who have completed their articleship in taxation and Law graduates/Post graduates who have been engaged in research work or projects in taxation will be given preference for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026.

Preferred Skills – ICT & Communication: Candidates having good skills in Information & Communication Technology (ICT) along with strong communication and interpersonal skills shall be preferred for the Young Professional position in Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) Pune.

Other Conditions: The Young Professional engagement in Income Tax Department Pune is purely contractual for a period of one year, extendable by another year based on satisfactory performance, and selected candidates will have no right to claim regular employment in the department.

Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026 selection process will be carried out in two stages as mentioned in the official notification.

Stage 1 – Screening: All applications received for Income Tax Young Professional Recruitment 2026 will first be scrutinized and screened based on eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience in taxation and preferred skills. Only those candidates who satisfy the prescribed Young Professional eligibility conditions will be shortlisted for the next stage of the selection process.

Stage 2 – Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional 2026. The intimation for interview will be sent to the candidates on their registered e-mail address and/or by speed post, and no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

Document Verification: At the time of interview, candidates must produce their bio-data and all original certificates in support of age, educational qualification, professional qualification, experience and other claims for verification, failing which they may be disqualified from Income Tax Young Professional selection 2026.

Final Selection: Final selection for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional posts will be based on performance in the interview and overall profile, as per the decision of the competent authority of the Income Tax Department Pune.

Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Salary 2026

Candidates appointed through Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026 will be engaged on a contractual remuneration basis as specified in the notice.

Monthly Remuneration: Selected Young Professionals will be paid a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month (lump sum) during the period of engagement with the Income Tax Department Pune.

Contract Period: The Young Professional engagement will initially be for a period of one year, which may be extended by another year subject to satisfactory performance and requirement of the department.

No Regular Employment Claim: The Young Professional position is purely contractual in nature and does not confer any right on the candidate to claim regular employment or absorption in the Income Tax Department Pune in future.

The official Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notice does not mention any specific application fee for submitting the Young Professional application form.

Date of ECIL Advt. 07/2026 notification 26 March 2026 
Walk‑in date – Mumbai (West Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, #1207, Veer Savarkar Marg, Dadar (Prabhadevi), Mumbai – 400028 
Walk‑in date – New Delhi (North Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, D‑15, DDA Local Shopping Complex, A‑Block, Ring Road, Naraina, New Delhi – 110028 
Walk‑in date – Bengaluru (South Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, #1/1, 2nd Floor, LIC Building, Sampige Road, Malleswaram, Bengaluru – 560003 
Walk‑in date – Chennai (South Zone) 18 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, Economist House, S‑15, Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai – 600032 
Walk‑in registration time at venues 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs; candidates reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be allowed to register 
Cut‑off date for age & post‑qualification experience Date of selection (respective walk‑in date) 

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, ECE, ETC, EEE, E&I, CSE, IT, CSIT, Mechanical/Electrical with NDT Level‑II (for Kudankulam) along with a minimum of 3 years post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship in the relevant field up to 1 year is also counted as experience.
  • Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/ETC/EEE/E&I/CSE/IT and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship up to 1 year is countable towards experience.
  • Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C): Diploma with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in ECE/ETC/Electronics/EEE/Instrumentation and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience including relevant apprenticeship.
  • Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C): ITI passed in Electronics, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Instrumentation or Radio & TV trades with minimum 2 years post‑qualification experience (including up to 1 year apprenticeship) in maintenance/repair of electronics, instrumentation systems, communication gadgets or computers.
  • Age Limit (UR): Project Engineer – maximum 33 years; Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan – maximum 30 years. Age relaxation is 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, an additional 10 years for PwBD (40% and above) over category relaxation, and 5 years for candidates domiciled in J&K from 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 will receive consolidated monthly emoluments based on the post and contract year, along with limited benefits as per ECIL rules.
  • Consolidated Emoluments: Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there is no mention of any application or examination fee in the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

There is no online application process for ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026); candidates have to attend walk‑in selections as per the notified schedule. Eligible applicants must visit the official ECIL website ecil.co.in, download the prescribed ECIL contract application form 2026, fill it carefully and report at the concerned zonal walk‑in venue on the respective date within the registration time slot.

Candidates must carry the duly filled ECIL application form, updated resume, original certificates and one set of self‑attested photocopies for age, qualification, experience, category, disability, ex‑servicemen and identity proof along with recent passport size photographs. Registration and document verification will be done at the venue before the personal interview under ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026.

Click to Download ECIL Contract Application Form 2026

Download ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 07/2026)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 selection for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan will be based on walk‑in registration, document verification and personal interview with a weighted merit system.
  • Shortlisting & Evaluation: After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks.
  • Final Merit & Offer: Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.

How to Apply / Attend ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 07/2026) must appear personally at the designated zonal venues on the scheduled walk‑in dates with the prescribed application form and documents.

  • Step 1 – Download ECIL Application Form: Visit the official ECIL website www.ecil.co.in, open the Careers/Recruitment section and download the application form for Advt. No. 07/2026. Take a printout and fill it neatly with all required details including post category, zone and location preference.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Documents: Keep ready original and one set of self‑attested copies of 10th certificate (DOB proof), all qualification certificates and marksheets, CGPA‑to‑percentage conversion (if applicable), complete experience certificates with from‑to dates and post held, appointment order and recent payslips (if currently employed), caste (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) certificate, non‑creamy layer OBC certificate (not older than one year), PwBD certificate, Ex‑servicemen/ J&K domicile proof and valid government ID (Aadhaar/Passport etc.).
  • Step 3 – Reach Walk‑in Venue in Time: Report to the respective ECIL Zonal Office (Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru on 09 April 2026; Chennai on 18 April 2026) within the registration time 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs. Late reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Step 4 – Registration & Document Verification: Submit the filled ECIL application form 2026, resume and document set at the registration desk. After successful verification, candidates will be allowed to attend the personal interview as part of the selection process.
  • Step 5 – Attend Interview & Wait for Result: Appear for the interview as scheduled at the venue. Final selection will be based on the combined weightage of qualification, experience and interview performance. Shortlisted candidates will receive joining instructions from ECIL and must be prepared for posting at project locations anywhere in India.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Supervisor (Assay/T.O.-Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy): Candidates must possess a 1st class full-time Diploma in Engineering in the relevant stream (Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy) from a recognized institution, or higher qualification i.e. B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. (Engineering) in the relevant discipline.
  • Engraver (Sculpture/Metal Works): Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts (Sculpture or Metal Works) with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution.
  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 25 years for Jr. Technician posts, 28 years for B-3/B-4 level posts, and 30 years for Supervisor posts, as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10–15 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on regular posts with pay scales as per the company's pay structure along with applicable allowances.
  • Pay Scale Details: Supervisor posts carry Level S-1 pay matrix ₹27,600–95,910; Engraver and Jr. Office/Bullion Assistant/Lab Assistant posts carry Level B-3 ₹21,540–77,160 or Level B-4 ₹23,910–85,570; and Junior Technician posts carry Level W-1 ₹18,780–67,390. Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).
  • SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee but are required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹200/- towards service expenses.
  • Payment can be made online through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The online application process for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 will start from 28th March 2026 and the last date to submit the IGM online application form is 27th April 2026. Candidates must visit the official website igmnoida.spmcil.com, open the career page and complete their IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form within the given dates.

While filling the India Government Mint application form 2026, candidates should register with a valid email ID and mobile number, enter personal and educational details, upload scanned documents, pay the examination fee (if applicable) and finally submit and download the IGM online form for future reference.

Click to Apply for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026

How to Apply for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for the India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 must submit their application forms through the online mode only within the specified dates. Follow the step-by-step process given below to fill the IGM online application form correctly.

  • Eligible candidates for IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the company's official website within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to http://igmnoida.spmcil.com, click on "Discover SPMCIL" and navigate to the CAREERS page to find the IGM Recruitment 2026 link.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create login credentials, and proceed to the IGM online application form 2026.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form: Enter personal details, address, educational qualifications, category, unit preference (Mumbai/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Noida), and post applied for carefully, ensuring all data matches your original certificates.
  • Step 4 – Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, 20–50 KB, 4.5×3.5 cm), signature (10–20 KB), left thumb impression (20–50 KB), handwritten declaration, and other required certificates (educational, caste, PwBD, Ex-SM, etc.) in the prescribed format and size as per instructions in the IGM notification 2026.
  • Step 5 – Pay Fee & Submit: Complete the online fee payment (where applicable) through Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. Review all entries, submit the form, download the confirmation page, and take a printout of the IGM application form 2026 for document verification and future reference.

SIDBI Specialist Officers Eligibility Criteria 2026

SIDBI Specialist Officers eligibility criteria vary by post and include age limit, educational qualification, and experience requirements that must be fulfilled as on February 28, 2026.

Age Limit (as on February 28, 2026)

  • Data Scientist (DS): Maximum 35 years
  • AI Specialists (AIS): Maximum 35 years
  • ML Engineers (MLE): Maximum 35 years
  • Data Engineers (DE): Maximum 40 years
  • Data Protection Officer (DPO): Maximum 45 years
  • Relationship Manager – Corporate Deposit (RM-CD): Maximum 35 years
  • Portfolio Manager (PM): Maximum 40 years
  • Strategic Partnerships Manager (SPM): Maximum 35 years
  • Cluster Manager (CM): Maximum 40 years

Age Relaxation

  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD: As per Government of India guidelines

SIDBI Specialist Officers Educational Qualification 2026

Educational qualifications for SIDBI Specialist Officers are post-specific and must be from recognized universities/institutes:

Post-wise Educational Qualification

  • Data Scientist (DS): Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Quantitative Finance or related quantitative discipline. Desirable: PhD in relevant quantitative field, certifications in data science/ML/AI.
  • AI Specialists (AIS): Graduate degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science or related discipline. Post-graduate degree such as M.Tech, M.Sc. (Data Science/AI/ML) or equivalent. Desirable: Certifications in AI/ML/cloud AI.
  • ML Engineers (MLE): B.E./B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Data Engineering, AI or related discipline. Desirable: Master's degree in computer science/AI/ML/Data Science, certifications in cloud/ML engineering.
  • Data Engineers (DE): B.E./B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or related discipline. Desirable: Master's degree in computer science/data engineering/information systems, certifications in cloud/data platforms.
  • Data Protection Officer (DPO): Bachelor's degree (graduation or equivalent) in any discipline. Desirable: Post-graduate in Law (LLM), Technology Law, MBA, Computer Science, Information Security; certifications like CIPP, CIPM, FIP, CIPT, CDPSE, CDPO, CDP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
  • Relationship Manager (RM-CD): Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM (Finance)/CA/CFA or equivalent.
  • Portfolio Manager (PM): Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM (Finance)/CA/CFA or equivalent with strong exposure to capital markets/ECM/portfolio management.
  • Strategic Partnerships Manager (SPM): MBA/PGDM or Master's degree in Finance/Strategy/Marketing/Entrepreneurship/Economics or related field.
  • Cluster Manager (CM): Bachelor's degree in Agri Business/Rural Management/Business Administration/Finance/Commerce or related field. Desirable: MBA/PGDM in Agri Business/Rural Management/Sales/Marketing.

SIDBI Specialist Officers Experience Requirements 2026

Experience requirements (as on February 28, 2026) are post-specific and relevant experience certificates from employer are mandatory:

  • Data Scientist (DS): Minimum 3 years in data science/advanced analytics/ML modelling in Banks, NBFCs, DFIs, Fintechs or regulated financial institutions.
  • AI Specialists (AIS): Minimum 4 years in AI/ML development, deployment, and MLOps in banking, fintech or regulated financial services.
  • ML Engineers (MLE): Minimum 4 years in ML engineering/MLOps/backend engineering with ML systems exposure.
  • Data Engineers (DE): Minimum 8 years in data engineering/data platform roles in Banks, NBFCs, DFIs, fintechs or regulated financial institutions.
  • Data Protection Officer (DPO): 15 years in managerial/professional roles (preferably in IT, compliance, legal, risk, information security or finance) with minimum 4 years direct hands-on experience in data protection, privacy regulation, data governance or information security.
  • Relationship Manager (RM-CD): Minimum 6 years total in Banks/NBFCs with approximately 4 years in deposit mobilisation/institutional liabilities/treasury sales.
  • Portfolio Manager (PM): Minimum 10 years in portfolio management/investments, ECM/IPO/capital markets, merchant banking/investment banking, AMC/PMS/AIF/DFI/bank treasury roles.
  • Strategic Partnerships Manager (SPM): Minimum 8 years in strategic partnerships/ecosystem relationships, merchant banking/investment banking/transaction advisory, or DFI/NBFC/bank partnership roles.
  • Cluster Manager (CM): Minimum 3 years post-qualification experience in cluster & PDI activities/business development in banking/financial services or working with MSMEs, FPOs, or NBFC/microfinance institutions.

SIDBI Specialist Officers Selection Process 2026

The SIDBI Specialist Officers Selection Process 2026 consists of shortlisting of applications followed by Online Personal Interview before a Selection Committee.

  • Shortlisting: SIDBI will undertake preliminary screening of applications to prepare shortlist of eligible candidates. Merely fulfilling the requirements does not automatically entitle candidature for interview.
  • Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for online personal interview on a suitable date (to be informed in due course). Interview shall take place online, candidates must ensure availability of necessary infrastructure.
  • Merit List: Final merit list will be prepared in descending order based on scores obtained in interview only. In case of tie, candidates will be ranked by age in descending order.

Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Candidates applying for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must ensure that they satisfy all the eligibility conditions related to age, educational qualification and apprenticeship norms as on the crucial date 15th April 2026.
  • Educational Qualification: Applicants must have a full-time Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant branch (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics) granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education, a recognized University, or an institute recognized by the State or Central Government as equivalent. Candidates who have completed their Diploma through regular (full-time) mode only are eligible for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Training 2026.
  • Diploma Passing Date Condition: Candidates must have completed their Diploma in Engineering/Technology on or after 15th April 2021. Diploma holders who have completed their qualification before 15th April 2021 are not eligible for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026.
  • Age Limit: The minimum age limit to undergo Technician Apprenticeship Training at Ordnance Factory Bhandara is 14 years, and there is no upper age limit under the Apprentices Act. However, candidates between 14 to 18 years are minors and therefore cannot sign the apprenticeship contract themselves; their apprenticeship contracts must be signed by their guardians.
  • No Prior Training/Experience: Diploma holders who have undergone training or have job experience for a period of one year or more after attaining the Diploma qualification are not eligible to be engaged as Technician Apprentices under this Ordnance Factory Bhandara Apprentice Notification 2026.
  • Gap Limit Between Diploma and Training: A candidate is not eligible to undergo apprenticeship training if the gap between completion of Diploma and commencement of training is more than five years. Therefore, only candidates whose Diploma is completed within five years from the crucial date (i.e. on or after 15th April 2021) can apply for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026.
  • Graduates/Postgraduates Not Eligible: Candidates who have completed Graduate or Post Graduate qualifications after their Diploma (such as B.E./B.Tech or higher) are not eligible for Technician Apprentice Training at Ordnance Factory Bhandara.
  • Other Apprenticeship Conditions: Candidates who have already undergone Graduate or Technician Apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act and whose apprenticeship contract was terminated for any reason are not eligible to be engaged again without prior approval of the Apprenticeship Adviser. Sandwich course students will also not be eligible after passing their final examination unless specifically approved by the Regional Central Apprenticeship Adviser.

Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Salary (Stipend) 2026

  • Candidates selected through Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be engaged as Technician Apprentices for a fixed training period and will be paid a monthly stipend as per Apprentices Act provisions.
  • Stipend Amount: The stipend for Technician Apprentice (Diploma) at Ordnance Factory Bhandara is Rs. 10,900/- per month for the entire duration of the apprenticeship training.
  • Training Period: The period of Apprenticeship Training for Technician Apprentices is one year. During this period, apprentices will be governed by the Apprentices Act 1961 (as amended) and applicable rules of Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT), Western Region.
  • No Employment Guarantee: On completion of the one-year Apprenticeship Training, no employment in Ordnance Factory Bhandara is guaranteed. The apprenticeship is purely for training purposes and does not confer any right to regular job in the factory.

Bhandara.” Incomplete, incorrect or belated applications reaching OF Bhandara after 11th April 2026 will be summarily rejected and will not be considered for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026.
