Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Selection Process 2026

  • The Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 selection process is strictly merit-based and does not involve any written test or interview.
  • Merit List on Diploma Marks: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared from the marks obtained in the final year examination of the Diploma, taking the aggregate of all years/semesters into account. In case of CGPA/SGPA grading, candidates must attach appropriate conversion documents from their institute to calculate equivalent percentage; otherwise, their candidature will be disqualified.
  • No Test or Interview: There will be no written test or interview for selection of Technician Apprentices at Ordnance Factory Bhandara. Shortlisting is purely on the basis of Diploma marks and fulfilment of eligibility criteria.
  • Document Verification & Medical Examination: Candidates shortlisted from the merit list will be called for Document Verification, where their certificates, mark sheets, caste category, PwBD status and eligibility conditions will be thoroughly checked. After successful verification, they will have to undergo a Medical Examination and also furnish a Police Verification Report and Character Certificates from two Gazetted Officers as per notification.
  • Registration of Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates must enter into an apprenticeship contract with Ordnance Factory Bhandara, which will be registered with Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT), Western Region, Mumbai for the prescribed training period under the Apprentices Act 1961.

How to Apply for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 are required to apply only through the offline mode by submitting the prescribed application form by post.
  • Step 1 – Read the Apprentice Notification: Visit the official Munitions India Ltd/Ordnance Factory Bhandara website or obtain the advertisement and read the Technician Apprentice Notification 2026 carefully, noting eligibility conditions, crucial date (15 April 2026), closing date (11 April 2026) and list of documents to be attached.
  • Step 2 – Download and Print Application Form: Download the Application for Technician Apprenticeship Training form attached with the notification and take a clear printout. Ensure that the format and all fields remain as prescribed by Ordnance Factory Bhandara.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form Carefully: Fill in all details in block letters where required, including full name, father’s/husband’s name, gender, category (Technician Apprentice), trade (Diploma in Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics Engineering), permanent and correspondence address, email ID, mobile number, date of birth, educational qualifications, percentage in Diploma, Diploma completion date, category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD), job/training experience and status of any higher qualification.
  • Step 4 – Prepare Supporting Documents: Attach self-attested copies of all required documents: Diploma certificate and consolidated final year mark sheet (both sides), Aadhaar card, age proof (preferably SSC certificate), Central caste certificate of SC/ST/OBC (NCL) with recent valid Non Creamy Layer certificate for OBC, PwBD certificate (if applicable), declaration/affidavit regarding no prior training and gap, and CGPA/SGPA to percentage conversion certificate from college/university (if applicable).
  • Step 5 – Prepare Envelope and Superscription: Place the filled application form and all enclosures in a suitable envelope and clearly superscribe on the envelope: “Application for Technician Apprenticeship Training in Ordnance Factory Bhandara.” This superscription is mandatory for proper identification of your application by the factory.
  • Step 6 – Send Application by Post: Send the envelope by post to “The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Bhandara (Unit of Munitions India Ltd.), At + Post – Jawaharnagar, Tah + Dist – Bhandara, Maharashtra State, Pin – 441906.” Ensure that your application reaches the factory on or before 11th April 2026; applications received after this date for any reason, including postal delay, will not be entertained.
  • Step 7 – Keep Copies and Track Communication: Keep photocopies of the filled application and all attached documents for your own record. Regularly check your email ID and keep your mobile number active, as all further communication regarding shortlisting, document verification and joining for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Training 2026 will be sent via email only.
  • Step 8 – Affidavit and Certificates at Joining: At the time of document verification/joining, be prepared to submit the original declaration/affidavit regarding training gap, Police Clearance Certificate and two Character Certificates from Gazetted Officers in the prescribed format, along with all original documents for verification.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Salary 2026

For Regular Basis positions, the annual fixed compensation for Senior Analyst grade is approximately ₹24.81 lakh. In addition, variable pay (performance bonus) of up to 20% on fixed compensation may be paid based on performance, as decided by the Bank from time to time. Compensation may be revised at suitable intervals as approved by the Board. Group Insurance (Medical, Accidental & Term Life) will be provided over and above the compensation.

For Contract Basis positions, remuneration will be offered based on qualification, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. The Fixed Term engagement will be for a minimum of 5 years, which may be renewed at NaBFID's discretion.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Selection Process 2026

The selection process differs for Regular and Contract basis appointments as follows.

Regular Basis: The selection process comprises an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview. If fewer applications are received for any stream, the Bank may change the process to Shortlisting-cum-Interview. The online exam consists of 50 objective-type questions (Professional Knowledge) carrying 100 marks to be completed in 60 minutes. There is a negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% for UR/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates. Final selection is based on Online Exam (70% weightage) and Interview (30% weightage).

Contract Basis: The selection process is Shortlisting-cum-Interview. If a large number of applications are received, the Bank may conduct an Online Exam. A Psychometric Test and Group Discussion may also be conducted as additional assessment tools. Interviews will be held at Mumbai only.

Category Application Fee

SC / ST / PwBD ₹100 + applicable taxes (Intimation charges only)

Fee is non-refundable. Payment can be made through Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Mobile Wallets, or UPI. Bank transaction charges and GST are to be borne by the candidate.

Important Instructions

  • The application process is complete only when the application fee is successfully deposited online on or before 08.04.2026.
  • All candidates must ensure they fulfil the eligibility criteria as on the cut-off date 28.02.2026 before applying.
  • Candidates must upload all required documents - Brief Resume, ID Proof, Age Proof, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates, and Caste/EWS/PwBD Certificate (if applicable) - in PDF format, failing which the candidature will not be considered.
  • No candidate is permitted to apply for more than one position. If multiple applications are submitted, only the latest valid registration (higher registration number) will be retained and fees paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check https://nabfid.org/careers for updates. No separate intimation will be issued for any change or update - all corrigenda will be hosted only on the Bank's website.
  • Call letters for examination and interviews will be available only on the Bank's website. All communications will be sent by email only - no hard copy will be dispatched.
  • Interviews for both Regular and Contract positions will be held at Mumbai only.
  • Candidates called for Interview will be reimbursed actual travel expenses up to a maximum of IInd AC rail fare of mail express train, upon submission of to & fro tickets.
  • Selected candidates may be posted at Mumbai, New Delhi, or anywhere in India as per the Bank's discretion. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Candidates serving in Govt./Quasi-Govt./PSU/Nationalised Banks/Financial Institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview.
  • All educational qualifications must be regular full-time. MBA/PG Diploma must be 2-year full-time; MCA must be 3-year full-time (or 2-year full-time if admitted on or after 2020-21 as per UGC guidelines).
  • The offer to join NaBFID is subject to verification of original documents at any stage after qualifying the exam/shortlisting/interview/date of joining.
  • If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage - even after appointment - the candidature/services will be cancelled/terminated without notice.
  • Candidates must carry original photo identity proof (PAN Card/Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/Aadhar etc.) along with a photocopy at the time of examination/interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid identity proofs.
  • The handwritten declaration must be written in the candidate's own handwriting in English only on white paper with black ink; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification. No correspondence will be entertained by any ineligible or non-selected candidate.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai. Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • No change in category of any candidate is permitted after registration of online application.

How to Apply for NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026 from 18.03.2026 to 08.04.2026 by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official NaBFID website at https://nabfid.org/careers and click on the "APPLY ONLINE" link for the relevant advertisement (Regular or Contract).
  2. Click on "Click here for New Registration", enter your Name, Contact details and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and sent to your registered email/mobile.
  3. Fill in all personal, educational and professional details in the online application form. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save your progress. No changes are permitted after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION".
  4. Upload scanned copies of your Photograph (4.5cm×3.5cm, 20–50 KB), Signature (10–20 KB), Left Thumb Impression (20–50 KB), Handwritten Declaration (50–100 KB), and all required documents in PDF format (max 500 KB each).
  5. Also capture a live photograph using webcam or mobile QR scan as required by the application system.
  6. Proceed to the payment tab and pay the application fee online through the available digital payment methods.
  7. Submit the form and download the e-Receipt and a printout of the completed application for future reference.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Research Associate (Ph.D. Projects): Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline as specified for each Research Project - including Chemical Sciences, Physical Sciences, Polymer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biosciences, Agriculture, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Materials Science and related fields.
  • Research Associate (Project No. 21 - Muon Tomography): Candidates must have B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Computer Science, Information Technology or Electronics & Computer Engineering with one year of relevant experience preferred.
  • Experience: Relevant post-Ph.D. research experience in the specific field as detailed against each project is desirable/preferred. Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis and are awaiting evaluation are not eligible.
  • Age Limit: No specific age limit mentioned; candidates should meet BARC/DST fellowship norms applicable for Research Associates.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 - Fellowship Amount

  • Selected candidates under BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 will be placed at one of three fellowship levels - RA-I, RA-II or RA-III - based on qualifications, experience and performance in the selection interview.
  • Fellowship Details: RA-I carries Rs. 58,000/- per month plus Contingency Grant of Rs. 20,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable. RA-II and RA-III carry higher fellowship amounts plus Contingency Grant and HRA as per BARC norms. The level will be decided by the interview committee based on quality of Ph.D. thesis, post-Ph.D. research experience, publications/products and performance in interview.
  • Note: Hostel accommodation will not be provided to Research Associates.
  • RA-I: 58,000/- p.m. plus Contingency Grant of 60,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable.
  • RA-II : 61,000/- p.m. plus Contingency Grant of 60,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable.
  • RA-III : 67,000/- p.m. plus Contingency Grant of 60,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 advertisement, no application fee is prescribed for candidates applying for Research Associate posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates can prepare and submit their BARC RA online application form 2026 by post to BARC Mumbai without paying any examination or application fee.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The application process for BARC Research Associate Fellowship Recruitment 2026 is offline only. Eligible candidates must fill the application in the prescribed format available in the official advertisement and send it along with complete bio-data, photocopies of mark-sheets and degree certificates (from SSC to Ph.D.), other academic credentials and work experience details by post to:

Deputy Establishment Officer, Recruitment-V, Central Complex, BARC, Trombay, Mumbai - 400085

The envelope must be superscribed with the Research Project Number. Candidates must apply separately for each Research Project with a separate set of documents. Applications received through email will not be accepted.

Download Naval Ship Repair Yard Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The BARC Research Associate Fellowship Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted through screening of applications followed by a personal interview - no written exam.
  • Stage 1 - Screening: Applications received will be subject to screening based on qualifications, experience and relevance to the research project. Only screened-in candidates will be called for interview. All information related to selection will be made available on www.barc.gov.in.
  • Stage 2 - Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed. The RA fellowship level (RA-I / RA-II / RA-III) will be decided by the interview committee based on: (i) quality of Ph.D. thesis, (ii) post-Ph.D. research experience as evidenced from publications and/or products/processes developed, and (iii) performance in the selection interview. Candidates must bring a copy of the application and a valid photo identity card (Aadhaar, Passport, Driving License, College ID or Voter ID) and all original documents at the time of interview.

How to Apply for BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible candidates for BARC Research Associate Fellowship Recruitment 2026 must submit their application by post within the last date of 24 Apr 2026.
  • Step 1 - Download Application Format: Download the prescribed application form from the official BARC website www.barc.gov.in (Advertisement No. 3/2026(R-V)).
  • Step 2 - Fill Application Form: Fill in personal details, date of birth, nationality, category (SC/ST/OBC), correspondence address, contact details, educational qualifications from SSC onwards, Ph.D. topic details, work experience, publications and conference participation carefully. Mention the Research Project Number you are applying for.
  • Step 3 - Affix Photograph: Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the space provided on the application form.
  • Step 4 - Attach Documents: Attach one set of photocopies of all mark-sheets and degree certificates from SSC to Ph.D., PAN/Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable), work experience certificates, publications and any other relevant documents as per the checklist in the application form.
  • Step 5 - Dispatch by Post: Review all entries, superscribe the envelope with the Research Project Number and send by post to Deputy Establishment Officer, Recruitment-V, Central Complex, BARC, Trombay, Mumbai - 400085, so as to reach by 24 Apr 2026. Apply separately for each Research Project with a separate set of documents. Keep a copy safely for future reference.

HEF Khadki Educational & Professional Qualification 2026

Supervisory Staff (Graduate Project Engineer – Chemical)

Skilled Worker (AOCP – Attendant Operator Chemical Plant)

  • Matriculation + NAC/NTC issued by NCTVT (now NCVT) having completed the course from government/private organization having affiliation from government, and those from Government ITI.
  • Trade: AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant)
  • Feeder Trades: IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Mechanic.

HEF Khadki Selection Process 2026

For Supervisory Staff (Graduate Project Engineer):

  • Selection based on Marks scored in B.E./B.Tech and Personal Interaction/Interview only, in order of Merit.
  • Weightage: B.E./B.Tech marks – 85%; Personal Interaction/Interview – 15%.
  • Cut-off percentage for calling candidates for interview may be decided by HEF based on marks in qualifying examination to ensure sufficient competition.
  • Merit list prepared on combined marks of B.E./B.Tech and Personal Interaction/Interview.
  • Candidates scoring more than cut-off marks will be called for Document Verification in order of merit; number limited to posts notified (Discipline/Category wise).
  • Candidates qualifying Document Verification will be issued Offers of Engagement.

For Skilled Worker (AOCP – CPW):

  • Selection based on Marks scored in NCVT and Trade Test/Practical Test only, in order of Merit.
  • Weightage: NCVT Exam – 80%; Trade Test/Practical Test – 20%.
  • Cut-off for Trade Test/Practical Test decided by HEF based on total marks in NCVT.
  • Merit list prepared on combined marks in NCVT Exam and Trade Test/Practical Test.
  • Candidates with AOCP Trade (NCVT) will be given preference; candidates from feeder trades considered only if requisite number of AOCP candidates not available.
  • AOCP Trade Apprentices from Government/Private organisations will be given compulsory "ONE MONTH" extensive in-house training on Safe Handling of Explosives, ammunition, safety norms, DOs & DON'Ts, etc. After successful completion, two months On-Job training will be imparted, after which they will be considered for specific job deployment.
  • On successful completion of training, a Certificate will be issued acceptable in all MIL Group of Factories.

Remuneration & Benefits

  • Remuneration at 1/30th of Basic Pay + Dearness Allowance for 8 hours work per day.
  • IDA as prevalent will be applicable.
  • House Rent Allowance as per classification of cities (when Company Quarter is not available). Priority for Company Quarters where available.
  • 30 days leave per year (2.5 days per calendar month of service); can be accumulated up to 30 days and encashed after completion of one year.
  • Eligible for EPF and Employees Compensation Act as per government guidelines.
  • Bonus (as applicable) as per Bonus Act 1965.
  • Night Duty Allowance at par with regular employees (for Night Shift due to production exigency).
  • Risk Allowance at par with regular employees as per extant rules.
  • Safety and protective gear, equipment, kits as per Company norms.
  • Maternity Benefits for female personnel as per Maternity Benefit Act, 1961.
  • Company Quarters eligibility (wherever available); license fee deducted at rates applicable to regular employees.

NOT entitled for: Promotions, OT allowance, Loans/Advances/Interest Subsidies, Medical Facilities, Contingency Advance, School Fee Reimbursement, LTC/LTA Facilities, Grant of Study Leave, Sponsorship for Higher Studies, or any other benefits admissible to regular employees.

Terms & Conditions of Tenure Engagement

  • Engagement on contract basis initially for One Year; extendable for another Three Years (total maximum Four Years) with yearly renewal based on factory requirement and individual performance.
  • Tenure ends automatically on completion of four years from date of joining, without any further notice.
  • Employment can be terminated at any time during tenure by giving one month's notice by either side or payment of Basic Pay + IDA Component in lieu of Notice.
  • No commitment to the candidate either for absorption as permanent employee or for extension of term.
  • Performance assessed on a six-monthly basis; poor performance will result in written notice to improve; repeated poor rating may lead to termination.
  • Full-time basis; absence other than authorized leave/Company Holidays will result in proportionate reduction in Consolidated Emoluments.
  • For quitting the job, candidate must give one month prior notice in advance, failing which one month salary will be deducted.
  • Tenure Based Personnel will abide by various Company/Factory Rules & Regulations governing the assigned tasks and conduct.
  • Personnel covered under Income Tax, Service Tax, Professional Tax as per applicable rules; all such taxes payable by candidates.

Eligibility Criteria – Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026

Asstt Director (EDP)

  • Degree in Computer Engineering/Computer Science OR Degree in Maths/Statistics/Operational Research/Economics with PG Diploma in Computer Application/Computer Science/Information Technology OR Degree in Engineering with PG Diploma in these areas from a recognised university/institution.

Catering Officer

  • Degree from a recognised University plus Diploma in Catering Technology and Applied Nutrition from the Institute of Catering Technology and Applied Nutrition, Mumbai or equivalent, with 3 years’ experience in the line.

  • Degree or equivalent in Electrical/Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised university/institution.

  • Degree or equivalent in Electrical/Electronics & Communication Engineering with 5 years’ experience in the relevant discipline in executive cadre in an Industrial/Commercial/Government undertaking.

Dy. Secretary

  • Degree from a recognised university with 9 years’ experience in executive cadre in General Administration/Personnel/Industrial Relations etc. in an Industrial/Commercial/Government undertaking.

Senior Welfare Officer

  • Degree plus Degree/Diploma in Social Science (as per specified list in notification) and 5 years’ experience as Labour Welfare Officer/Industrial Relations Officer in Industrial/Commercial/Government undertaking, with knowledge of Marathi.

Dy. Manager (Welfare)

  • Degree plus Degree/Diploma in Social Science (as per specified list) and 9 years’ experience as Labour Welfare Officer/Industrial Relations Officer, with knowledge of Marathi.

Qualifications must be from recognised Indian Universities/Institutes approved by UGC/AICTE, and candidates must possess valid mark sheet/degree/diploma/certificate and required experience as on 01/03/2026.

Age limit (as on 01/03/2026)

  • Asstt Director (EDP), Assistant Director (Research), Catering Officer, Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical): Above 18 years – Below 30 years (born between 02/03/1996 and 01/03/2008, both dates inclusive).
  • Executive Engineer (Electrical/Mechanical), Senior Welfare Officer: Above 21 years – Below 35 years (born between 02/03/1991 and 01/03/2005).
  • Dy. Secretary, Dy. Manager (Welfare): Above 21 years – Below 40 years (born between 02/03/1986 and 01/03/2005).

Age relaxation and category-wise conditions will be as per prevailing Government guidelines mentioned in the notification.

The notification specifies categories of benchmark disabilities identified as suitable for each post (e.g., B, LV, D, HH, OA, OL, BA, BL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV, SLD, MI, MD etc.) and clarifies that PwBD candidates can apply only for posts where their disability is identified as suitable. The recruitment will be carried out through online examination and further selection stages as per the detailed advertisement. How to Apply Online for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026

Applications will be accepted online only from 06/03/2026 to 06/04/2026 through the Mumbai Port Authority website.

  • Visit the official website www.mumbaiport.gov.in and open the “People & Career/Jobs” section.
  • Click on the “Apply Online” link against Advertisement No. DR-15 – Recruitment of Class I posts in Mumbai Port Authority.
  • Click on “Click here for New Registration”, enter your name, contact details and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  • Log in with the credentials, fill in personal, educational and experience details carefully and use the “Save and Next” option to verify entries before final submission.
  • Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per the size and format guidelines given in Annexure III of the advertisement.
  • Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the prescribed application fee/intimation charges online using Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/IMPS/Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets.
  • After successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated; download and print both the e-Receipt and the final submitted application form containing fee details for future reference.

Candidates are advised to ensure they meet all eligibility conditions (age, qualification, experience, physical requirements) before applying; appearing in the online examination will not confer any right of selection if they are found ineligible at any stage.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Surgeon: MBBS with MD/MS in Surgery and relevant post-graduate qualification

  • Other Medical Posts: MBBS with respective post-graduate qualifications in the concerned specialization

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidates must possess the required educational qualification from a recognized University/Board/Institution
  • Knowledge of Marathi language is essential for most administrative positions
  • Valid professional registration certificates wherever applicable (for medical posts)
  • Computer knowledge and typing skills for clerical posts

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in municipal corporation or government organization
  • Additional certifications in the relevant field
  • Knowledge of local government procedures and regulations
  • Proficiency in English along with Marathi

Experience

  • For technical posts, relevant work experience in government/municipal bodies is desirable
  • For medical specialist posts, clinical experience in respective specialization is required
  • Fresh graduates can also apply for positions where experience is not mandatory

Salary/Stipend

  • Junior Engineer (Electrical/Mechanical): Rs. 38,600 - 1,22,800 per month
  • Assistant Commissioner: Rs. 44,900 - 1,42,400 per month
  • Municipal Deputy Secretary: Rs. 41,600 - 1,32,300 per month
  • Assistant Law Officer: Rs. 41,600 - 1,32,300 per month
  • Biomedical Engineer: Rs. 56,900 - 1,77,500 per month
  • Surgeon/Gynecologist/Medical Specialists: Rs. 56,900 - 1,77,500 per month
  • All pay scales are as per 7th Pay Commission norms
  • Additional allowances like DA, HRA, TA and other benefits as per NMMC rules

Age Limit (as on 04/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 38 years for most posts
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC/ST Candidates: 5 years
    • OBC Candidates: 3 years
    • PWD Candidates: 10 years
    • Ex-Servicemen: As per government rules
    • Women candidates: Additional relaxation as per norms
  • Age will be calculated as on the last date of online application submission
  • Upper age limit may vary for different posts, candidates must check the official notification

Category Application Fee

  • Application fee must be paid online through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI
  • The application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 20/12/2025
Online Application Start Date (Group A - Health Cadre) 20/01/2026

Exam Fee Payment Last Date Same as application closing date
Exam Date Will be notified 7 days before exam on official website
Admit Card Release Date Will be available on NMMC website

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Computer-based test covering general knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, technical subjects related to the post, and Marathi language
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in written test will be called for document verification. Candidates must bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Personal Interview/Skill Test: For technical and specialist posts, candidates may have to appear for personal interview and/or skill test
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must undergo medical fitness test as per NMMC norms
  • Final Merit List: Final selection will be based on performance in written test, interview (if applicable) and document verification
  • Typing Test: For Clerk-Typist and similar posts, typing test in Marathi and English will be conducted

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must read the official notification carefully before applying
  • Only online applications through the official website www.nmmc.gov.in will be accepted
  • Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number which should be active during the entire recruitment process
  • Incomplete applications or applications without required documents will be rejected
  • False information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • NMMC reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage
  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply unless otherwise specified
  • Candidates already employed in government/semi-government organizations must produce NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their employer
  • Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for a period as per NMMC rules
  • The decision of NMMC in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate
  • No TA/DA will be provided for attending the exam or interview

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation at www.nmmc.gov.in
  • Step 2: On the homepage, locate the "Recruitment" or "Career" section
  • Step 3: Click on the relevant recruitment notification link for NMMC Recruitment 2025
  • Step 4: Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Online" button to start the application process
  • Step 6: Register yourself by providing basic details like name, email ID, and mobile number
  • Step 7: After registration, login using the credentials received on your email/mobile
  • Step 8: Fill the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and other required details
  • Step 9: Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and other required documents in prescribed format and size
  • Step 10: Pay the application fee online through available payment modes (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI)
  • Step 11: Review all the entered information carefully before final submission
  • Step 12: Submit the application form and take a printout of the confirmation page for future reference
  • Step 13: Keep the payment receipt and application confirmation safe until the recruitment process is complete

Ans: Eligibility varies by post. For Junior Engineer posts, Diploma in relevant engineering is required. For medical posts, MBBS with respective post-graduate qualification is mandatory. For administrative posts, Graduate degree with relevant qualifications is required.

Ans: Salary ranges from Rs. 38,600 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month depending on the post, as per 7th Pay Commission norms.

Ans: Details about negative marking will be mentioned in the exam pattern section of the official notification. Candidates should check the detailed notification before appearing for the exam.

Ans: Candidates can apply for multiple posts if they meet the eligibility criteria for each post. Separate application forms and fees must be submitted for each post.

IDBI Specialist Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026-27

Candidates who wish to apply for IDBI Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026-27 must ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria regarding age, educational qualification and post-qualification experience as on the cut-off date 01 March 2026.

IDBI Specialist Officer Age Limit 2026-27

  • Deputy General Manager (Grade D): 35 to 45 years (relaxation as per Government/Bank rules).
  • Assistant General Manager (Grade C): 28 to 40 years.
  • Manager (Grade B): 25 to 35 years.
  • Junior Assistant Manager – Security Officer (Grade O): Up to 50 years (inclusive of all relaxations).
  • Upper age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PwBD, Ex‑Servicemen and other categories is applicable as per Government/Bank guidelines.

IDBI Specialist Officer Educational Qualification & Experience 2026-27

  • Audit – Information System (IS) (Grade C): B.Tech/BE in IT/Electronics & Communications/Software Engineering/Electronics & Electrical/Electronics/Computer Science/Digital Banking or BCA/B.Sc (IT/Computer Science) or Graduate in any stream with valid CISA, or M.Sc (IT/Computer Science)/MCA/M.Tech/M.E in relevant disciplines from a recognised University, with minimum 7 years officer-level experience in BFSI/IT/Information Security consultancy, out of which 4 years in IS Audit/Cyber Security Audit/Information Security consultancy.
  • Risk Management – Information Security (Grade C & B): B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/ICT/Electronics & Communications/Electrical/Electronics & Electrical or BCA/B.Sc (IT/Computer Science) or MCA/M.Sc (IT/Computer Science) from a recognised University. Grade C: minimum 7 years experience (4 years in Information Security/Cyber Security); Grade B: minimum 4 years experience (2 years in Information Security/Cyber Security) in IT/BFSI/FinTech/Corporate entity in IT/Information Security/Cyber Security.
  • IT & MIS (Grade D/C/B): Graduate in Computer Science/IT/Electronics/Electronics & Communications/Electronics & Telecommunications/Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning/Cloud Computing/Data Science/Data Engineering or akin disciplines, or MCA/equivalent from a recognised University, with preference for candidates with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD) and relevant certifications like OCP, Data Analytics, SAS, Python, Project Management, Digital Banking, IT Security, Network etc. Grade D: minimum 10 years experience (7 years in relevant functional area) at middle management level; Grade C: minimum 7 years officer-level experience (4 years in relevant area); Grade B: minimum 4 years officer-level experience (2 years in relevant area) in BFSI/FinTech/Large IT Services organisations.
  • Security Officer – Junior Assistant Manager (Grade O): XII/Diploma pass or equivalent from recognised institutes, basic computer proficiency desirable, with minimum 15 years regular service as a Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) in Indian Army/Indian Navy/Indian Air Force and exemplary character at the time of retirement as recorded in discharge book.
  • Only full-time experience as a permanent employee is considered; training/internship/apprenticeship/teaching/trainee/retainer or staffing agency experience will not be counted.
  • IDBI Specialist Officer Selection Process 2026-27

The IDBI Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026-27 selection process will be based on shortlisting of applications as per eligibility criteria followed by further selection stages as decided by the Bank, and document verification.

Stage 1 – Shortlisting of Applications

  • Candidates must submit the online application with complete and correct details regarding age, qualification and experience.
  • IDBI Bank will shortlist applications based on information declared in the online form and eligibility criteria for the respective post/grade.
  • Candidature at this stage will be purely provisional and subject to verification of original documents at later stages.

Stage 2 – Further Selection Process (Exam/Interview/Group Process as decided)

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for the next stage of the selection process, which may include online test, personal interview or any other method as decided by the Bank (details to be notified separately on the official website).
  • Candidates must secure the required qualifying marks and meet the Bank’s criteria to be considered for final selection.

Stage 3 – Document Verification

  • Candidates provisionally shortlisted after the selection process will be called for document verification.
  • They must produce original documents/certificates related to age, educational qualification, experience, category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), PwBD, ex‑serviceman status and any other eligibility claimed in the online application.
  • Any mismatch between the online application details and original documents or failure to produce valid documents may lead to rejection of candidature.

The final selection list for IDBI Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026-27 will be prepared subject to successful document verification and fulfilment of all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date.

  • Deputy General Manager, Grade ‘D’: 102300-2980(4)- 114220-3360(2)- 120940 (7 years) Gross emolument for metro cities will be ₹197000/- per month (approx.)
  • Assistant General Manager, Grade ‘C’: 85920-2680(5)-99320-2980(2)-105280 (8 years) Gross emolument for metro cities will be ₹164000/- per month (approx.)
  • Manager – Grade ‘B’: 64820-2340(1)-67160-2680 (10)-93960 (12 years) Gross emolument for metro cities will be ₹124000/- per month (approx.)
  • Junior Assistant Manager– Grade ’O’: Cost to Company (CTC) basis would range between ₹6.14 lakh to ₹6.50 lakh (Class A city) at the time of joining. Annual increment shall be granted based on performance or any other parameters as decided by the Bank from time to time.

IDBI Specialist Officer Application Fee 2026-27

Candidates applying for IDBI Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026-27 are required to pay the prescribed application fee/intimation charges through online mode while submitting the application form. The exact fee for each category (General/OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD) is mentioned in the fee section of the official notification.

Note: The application fee/intimation charges must be paid through online payment modes as enabled on the IDBI Bank website. The registration process is considered complete only after the fee is successfully paid on or before the last date. Fee once paid is non‑refundable under any circumstances.

How to Apply for IDBI Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026-27

The application process for IDBI Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026-27 is completely online through the official website of IDBI Bank.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of IDBI Bank at https://www.idbibank.in and open the “Careers” → “Current Openings” section.
  • Step 2: Click on the link for Advertisement No. 8/2025-26 – Recruitment of Specialist Officer (FY 2026-27) and read the detailed notification carefully.

  • Step 5: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as mentioned in the notification.
  • Step 6: Pay the applicable application fee/intimation charges using online payment modes such as net banking, debit/credit card, UPI, etc. on or before 08 April 2026.
  • Step 7: Verify all the details entered in the IDBI Specialist Officer application form carefully; no changes will be permitted after final submission.

Vacancy Details: DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

This recruitment targets regional needs, with language proficiency (Tamil for Puducherry/Karaikal, Telugu for Mahe/Yanam) as a must. Total tentative vacancies: 36 for ANM (Level 4), broken down by region and reservation:

Region Total
Puducherry & Karaikal (Tamil) 36*

*Grand Total: 36 (subject to change). Reservations follow Puducherry norms; PwBD categories include low vision, hearing impairment, locomotor disabilities, etc. Refer to the PDF for inter-se exchanges.

Eligibility Criteria: DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

DHFWS ensures accessible criteria with relaxations for reserved groups—review these to confirm your fit.

Educational Qualification

Pass in 12th Std. (HSC) or equivalent, plus Diploma in Multipurpose Health Worker (Female)/Auxiliary Nurse Midwife from a recognized institution. Must hold permanent registration as a Midwife from any State Nursing Council in India. Regional language (Tamil/Telugu/Malayalam) studied up to SSLC level required.

Age Limit

18-30 years as of March 8, 2026. Relaxations: 3 years (MBC/OBC/EBC/BCM), 5 years (SC), military service +3 years (Ex-Servicemen), 10 years (PwBD, plus category relaxations), up to 35/40 years (widows/divorced/judicially separated women, General/SC).

Experience

No prior experience needed—open to freshers. Seniority marks (up to 15) awarded for Employment Exchange registration post-Diploma.

Nativity: Must be UT native/resident for 5+ years; fresh certificate required on selection.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern: DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

Merit-driven and transparent, with no written exam—focus on your academics and registration history.

Selection Process

  1. Merit List: Based on 50% HSC marks + 50% Diploma marks (deduct 5% per extra attempt) + up to 15 seniority marks (1.5/year from Diploma registration in Employment Exchange).
  2. Total Score: Out of 115 marks.
  3. Wait List: Valid 1 year for unfilled spots.
  4. Certificate Verification: For provisionally selected candidates.

Exam Pattern

No exam; purely marks-based computation. Ties resolved by: Diploma marks > HSC marks > Date of birth (older preferred) > Alphabetical order. Regional language knowledge verified for placement.

How to Apply Online: Step-by-Step Guide for DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

Online-only initial submission; follow promptly to meet the March 8 deadline.

  1. Visit https://recruitment.py.gov.in, register with mobile number for Username/Password via SMS.
  2. Log in, select ANM post, fill personal/educational/category details; change default password.
  3. Upload photo/signature: Option 1 (single A4 scan, 200 DPI, <150KB) or Option 2 (separate JPEGs: Photo 238x306px <50KB, Signature 350x150px <30KB). Recent photo essential.
  4. Preview form, submit—corrections allowed till March 8 (3 PM).

Indian Navy Agniveer (MR/Musician) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification: Candidate must have passed Matriculation Examination with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from the Boards of School Education recognised by Ministry of Education, Govt. of India.

Age Limit: Born between 01 Jul 2004 – 31 Dec 2008 (both dates inclusive).

Marital Status: Only unmarried male and unmarried female candidates are eligible. Candidates will have to give a certificate of being 'unmarried' at the time of enrolment. Agniveers shall not be permitted to marry during their entire tenure of four years. Marriage during tenure will result in dismissal.

Musical Ability: The candidate should have proficiency and aptitude for music with accuracy in tempo, pitch and singing one complete song. He/She should also have actual practical skill on any instrument of Indian or foreign origin with proficiency in tuning of instrument, matching unknown notes with instrument, prepared piece, sight reading of Indian Classical/Tablature/Staff Notation, performance of Scale/Raaga/Taala and basic theory of Indian or International music.

Type of Instruments on which Proficiency Required: Candidates would be required to perform with expertise on one or more instruments such as Keyboard/String/Wind instruments or any other instrument of Indian or foreign origin. Candidates performing on indefinite pitch instruments such as Jazz Drum set, Bass Drum, Snare Drums, Side Drums, Cymbals, Non Chromatic instruments such as bugle & monotone instruments used to produce only one note or drone will not be eligible.

Musical Experience Certificate:

  • Candidates performing Hindustani or Carnatic Classical music on wind instruments will require a musical experience certificate from any recognized musical institute or organisation of repute.
  • A certificate of minimum initial grade from international boards such as Trinity College of Music, London or Royal School of Music London etc., will be mandatory for candidates performing western notation or western music on wind instruments.
  • Other candidates will be required to submit certificates of participation/awards presented at various events.

Physical Standards:

  • Minimum Height: 157 cm (Male & Female)
  • Visual Standards: 6/12, 6/12 (Uncorrected) | 6/6, 6/6 (Corrected) | CP Pass

Indian Navy Agniveer (MR/Musician) Recruitment 2026 Pay, Allowances & Benefits

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent degree in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution / Board.
  • Essential Qualification: Adequate knowledge in basic Computer skill with certification.
  • Other Conditions:
    • Candidate must be a citizen of India and a domicile of the State of Odisha.
    • Must be able to speak, read and write Odia and shall have Odia as a language subject in the H.S.C. Examination or an equivalent examination, or be declared to have passed a test in Odia language equivalent to the Middle School Standard.
    • Candidates possessing academic qualifications from Universities / Institutions / Councils / Boards outside Odisha must produce proof of equivalence from any recognized University / Institution / Council / Board of the State of Odisha, and affiliation of the institution to a recognized University/Council/Board.
    • Candidates furnishing certificates and mark-sheets with grades / grade-points must furnish numerical equivalence from the examining body, failing which they shall not be considered eligible.
    • Government servants having requisite educational qualification and within the prescribed age limit, whether temporary or permanent, are eligible to apply, provided they inform their respective head of office in writing and produce a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer before the date of document verification.

Salary / Stipend

  • Pay Scale for all posts (Junior Assistant & Junior Clerk): Group-C, Level-4, Cell-1
  • Junior Assistants in Government Degree Colleges, NCC, and BSE are posted as Government employees.
  • Junior Assistants in State Public Universities and OUHS are posted in Autonomous Body status.
  • Junior Clerks in Non-Govt. Aided Colleges are posted under Non-Govt. Aided Colleges status.
  • Note: HRA, encashment of unutilized leave, and a few other incentives are not available to Non-Govt. Aided Colleges employees.
  • All persons appointed shall not be eligible for pension as defined under Odisha Civil Service (Pension) Rules, 1992; but shall be covered by the defined Contributory Pension Scheme in accordance with the Odisha Civil Service (Pension) Amendment Rules, 2005.

 Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 Years
  • Maximum Age: 42 Years (candidate must have been born not earlier than 1st January 1984 and not later than 1st January 2005)
  • SC / ST / SEBC / Women / Ex-Servicemen: Upper age relaxable by 5 years (up to 47 years)
  • PwD candidates (permanent disability of 40% and above): Upper age relaxable by 10 years
  • PwD belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories: Cumulative age relaxation of 15 years
  • A candidate coming under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of relaxation, which shall be considered most beneficial to him/her.
  • PwD category with temporary disability will not avail age relaxation and will not be considered for subsequent selection processes.
  • Date of Birth mentioned in the High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board / Council will only be accepted as age proof.

Application Fee

  • Unreserved (UR) / SEBC Category: Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) – Non-refundable and non-adjustable
  • Scheduled Tribe (ST) / Scheduled Caste (SC) / PwD Category: Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred only) – Non-refundable and non-adjustable
  • Mode of Payment: Online through SB Collect only. The link for SB Collect payment gateway is available in the online application form. Any other mode of payment will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Bank Account Details of SSB for Payment:
    Account No: 35396835756, State Bank of India, Govt. Treasury Branch, Bhubaneswar
    IFS Code: SBIN0009025
  • In case of non-payment of examination fee / application fee, the application form will be rejected.
  • After successful payment, the candidate will be able to download the application form from the SSB website after 48 hours.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Date 09/03/2026
Opening Date & Time of Online Application 11/03/2026 at 02:30 PM
Closing Date & Time of Online Applications & Online Payment 13/04/2026 at 11:45 PM
Age Reckoning Date 01/01/2026
Written Test Date To be announced
Computer Skill Test Date To be announced (held at Bhubaneswar)
Document Verification Date To be announced

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on performance in Written Test and Computer Skill Test – Total 250 Marks.
  • Written Test: 200 Marks (100 Questions, Multiple Choice type, answered on carbonless OMR Answer Sheets, duration: 2 hours)
    • General English up to Graduation Level – 60 Marks
    • General Knowledge and Current Affairs – 40 Marks
    • General Mathematics up to HSC Standard – 40 Marks
    • Reasoning & Mental Ability – 60 Marks
  • Computer Skill Test: 50 Marks (1 hour duration; minimum qualifying mark: 20 marks for all categories)
  • For each correct answer, 2 marks will be awarded; for each wrong answer, negative marking of 0.50 mark.
  • Qualifying marks in Written Examination: 40% for Unreserved category candidates; 30% for SC/ST/SEBC & PwD categories.
  • On the basis of the Written Test performance, candidates will be shortlisted two times the vacancy (category-wise & sub-category-wise for PwD) for the Computer Skill Test.
  • Candidates who qualify both the Written Test and Computer Skill Test shall be called for Document Verification at the SSB office.
  • For final selection, the marks secured in the Written Test and Computer Skill Test taken together shall be considered for candidates who have successfully completed the document verification process.
  • In case of a tie after the Written Test (for shortlisting for Computer Skill Test), merit position will be decided based on aggregate percentage of marks in Bachelor's Degree (up to 2 decimal). A further tie will be resolved by date of birth (earlier born preferred).
  • The final merit list will be prepared as per vacancy of the posts advertised category-wise and sub-category-wise.
  • SSB will prepare the final merit list and submit it to HED for counselling of university-wise Junior Assistants, Govt. Colleges, NCC, and district-wise Junior Clerk in Non-Government Aided Colleges.
  • Zone of Examination: Written Test will be held at 5 zones – Balasore, Berhampur, Bhubaneswar, Jeypore, and Sambalpur (depending on number of candidates per zone).
  • Computer Skill Test and Document Verification will be conducted at Bhubaneswar.
  • Scribe facility and compensatory time shall be allowed to PwD candidates having 40% or above permanent disability. The PwD candidate must arrange their own scribe and provide scribe information in the prescribed format available on the SSB website.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online through the link available on the official website of State Selection Board, Odisha: www.ssbodisha.ac.in
  • Read the detailed INSTRUCTIONS carefully before filling up the Online Application Form.
  • Enter the percentage of aggregate marks secured in Under-graduate (+3) degree, converting CGPA as per the conversion formula of the respective degree-awarding University/Institution.
  • Upload the latest passport size photograph (taken within fifteen days before the submission of application), scanned image of full signature, and left-hand thumb impression – all must be clearly identifiable/visible. Failure to do so will result in rejection of application.
  • Deposit the requisite application fee online through SB Collect only. In case of non-payment, the application form will be rejected. Ensure the Application ID No. allotted to you is entered correctly during payment.
  • After successful payment, the candidate can download the application form from the SSB website after 48 hours. Keep this form for future reference and during document verification.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application form well within the timeline without waiting for the closing date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • There is no edit option after final submission of the online application form. Candidates are advised to be very careful while filling up the form.
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (02:30 PM) to 13.04.2026 (11:45 PM).

MCL Technician, Mining Sirdar and Other Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL)
Post Name Jr. Overman T&S Gr-C, Mining Sirdar T&S Gr-C, Surveyor T&S Gr-B, Translator (Tr.) OL Clerical Gr. III, Technician (Pathology) Tr. T&S Gr-C
No of Posts 667
Advt No MCL/HQ/Recruitment/Statutory/2026/120
Salary Rs. 41,966.51 PM to Rs. 51,103.12 PM (Basic Pay – NCWA-XI)
Qualification Diploma/Degree in Mining Engineering, Valid Statutory Certificates, B.A. with Hindi & English, Diploma in Pathology – as per post
Age Limit 18 years to 30 years (as on 06/04/2026)
Start Date for Apply 16/03/2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date for Apply 06/04/2026 (11:50 PM)
Official Website mahanadicoal.in

MCL Technician, Mining Sirdar and Other Vacancy 2026 Details 

Name of Post Basic Pay (NCWA-XI) Total

Eligibility Criteria

Jr. Overman, T&S Gr-C – Essential Qualifications:

  • Diploma in Mining Engineering of 03 years duration or Degree in Mining Engineering or other equivalent qualifications approved in that behalf by the Central Government from any recognized Institute.
  • Valid Overman Competency Certificate (Un-Restricted) issued by Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS) under Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both Open Cast (OC) & Under Ground (UG) Mines or any other certificate in Mining which entitle to work as Overman as per Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both OC & UG Mines.
  • Valid First Aid Certificate.
  • Valid Gas Testing Certificate.

Mining Sirdar, T&S Gr-C – Essential Qualifications:

  • Senior Secondary school examination or intermediate examination (10+2) or equivalent Examination from any recognized Board of Examination OR Diploma in Mining Engineering of 03 years duration or Degree in Mining Engineering or other equivalent qualifications approved in that behalf by the Central Government from any recognized Institute.
  • Valid Mining Sirdarship Certificate of Competency (Un-Restricted) from DGMS under Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both Open Cast (OC) & Under Ground (UG) Mines or any other certificate of Competency in Mining which entitle the applicant to work as Mining Sirdar as per Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both OC & UG Mines.
  • Valid First Aid Certificate.
  • Valid Gas Testing Certificate.

Surveyor, T&S Gr-B – Essential Qualifications:

  • Senior Secondary school examination or intermediate examination (10+2) or equivalent Examination from any recognized Board of Examination OR Diploma in Mining/Mine Surveying Engineering of 03 years duration or Degree in Mining/Mine Surveying Engineering or other equivalent qualifications approved in that behalf by the Central Government from any recognized Institute.
  • Valid Survey Certificate of Competency (Un-Restricted) granted by Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS) as per Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both Open Cast (OC) & Under Ground (UG) Mines.

Translator (Tr.) OL Clerical Gr. III – Essential Qualifications:

  • B.A. or equivalent with Hindi & English.
  • Govt. Diploma Holder in Hindi Translation preferred.

Technician (Pathology) Tr. T&S Gr-C – Essential Qualifications:

  • Diploma in Pathology from an Institute recognized by the Government.

Salary/Stipend

  • Jr. Overman T&S Gr-C: Basic Pay Rs. 47,330.25 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.
  • Mining Sirdar T&S Gr-C: Basic Pay Rs. 47,330.25 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.
  • Surveyor T&S Gr-B: Basic Pay Rs. 51,103.12 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.
  • Translator (Tr.) OL Clerical Gr. III: Basic Pay Rs. 41,966.51 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.
  • Technician (Pathology) Tr. T&S Gr-C: Basic Pay Rs. 47,330.25 per month (NCWA-XI). Besides basic pay, the post carries other allowances and fringe benefits as per Company's Rules/National Coal Wage Agreement-XI.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 18 years as on 06/04/2026.
  • Maximum Age: 30 years as on 06/04/2026 for General (UR) & EWS category candidates.
  • The Cut-Off date for determining Age Limit Criteria will be the last date of receipt of application i.e. 06/Apr/2026.
  • The Actual upper Age Limit of the applicant (except Departmental candidates) on the crucial date i.e. 06/Apr/2026 shall not exceed 56 years.
  • There will be no age bar for Departmental candidates i.e. any employee of CIL & its subsidiary companies having the requisite qualification.
  • Age Relaxation:
    • UR / EWS: No relaxation
    • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Central List: 03 years
    • SC / ST: 05 years
    • Ex-Servicemen (ESM): Actual period of service rendered in defence services + 3 years
    • Departmental Candidates (all employees of CIL & its subsidiary companies): No upper age limit
    • Persons with Disabilities (Only for Translator OL and Technician Pathology): By 10 years for General (UR) candidate, By 13 years for OBC-NCL candidate, By 15 years for SC/ST candidates

Application Fee

  • General (UR) / OBC (Creamy Layer & Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS candidates: Rs. 1,000/- plus applicable GST – Rs. 180/- totalling Rs. 1,180/- (Non-Refundable).
  • Exempted Categories: SC / ST / PwBD / ESM / Female candidates / Employees of Coal India Limited and its Subsidiaries are exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Application fee can be paid through online mode only i.e. Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking etc. There will be no other mode of payment of application fee.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are therefore advised to verify their eligibility conditions before applying.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification / Advertisement Date 21/02/2026
Starting Date of Online Application & Payment Gateway 16/03/2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 06/04/2026 (11:50 PM)
Cut-off Date for Age & Eligibility 06/04/2026
Tentative Date of Downloading Admit Card for Eligible Candidates Will be notified in the website
Tentative Date of Computer Based Test (CBT) Will be notified in the website
Tentative Date of Declaration of Results Will be notified in the website

Selection Process

  • The Selection methodology will comprise of Computer Based Test (CBT) only. No personal interview will be held.
  • Eligible Candidates, as declared by them, will be provisionally called for Computer Based Test (CBT) on the basis of their declaration regarding their eligibility such as age, educational/technical qualification, Valid Statutory Certificate etc. as laid down in this notification/advertisement.
  • The CBT will comprise of objective type questions with multiple choice of answers and there will be no negative marking for wrong answers. The instructions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi).
  • The CBT will consist of two sections i.e. "A" & "B". Section "A" will comprise question specific to General Awareness/Aptitude and will comprise 20 questions of "One" mark each. Section "B" of the test paper will comprise questions relating to Technical knowledge and will comprise 80 questions of "One" mark each, with a total of 100 marks.
  • Qualifying marks (CBT): General/EWS candidates – 45 marks (i.e. 45% of 100); OBC(NCL) candidates – 40 Marks (i.e. 40% of 100); SC/ST candidates – 35 marks (35% of 100).
  • Based on the merit order of marks secured by the candidates in CBT, the shortlisted qualified candidates in the ratio of 1:3 will be called for document verification.
  • In case of a tie of marks obtained in the CBT, it will be resolved on the basis of Date of Birth (elder one being the first) and thereafter Name alphabets.
  • Successful shortlisted candidates will be notified to appear for scrutiny of their testimonials through the website of MCL. Candidates shall have to appear along with all original certificates/documents & photocopies thereof as per eligibility criteria notified in this advertisement.
  • Those who are working in Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/CIL & Subsidiaries etc. must have to produce "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of documents/certificates verification.
  • After verification of documents/certificates, 'Provisional Select List' of successful candidates will be published in the official website of MCL (https://mahanadicoal.in).
  • Finally, provisionally selected candidates will be issued offer of appointment based on their position in the merit list and with due consideration of the reservation policy of Govt. of India for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS/ESM. They have to undergo Initial Medical Examination (IME) by company's own doctors & their findings thereon will be final. Those who are found UNFIT, will be disqualified for employment.
  • The validity of the merit panel will be for 01 year or as per extant Govt. guidelines.
  • Exact schedule of CBT will be displayed on MCL website (https://mahanadicoal.in) in due course.

How to Apply

  • The candidates shall apply through online mode available on MCL website https://mahanadicoal.in only under CAREERS >>>> Recruitment section as per the qualification and eligibility criteria indicated above. No other means/mode of application will be accepted.
  • Before filling-up of the online application, keep the following details/documents/information ready: E-Mail ID, Mobile No., Personal and Educational qualification details, Scanned Copy of Matriculation (X) Certificate/Mark sheets/diploma/degree Mark sheets (in Jpg/Jpeg/PDF format), Scanned Copy of valid Caste Certificate for OBC (NCL)/SC/ST candidates and Income Certificates for EWS candidates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of Ex-Servicemen Certificates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of PwBD Certificates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of competency certificate of Mining Sirdar/Overman/Surveyor, Gas testing & First Aid certificate (in Jpg/Jpeg/PDF format), Details of Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking for making application fee, Scanned Copy of candidates' Recent Photograph (not more than 3 weeks old in jpg/jpeg format), Scanned Copy of candidates' Signature with Black ink pen (in jpg/jpeg format).
  • Read Important Instructions and Click on (√) 'I Agree' Button.
  • Register by filling up necessary details (Post opted, name, Mobile No. and e-mail ID and click on Submit Button).
  • Check Application Sequence No., User ID & Password received on your e-mail and mobile number.
  • Re-login to your account by entering User ID and password received through e-mail.
  • Click on the option to go to Application Form and fill all the necessary details in the respective field and upload documents, Photo and Signature.
  • Check Preview of the Application Form and make corrections, if any.
  • Press Submit Button.
  • Make Online payment through Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking (as applicable).
  • Take Print out of application form for future record.
  • The last date for submission of application is 06/Apr/2026 up to 11:50 PM.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

The candidate must be a citizen of India.

Educational Qualification

  • Must possess a BDS or equivalent Degree from a Medical College or Medical Institution recognized by the Dental Council of India (DCI).
  • Must possess a valid Registration Certificate under the Dentist Act, 1948.
  • Candidates having degrees from foreign universities must possess required Conversion Certificates recognized by DCI.

Additional Requirements

  • Houseman-ship/Internship Completion Certificate
  • Certificate relating to passing of the screening test conducted by the National Board of Examinations (for candidates from foreign universities)
  • Odia language test pass certificate, or must pass the required Odia examination within 4 years of joining service

Odia Language Requirement

Candidate must be able to read, write, and speak Odia and must have fulfilled any one of the following:

  • Passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject; OR
  • Passed Matriculation or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subject; OR
  • Passed in Odia as language subject in the final examination of Class-VII or above; OR
  • Passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department.

Proviso: If a candidate has not passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject, he/she shall be required to pass the examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Odisha within 4 years of joining service. Failing this, no further increment will be sanctioned and promotion to Group-A (Senior Branch) will not be allowed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • Candidate must not have been born earlier than 02 January 1984 and not later than 01 January 2005.

Age Relaxation

Category Upper Age Limit Relaxation
SEBC 5 years
SC 5 years
ST 5 years
Women candidates 5 years
Ex-Servicemen 5 years
PwBD (40% or more permanent disability) 10 years
PwBD belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories 15 years (cumulative benefit)
  • A candidate who comes under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of upper age relaxation, whichever is more beneficial.
  • Exception: PwBD candidates belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories shall be eligible for 15 years cumulative age relaxation.
  • Date of birth in High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board/Council will only be accepted.
  • Save as provided above, the age limits prescribed can in no case be relaxed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Salary & Pay Scale

Selected candidates will be appointed in Level-12, Cell-1 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 and will also be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA) and other admissible allowances as sanctioned by the Government from time to time.

  • Refunds will be processed to the original mode of payment used at the time of transaction.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the online application form for refund in case of technical glitches.
  • Bank account must remain valid and active. The Commission will not entertain correspondence regarding incorrect bank details.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Selection Process

The selection shall be made on the basis of a Written Test as per the Odisha Medical Services (Method of Recruitment and Conditions of Service of Dental Surgeons) Rules, 2022 along with Amendment Rules, 2025.

Merit List Preparation

  • The Commission shall prepare a list of candidates in order of merit on the basis of the Written Test equal to the number of advertised vacancies.

UPSSSC AGTA Selection Process 2026

The UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises shortlisting on the basis of UPSSSC PET 2025 scores, a mains written examination and document verification. Only PET 2025 qualified candidates will be allowed to appear in the UPSSSC AGTA mains exam.

Stage 1 – Shortlisting through UPSSSC PET 2025

  • Candidates must have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard to apply for the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C mains examination.
  • UPSSSC will prepare a list of eligible candidates for AGTA mains based on PET 2025 scores, reservation rules and post‑wise vacancy distribution.
  • Only shortlisted candidates, as per the criteria given in the official notification, will be permitted to fill the UPSSSC AGTA mains online form and appear for the written exam.

Stage 2 – UPSSSC AGTA Mains Written Examination 2026

  • The mains written exam for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant Group C will be an objective type paper covering agriculture and related subjects as per the prescribed syllabus.
  • The question paper will carry a fixed number of questions and marks (details like total marks, duration and negative marking will be as per the official AGTA notification).
  • Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks and rank high in the merit list to be considered for the next stage of the selection process.

Stage 3 – Document Verification

  • Candidates shortlisted on the basis of performance in the AGTA mains written exam will be called for document verification (DV).
  • During DV, candidates must produce original documents and certificates related to age, educational qualification, category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), domicile, PET 2025 score, and other eligibility criteria.
  • Failure to produce valid documents or any discrepancy in information can lead to cancellation of candidature for UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026.

The final selection list for UPSSSC AGTA Recruitment 2026 will be prepared purely on the basis of marks obtained in the mains written examination, subject to successful document verification and fulfilment of all eligibility conditions.

How to Apply for UPSSSC AGTA / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026

The application process for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Only candidates who have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 registration and score can fill the UPSSSC AGTA online form 2026 on the official website upsssc.gov.in.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission at upsssc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: On the home page, click on the “Notifications/Advertisements” section and open the link for Advt. No. 06-Exam/2026 – Technical Assistant Group C (AGTA) Recruitment 2026.
  • Step 3: Read the UPSSSC AGTA Notification 2026 carefully, then click on the “Apply” or “Candidate Registration” link given against the advertisement.
  • Step 4: Log in using your UPSSSC PET 2025 Registration Number, date of birth and other required details; the system will fetch your basic data from the PET database.
  • Step 5: Fill the UPSSSC AGTA online application form 2026 with category, educational qualification, agriculture degree details, reservation information and other required fields.
  • Step 6: Upload your recent passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as mentioned in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C notification.
  • Step 7: Pay the UPSSSC AGTA application fee of ₹25 (for all categories) using the available online payment options such as net banking, debit/credit card, SBI I‑Collect or e‑challan.
  • Step 8: Review all the details entered in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C application form carefully, then submit the form and take a printout of the final submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

Candidates should complete the UPSSSC AGTA Online Form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.

  • Stage 2 – Main Written Examination: 100 objective/MCQ questions, 100 marks, 2 hours duration. Negative marking: 25% (¼ mark deducted per wrong answer).

UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services (Graduate Level) Recruitment 2026 selection will be based on a Written Main Examination (Likhit Pariksha).

Main Examination (Written Test – 100 Marks, 2 Hours): There will be one question paper containing 100 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks with a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). There is negative marking of 1/4 (25%) of prescribed marks for each wrong answer.

Eligible candidates for UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services Recruitment 2026 must apply online through the official UPSSSC portal before the last date.

Step 1 – Login via PET-2025 Registration Number: Visit upsssc.gov.in and login using your PET-2025 Registration Number and OTP sent to the registered mobile number/email. Only PET-2025 registered candidates can apply.

Step 2 – Select Posts and Fill Application: Your personal details from PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. Select the post(s) you wish to apply for, verify eligibility, and fill in all educational qualification, community, and other details carefully.

Step 3 – Enter Post Preference: In the "Other Details" section, enter your post and department preference priority and indicate preferential/additional qualification details (if applicable).

Step 4 – Verify Photo and Signature: Your photo and signature uploaded in PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. No changes can be made. Click Continue to proceed.

Step 5 – Pay Application Fee: Pay Rs.25/- via Credit Card, Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or SBI e-Challan. After successful payment, your application form will be auto-submitted. Download and print the application form immediately.

Step 6 – Fee Reconciliation & Amendment: If required, reconcile fee and amend permissible details (correspondence address, EWS/horizontal reservation category, educational qualification, marital status) on the Applicant's Dashboard by 25 June 2026. IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Supervisor (Assay/T.O.-Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy): Candidates must possess a 1st class full-time Diploma in Engineering in the relevant stream (Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy) from a recognized institution, or higher qualification i.e. B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. (Engineering) in the relevant discipline.

  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).

Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).

Vacancy Details

High Court of Allahabad has announced the recruitment of Special Judicial Magistrates for two districts in Uttar Pradesh. These positions are on a fixed honorarium basis with conveyance allowance. The recruitment is open for Government servants or former Government employees who possess legal qualifications or have extensive experience in legal affairs.

District Vacancy Position
Gonda 1 Special Judicial Magistrate
Jalaun (Orai) 1 Special Judicial Magistrate

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Status: Must be a Government servant (current or former) OR has held any post under the Government of India/State Government/Union Territory
  • Educational Qualification: Must possess:
    • Law degree (LL.B. from a recognized university), OR
    • Be well-experienced in relation to legal affairs to the satisfaction of the High Court
  • Professional Background: Experience in legal matters, judicial work, or administrative/legal roles under Government is an advantage

Term & Age

  • Term of Office: 4 years from the date of assumption of charge OR attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier
  • Age Limit: No specific upper age limit mentioned, but term ends at age 70
  • Transferability: A candidate appointed for a specific district shall NOT be transferred to any other district under any circumstances

Previous SJM/SMM Experience

  • Ex-SJMs appointed by Government of Uttar Pradesh do NOT need to submit character roll entries
  • Ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment must enclose four best judgments delivered while holding the post of SJM/SMM

Event Date

Selection Process Merit-based by High Court
