Selection Process

  • Application Scrutiny: All applications are submitted to the respective District Judge who conducts preliminary scrutiny
  • District Judge Review: The District Judge reviews applications and forwards only those he finds fit for the SJM post to the High Court with his remarks
  • High Court Evaluation: The High Court evaluates forwarded applications based on qualifications, experience, and legal expertise
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection is based on merit, qualifications, Government service record, and experience in legal matters
  • Final Appointment: Appointment is made by the High Court through formal order of the Court

Salary/Remuneration

  • Fixed Honorarium: ₹45,000/- per month (fixed, subject to correction and updation by High Court)
  • Conveyance Allowance: ₹5,000/- per month for official travel and conveyance
  • Total Monthly Remuneration: ₹50,000/- per month (base honorarium + conveyance)
  • Payment: Subject to correction and updation from time to time as per High Court guidelines

How to Apply

Application Preparation

  1. Download the Application Form from the official High Court notification PDF
  2. Fill all columns of the application form in block letters (all columns are compulsory)
  3. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph
  4. Provide complete and accurate information including:

Download Ordnance Factory Kanpur Recruitment 2026 Application Form

Salary

  • For all tenure-based ITI posts (Machinist and other trades), the consolidated monthly salary is based on Basic Pay of Rs 18,000 at 7th CPC Level‑1 plus applicable Dearness Allowance (DA) as per Government rules.

  • The pay is treated as consolidated for contract employees, and an annual increase of 3% on the Basic Pay is admissible during the tenure, subject to satisfactory performance in half‑yearly evaluations.

  • Remuneration is calculated at the rate of 1/30th of Basic Pay plus DA for 8 hours of work per day, and proportionate deductions are made for unauthorised leave or absence; contract personnel are also eligible for company holidays at par with regular employees.

  • If company quarters are not provided, HRA is payable, and where quarters are allotted, licence fee is deducted at rates applicable to regular workmen.

Selection Process

  • Selection for all 151 tenure-based ITI posts is purely merit-based, combining NCTVT/NCVT marks and Trade/Practical Test performance.

  • First, candidates are shortlisted for Trade/Practical Test on the basis of total marks obtained in the NCTVT/NCVT exam; the cut‑off percentage for calling candidates is decided by Ordnance Factory Kanpur.

  • A Trade/Practical Test is then conducted for the relevant trade (Machinist, Examiner, Electrician, etc.) at Ordnance Factory Kanpur to assess hands‑on skills.

  • The final merit list is prepared using combined scores with 80% weightage to NCTVT/NCVT exam marks and 20% weightage to the Trade/Practical Test.

  • Candidates placed in merit are called for Document Verification, where all original certificates and eligibility conditions are checked; if some candidates are rejected at this stage, additional candidates in order of merit may be called until all notified posts are covered.

Application Fees

  • The application fee is Rs 100 per candidate, to be paid via Demand Draft in favour of “ORDNANCE FACTORY KANPUR” for both advertisements.

  • SC/ST, Ex‑Servicemen and Physically Handicapped (PwD) candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

  • The fee must be enclosed with the offline application form in the prescribed manner; applications without the required fee (where applicable) are liable to be rejected.

How to Apply Ordnance Factory Kanpur Recruitment 2026 (151 Posts)

  • Applications are accepted offline only for all 151 tenure-based ITI posts under Ordnance Factory Kanpur Recruitment 2026.

  • Candidates must download and print the prescribed application form format from the official notice section of the AWEIL website (aweil.in/notice) as given in the two recruitment advertisements for 116 Machinist posts and 35 trades posts.

  • Fill the application form in block letters, carefully entering personal details, educational qualifications (10th and NTC/NAC), trade applied for, category, and contact details as required in the format.

  • Attach self-attested copies of:

    • Class 10th certificate/marksheet (as proof of date of birth)

    • NTC/NAC certificate in the relevant trade

    • Caste/category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD), Ex‑serviceman documents, etc., if applicable

    • Any other documents specified in the notifications.

  • Paste the required photograph on the form and enclose two extra self‑attested passport-size photographs as instructed.

  • Prepare the application fee Demand Draft of Rs 100 (where applicable) in favour of “ORDNANCE FACTORY KANPUR”; SC/ST, Ex‑Servicemen and PwD candidates are exempt from the fee.

  • Place the filled form, DD and documents in an envelope clearly superscribed with the relevant post, for example:

    • “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF MACHINIST (SS) ON CONTRACT BASIS” (for 116 Machinist posts), or

    • “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ‘TRADE NAME’ ON CONTRACT BASIS” (for Examiner, Electrician, etc.).

  • Send the envelope by post to: The Chief General Manager,Ordnance Factory Kanpur,Kalpi Road, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh – 208009, ensuring it reaches on or before 08 April 2026; applications received after the last date or incomplete/unsigned are liable to be rejected.

  • Qualifications (Post 04 – Shaareerik Roop se Aksham Vidyalay Teacher):

    • Exam Plan:
      • Part-1: Introduction to Disability (25 Marks) + Child Development & Learning (20 Marks) + Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (20 Marks)
      • Part-2: Knowledge of Concepts of Computer and IT and Contemporary Technological Development (15 Marks)
      • Part-3: General Information related to the State of Uttar Pradesh (20 Marks)
      • Total: 100 Questions – 100 Marks
    • Shortlisting for Written Exam will be based on normalized score of PET-2025 (15 times the number of advertised posts).
  • Stage 2 – Qualifying Exam (Skill Test):

The selection process varies by post code:

    • Stage 3 – Skill Test (Go/No-Go basis): Up to 5 times the number of vacancies shortlisted from Stage 2. Candidates clearing Skill Test empanelled in order of Stage 2 merit.

  3. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post.
  4. Keep the following documents ready in PDF format for uploading:
    • SSC/10th Standard Certificate
    • HSC/12th Certificate
    • Qualifying certificate (Degree/Diploma/Certificate for respective post)
    • Registration Certificate (as applicable)
    • Caste/PwBD/EWS certificate (if applicable)
    • Experience/Training certificate (as applicable)
    • Application fee payment receipt (if applicable)
    • Passport-size photograph (JPEG, 165×125 pixels, max 50 KB, white background)
    • Signature (JPEG, 80×125 pixels, max 20 KB)
  5. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through BharatKosh/NTRP before initiating the online application.
  6. Fill all details in the online application form correctly as per Matriculation certificate.
  7. Enter fee payment details in the 'Details of Fee Paid' column and submit the application before 18 April 2026 (17:00 hrs).
  8. A copy of the submitted application will be sent to your registered email ID in PDF format – preserve it till the selection process is completed.

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by concerned Regulatory Authorities in India.
  • Only one application per post; separate applications required for each post if applying for multiple posts.
  • After final submission, no request for change/correction will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies must submit NOC at the time of Interview/Skill Test.
  • SC/ST outstation candidates called for Tests/Interview/Skill Test will be reimbursed to-and-fro sleeper class/second-class railway fare by shortest route (subject to production of tickets); fare for first 30 km shall be borne by candidates.
  • Appointment is subject to Medical fitness conducted by NFC.
  • Selected candidates will be governed by National Pension System (NPS) or Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as notified by the Government.
  • Select list/Wait list validity is one year from the date of publication of results.
  • Candidates must regularly check https://www.nfc.gov.in for all updates; no information will be sent by post/courier.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the Courts having jurisdiction in Hyderabad only.
  • Beware of fraudulent recruitment advertisements forging NFC/DAE name/logo; NFC does not ask for any payment other than the prescribed application fee.
  • For any clarification, contact: [email protected] (with Registration Number, registered email ID, mobile number, name, date of birth, and post applied for).

HVF Avadi Apprentice Vacancy 2026-27 Details

The HVF Avadi Apprenticeship Notification 2026-27 announces a total of 450 Apprenticeship seats across Graduate, Diploma and Non-Engineering streams with one year training duration.

Reservation of vacancies for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates will be as per Apprentices Act guidelines, and candidates claiming reservation must produce valid certificates in the prescribed format, otherwise they will be considered under General category.

  • Declaration of shortlisted candidates list: 30.04.2026
  • Certificate verification for shortlisted candidates at HVF Avadi: 06.05.2026 to 08.05.2026 (Tentatively)

HVF Avadi Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026-27

HVF Avadi Apprenticeship eligibility criteria include educational qualification, domicile, year of passing, age as per Apprenticeship Rules, reservation norms and physical standards as prescribed in Apprenticeship Rule 1992.

Educational Qualification

  • Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Engineering / Technology): Full-time Degree in Engineering or Technology in relevant discipline granted by a Statutory University, Institution empowered by an Act of Parliament, or Graduate examination of professional bodies recognized as equivalent by State/Central Government.
  • Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Full-time Diploma in Engineering or Technology in relevant discipline granted by State Technical Education Board, University, or Institution recognized by State/Central Government.
  • Category III – Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices: Full-time Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Humanities such as BA/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA/BBM/BCA etc. from Statutory/Deemed University in relevant discipline (UGC approved).

Not Eligible: Candidates with Distance Education / Correspondence degrees, Open University degrees or Post Graduates (PG) are not eligible for Apprenticeship.

Year of Passing & Domicile

  • Candidates must be Graduate/Diploma holders who passed in 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025.
  • Candidates must hail from Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana or Puducherry.

Age Limit

Age limit will be followed as per Apprenticeship Rules.

Reservation of Vacancies

  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD will be as per Apprentices Act guidelines.
  • Candidates claiming SC/ST/OBC/PwD reservation must produce valid certificates in Government-prescribed format; otherwise their claim will be treated as General category.
  • BC/MBC candidates claiming OBC (Non-creamy layer) must produce OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format from competent authority.

Physical Standards

Minimum physical standards shall be as prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rule 1992 and subsequent amendments.

Previous Training / Experience

Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing Apprenticeship under Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973, and/or having one year or more experience are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply.

HVF Avadi Apprentice Selection Process 2026-27

The selection process for HVF Avadi Apprenticeship 2026-27 is based on merit of qualifying examination and certificate verification.

  • Shortlisting: Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will prepare the shortlist from online application data based on percentage of marks obtained in the basic prescribed qualification for the respective disciplines.
  • Intimation: Shortlisted candidates will be informed through their registered email ID.
  • Certificate Verification: Shortlisted candidates must appear for Certificate Verification at Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi, Chennai on the scheduled dates.

HVF Avadi Apprentice Stipend & Training Duration 2026-27

All Apprentices engaged under HVF Avadi Apprenticeship 2026-27 will undergo one-year training with monthly stipend as per Apprenticeship norms.

  • Graduate Apprentices (Engineering / Technology): ₹18,000/- per month.
  • Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices (BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BBM/BCA etc.): ₹18,000/- per month.
  • Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: ₹16,200/- per month.
  • Training Period: One year for all categories as per Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973.

Upon completion of Apprenticeship, Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi, Chennai has no obligation to offer employment, and apprentices cannot claim right of employment on the basis of completion of training.

How to Apply for HVF Avadi Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

Eligible candidates must register and apply online through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal for Heavy Vehicles Factory Avadi (User ID: STNTLC000004) by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and click on “Student”.
  2. For first-time users, click “Student Register”, complete the registration form and obtain a 12-digit Enrollment Number.
  3. For existing NATS users, log in using registered email ID and password (or use “Forgot Password” to reset if migrated from old portal). Complete the application form if not already done.
  4. After enrollment, log in with email ID and password and click on “Apply against advertised vacancies”.
  5. Search for “HEAVY VEHICLES FACTORY” and click “Apply”. The status will change to “applied”.
  6. Upload Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet of BE/B.Tech/Diploma/BA/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA/BCA etc. and ensure that percentage of marks is correctly entered in the “% of marks / CGPA x 10” column; applications without percentage will not be considered.

Important Instructions

  • Only eligible candidates should apply and carefully read all provisions and requirements in the notification before submitting online application via NATS portal for HVF Avadi.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending certificate verification, and no boarding/lodging expenses are admissible for candidates.
  • Incomplete, erroneous or late online applications received after due date will be rejected, and no further communication will be entertained in this regard.
  • Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) has not authorised any individual/organisation to coordinate or liaison on its behalf; candidates are advised to beware of touts and note that the Board is not responsible for such incidents.
  • Canvassing or pressuring through any source will disqualify the candidature and the candidate’s name will be removed from official records without prior intimation.
  • For any clarification, candidates may contact through email at [email protected] as given in the notification.

The Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test (TNTET) is a state-level examination that assesses the eligibility of candidates to teach in primary and upper primary schools. The 2026 edition is special as it focuses exclusively on working teachers, providing them an opportunity to clear the test amid government directives making TET mandatory for promotions and continued service. This is particularly relevant following recent G.O.s and court rulings emphasizing TET qualification for in-service educators. Working teachers in government, aided, and recognized private schools should read this article to understand application details, preparation strategies, and benefits.

Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 – Complete Guide

The Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 is designed to certify the eligibility of in-service teachers for teaching positions in Classes 1 to 8. Conducted by the Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB) under the Government of Tamil Nadu, it targets working teachers appointed before a specified cutoff date. The exam is held in offline mode using OMR sheets, with two separate papers: Paper 1 for Classes 1–5 and Paper 2 for Classes 6–8.

What is Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026?

TET is a state-level eligibility test for teachers of Classes 1–8 in government and aided schools, ensuring they meet national standards for teaching aptitude and subject knowledge. The 2026 version includes a special focus on working teachers who have not yet cleared TET, aligning with government and Supreme Court directives to make it mandatory for all educators. Clearing TET is now essential for job security and career advancement in Tamil Nadu.

  • Conducting body: Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB), Government of Tamil Nadu
  • Level: State-level eligibility test
  • Applicable classes: Paper 1 – Classes 1–5, Paper 2 – Classes 6–8

Special TET 2026 for Working Teachers – Key Highlights

This special TET targets working teachers, offering a dedicated chance to qualify without competing with fresh candidates. It differs by restricting eligibility to in-service educators, emphasizing their need for TET clearance for promotions and regularization. The test follows the standard TNTET pattern and syllabus.

Aspect Details
Exam name Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test (Special TET) 2026 for Working Teachers
Conducting body Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB), Tamil Nadu
Eligible group In-service teachers of Classes 1–8 who have not yet cleared TET
Papers Paper 1 (Classes 1–5), Paper 2 (Classes 6–8)
Mode Offline OMR-based, MCQs

TN TET 2026 Notification for Working Teachers – Important Dates

The notification was released on 13-02-2026, inviting applications from eligible working teachers.

Event Date
Notification release date 13-02-2026

Last date to apply 10-04-2026
Edit Option 11-04-2026 to 13-04-2026
Exam date for TNTET Paper I 04-07-2026 FN (Tentative)
Exam date for TNTET Paper II 05-07-2026 FN (Tentative)
Admit card download To be uploaded on TRB website; candidates advised to check regularly

Eligibility Criteria for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Eligibility is limited to working teachers appointed on or before 01.09.2025 as Secondary Grade Teachers (SGT), BT Assistants, or equivalent cadres on time scale, consolidated, or part-time pay in specified departments and schools.

Educational Qualification for Paper 1 (Classes 1–5)

Candidates must possess the qualifications as per G.O.(Ms).No.13, School Education [SE3(1)] Department, dated 30.01.2020, including 10+2/HSC plus Diploma in Teacher Education/Diploma in Elementary Education or equivalent. This applies to Secondary Grade Teachers, BRTEs, and Special Education Teachers (IEDSS). In-service teachers in aided or unaided schools are also eligible if they meet NCTE norms.

Educational Qualification for Paper 2 (Classes 6–8)

Graduation in the relevant subject plus B.Ed. or equivalent, as per special rules for Tamil Nadu School Educational Subordinate Services. For Special Education Teachers, qualifications from G.O.(Ms).No.144, dated 17.06.2025 apply. Subject-specific requirements include relevant graduation for Mathematics/Science or Social Science teachers.

Age Limit and In-Service Relaxations

There is no upper age limit specified for TET eligibility. Relaxations in qualifying marks apply: 50% for BC/BCM/MBC/DNC/PWD and 40% for SC/SCA/ST.

Who Can Apply as a Working Teacher?

In-service teachers in government, government-aided, and recognized unaided private schools teaching Classes 1 to 8, including those under various departments like School Education, MBC, ADW, Tribal Welfare, and corporations. Qualified serving teachers opting for promotion must also apply.

TN TET 2026 Exam Pattern for Working Teachers

The exam pattern is identical for working and non-working candidates: 150 MCQs, 3 hours duration, no negative marking.

Tamil Nadu TET 2026 Exam Pattern – Paper 1

Paper 1 is for primary level (Classes 1–5).

Section Questions Marks Medium
Child Development and Pedagogy (6–11 yrs) 30 30 Tamil/English
Language I (Tamil/Telugu/Malayalam/Kannada/Urdu) 30 30 As chosen
Language II – English 30 30 English
Mathematics 30 30 Tamil/English
Environmental Studies 30 30 Tamil/English
Total 150 150 –

Tamil Nadu TET 2026 Exam Pattern – Paper 2

Paper 2 is for upper primary level (Classes 6–8).

Section Questions Marks Medium
Child Development and Pedagogy (11–14 yrs) 30 30 Tamil/English
Language I (Tamil/Telugu/Malayalam/Kannada/Urdu) 30 30 As chosen
Language II – English 30 30 English
Mathematics and Science / Social Science / Any other subject 60 60 Tamil/English
Total 150 150 –

Minimum Qualifying Marks for Working Teachers

General category: 60% (90/150). BC/BCM/MBC/DNC and PWD: 50% (75/150). SC/SCA/ST: 40% (60/150).

Tamil Nadu TET 2026 Syllabus for Working Teachers

The syllabus is based on the state-prescribed topics for Classes 1–8, with difficulty up to secondary/higher secondary stage.

TNTET 2026 Paper 1 Syllabus (Classes 1–5)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy: Stages of child development, learning theories, inclusive education, teaching–learning process, assessment and evaluation.
  • Language I (regional language): Reading comprehension, grammar, language skills, pedagogy of language development.
  • Language II – English: Comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, communication, English language pedagogy.
  • Mathematics: Number system, operations, fractions, decimals, geometry, measurement, data handling, pedagogy of mathematics.
  • Environmental Studies: Family and friends, food, water, travel, shelter, environment, resources, EVS pedagogy.

TNTET 2026 Paper 2 Syllabus (Classes 6–8)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy (11–14): Adolescent development, learning and motivation, classroom management, evaluation.
  • Language I and II: Similar components as Paper 1 but at higher difficulty level.
  • Subject-specific: Mathematics & Science – algebra, geometry, mensuration, statistics, basics of physics, chemistry, biology, pedagogy. Social Science – history, geography, civics, economics, social science pedagogy.

Note that the official TRB syllabus PDF must be followed strictly.

Application Process for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Applications are online only via http://www.trb.tn.gov.in. Separate applications for Paper 1 and Paper 2 with fees.

  • Register with valid email and mobile number.
  • Fill details, upload photo (40-60 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), signature (20-40 KB), and certificates (250-300 KB PDF).
  • Pay fee: Rs.600/- (general) or Rs.300/- (SC/SCA/ST/PWD) via net banking/credit/debit card.
  • Use edit window if needed; submit by 10-04-2026.

Documents required:

  • 10th/SSLC, 12th/HSC, Diploma/B.Ed./UG certificates and mark sheets.
  • Community certificate, Differently Abled certificate.
  • Service Certificate (Annexure-I).

Exam Centres, Hall Ticket and Exam Day Guidelines

Exams in all districts; centre details in hall ticket. Download hall ticket from TRB website. Report early with ID proof; no electronic gadgets allowed. OMR-based; follow invigilator instructions.

TN TET 2026 Result, Certificate Validity and Use for Promotions

Results published on http://www.trb.tn.gov.in as qualified lists. Qualifying candidates receive TNTET certificates. Validity is lifetime as per norms. For working teachers, TET clearance is mandatory for promotions in Tamil Nadu government schools; it's an eligibility criterion for career progression.

Benefits of Clearing Tamil Nadu TET 2026 for Working Teachers

  • Eligibility for regularization and promotions in government and aided schools.
  • Compliance with Supreme Court directions making TET mandatory for Classes 1–8 teachers.
  • Better job security and mobility, eligibility for future recruitment drives.
  • Professional recognition and alignment with national teacher quality standards.

Preparation Strategy for Working Teachers – How to Crack TN TET 2026

Balance school duties with study by focusing on pedagogy sections. Use NCERT/Tamil Nadu textbooks for content revision.

  • Create a weekly timetable around school hours.
  • Revise core concepts from textbook levels you teach daily.
  • Use weekends for full-length mock tests.
  • Focus on weak sections identified from previous attempts.

NLC Industrial Trainee Finance Eligibility Criteria 2026

To be eligible for the NLC India Limited Industrial Trainee (Finance) positions in 2026, candidates must meet specific requirements related to educational qualifications, age limits, and other conditions as outlined in the official notification. This 12-month training program is open to CA and CMA intermediates, with no restrictions based on the year of passing the intermediate exam. Below is a detailed breakdown of the eligibility criteria for NLC Industrial Trainee Finance Recruitment 2026.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have:

  •     Passed the Intermediate Examination of Chartered Accountant (CA), conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), OR
  •     Passed the Intermediate Examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA), conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI).

Additional Notes:

  •     The notification is open to all eligible candidates, regardless of the year in which they passed the CA/CMA intermediate examination.
  •     Candidates who have already undergone training under a similar scheme for one year or more are not eligible to apply.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date: 01/03/2026)

The upper age limit varies by category and is calculated as on the crucial date (01/03/2026). Here's a category-wise overview:  

Category Upper Age Limit
UR/EWS 28 years
OBC (NCL) 31 years
SC/ST 33 years

Age Relaxations:

  • Persons with Disabilities (PwD): Additional relaxation of 10 years for general PwD candidates (degree of disability 40% and above). This extends to 13 years for PwD-OBC (NCL) and 15 years for PwD-SC/ST.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Relaxation as per Government of India rules.
  • Maximum Age Cap: In all cases, the upper age limit is capped at 58 years as on the crucial date.
  • Important: No age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying against unreserved (UR) posts.

Candidates must ensure their age aligns with these limits, and relaxations are subject to valid certificates issued by competent authorities.

Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Nationality: Only Indian Nationals are eligible.
  • Registration Requirement: Candidates should have registered their names with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) or the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI).
  • Medical Fitness: Selected candidates must be found medically fit as per NLCIL's prescribed health standards and produce a Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner at the time of document verification.
  • Project Affected Persons (PAPs): Preference will be given to PAPs of NLCIL, everything else being equal.
  • Reservations: Reservations and relaxations for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen are as per Government of India guidelines. Candidates must provide valid certificates (e.g., EWS/OBC-NCL issued in the current financial year) during application.

Failure to meet any of these criteria may lead to rejection of candidature at any stage. For complete details, refer to the official NLC Industrial Trainee Finance Notification 2026 on www.nlcindia.in. Eligible candidates can apply online from 20/03/2026 to 09/04/2026.

The selection process for NLC Industrial Trainee Finance Recruitment 2026 is merit-based and straightforward. Candidates will be shortlisted solely on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained in the Intermediate Examination of CA/CMA. No interviews or other tests are involved.

MFL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Candidates will be screened based on relevant experience; selection based on Virtual and/or Personal Interview(s) to be held at Chennai.

How to Apply for MFL Recruitment 2026

Upload self-attested scanned copies of: Caste/Community certificate, Disability/PwBD certificate, EWS Income & Asset Certificate (as applicable), educational qualification documents, experience certificates, emoluments proof, passport-size photograph (plain background, both ears visible) and signature.

  • OBC(NCL) certificate must have been issued on or after 01.04.2025 by Competent Authority.
  • EWS certificate must be valid for FY 2025–26, prepared on basis of income/assets for FY 2024–25.
  • PwBD candidates must have permanent disability of minimum 40% and must produce Unique Disability ID (UDID) card.
  • All documents (originals) related to Qualification, Age, Caste/PwBD/EWS/ESM certificates must be produced at the time of interview/document verification.
  • Employees who left MFL through early retirement, VRS, or were terminated/dismissed are NOT eligible to apply.
  • MFL employees who resigned after minimum 5 years with good performance (8+ rating) are eligible to apply.
  • Canvassing directly or indirectly will disqualify candidature.
  • All selected candidates will be on probation for 6 months from the date of joining.
  • Any dispute will be settled in Courts within jurisdiction of Chennai only.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL), a Govt. of India (DAE) enterprise, Miniratna Category‑I

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy 2026 Details

A total of 27 vacancies will be filled for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan posts under the ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026) on fixed tenure contract basis across North, West and South Zones. Check ECIL post wise contract vacancy details in the table below.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates (walk‑in schedule)

ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 Events Important Dates & Details
Date of ECIL Advt. 07/2026 notification 26 March 2026 
Walk‑in date – Mumbai (West Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, #1207, Veer Savarkar Marg, Dadar (Prabhadevi), Mumbai – 400028 
Walk‑in date – New Delhi (North Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, D‑15, DDA Local Shopping Complex, A‑Block, Ring Road, Naraina, New Delhi – 110028

Cut‑off date for age & post‑qualification experience Date of selection (respective walk‑in date) 

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, ECE, ETC, EEE, E&I, CSE, IT, CSIT, Mechanical/Electrical with NDT Level‑II (for Kudankulam) along with a minimum of 3 years post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship in the relevant field up to 1 year is also counted as experience.
  • Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/ETC/EEE/E&I/CSE/IT and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship up to 1 year is countable towards experience.
  • Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C): Diploma with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in ECE/ETC/Electronics/EEE/Instrumentation and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience including relevant apprenticeship.
  • Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C): ITI passed in Electronics, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Instrumentation or Radio & TV trades with minimum 2 years post‑qualification experience (including up to 1 year apprenticeship) in maintenance/repair of electronics, instrumentation systems, communication gadgets or computers.
  • Age Limit (UR): Project Engineer – maximum 33 years; Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan – maximum 30 years. Age relaxation is 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, an additional 10 years for PwBD (40% and above) over category relaxation, and 5 years for candidates domiciled in J&K from 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 will receive consolidated monthly emoluments based on the post and contract year, along with limited benefits as per ECIL rules.
  • Consolidated Emoluments: Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there is no mention of any application or examination fee in the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

There is no online application process for ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026); candidates have to attend walk‑in selections as per the notified schedule. Eligible applicants must visit the official ECIL website ecil.co.in, download the prescribed ECIL contract application form 2026, fill it carefully and report at the concerned zonal walk‑in venue on the respective date within the registration time slot.

Candidates must carry the duly filled ECIL application form, updated resume, original certificates and one set of self‑attested photocopies for age, qualification, experience, category, disability, ex‑servicemen and identity proof along with recent passport size photographs. Registration and document verification will be done at the venue before the personal interview under ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026.

Click to Download ECIL Contract Application Form 2026

Download ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 07/2026)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 selection for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan will be based on walk‑in registration, document verification and personal interview with a weighted merit system.
  • Shortlisting & Evaluation: After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks.
  • Final Merit & Offer: Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.

How to Apply / Attend ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 07/2026) must appear personally at the designated zonal venues on the scheduled walk‑in dates with the prescribed application form and documents.

  • Step 1 – Download ECIL Application Form: Visit the official ECIL website www.ecil.co.in, open the Careers/Recruitment section and download the application form for Advt. No. 07/2026. Take a printout and fill it neatly with all required details including post category, zone and location preference.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Documents: Keep ready original and one set of self‑attested copies of 10th certificate (DOB proof), all qualification certificates and marksheets, CGPA‑to‑percentage conversion (if applicable), complete experience certificates with from‑to dates and post held, appointment order and recent payslips (if currently employed), caste (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) certificate, non‑creamy layer OBC certificate (not older than one year), PwBD certificate, Ex‑servicemen/ J&K domicile proof and valid government ID (Aadhaar/Passport etc.).
  • Step 3 – Reach Walk‑in Venue in Time: Report to the respective ECIL Zonal Office (Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru on 09 April 2026; Chennai on 18 April 2026) within the registration time 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs. Late reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Step 4 – Registration & Document Verification: Submit the filled ECIL application form 2026, resume and document set at the registration desk. After successful verification, candidates will be allowed to attend the personal interview as part of the selection process.
  • Step 5 – Attend Interview & Wait for Result: Appear for the interview as scheduled at the venue. Final selection will be based on the combined weightage of qualification, experience and interview performance. Shortlisted candidates will receive joining instructions from ECIL and must be prepared for posting at project locations anywhere in India.

  • Additional Assistant Director: The post is to be filled on deputation basis. The eligibility criteria including educational qualification, experience, and other conditions are detailed in Annexure-C, available on the CBIC website (www.cbic.gov.in) and DGPM website (https://dgpm.gov.in).

The selection process varies by post code:

  • Post Codes 12602, 12605, 12606 – Three Stage Process:
    • Stage 1 – Preliminary Test (1 hour, OMR-based): 50 MCQs – Mathematics (20), Science (20), General Awareness (10). +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 40% (General), 30% (Reserved categories).
    • Stage 2 – Advanced Test (2 hours): 50 MCQs from relevant discipline. +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 30% (General), 20% (Reserved). Merit list prepared based on Stage 2 marks only. Both stages conducted in a single session as Section A & B.
    • Stage 3 – Skill Test (Go/No-Go basis): Up to 5 times the number of vacancies shortlisted from Stage 2. Candidates clearing Skill Test empanelled in order of Stage 2 merit.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).

  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.

  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Candidates applying for the above posts must fulfill the required qualification and experience criteria as mentioned in the official notification.

Senior Security Supervisor

  • Candidate should be a retired commissioned officer from Defense or Paramilitary Forces.
  • Should have served at least as a Captain in the Army or equivalent rank in Navy, Air Force, BSF, CISF, CRPF, or other paramilitary forces.
  • Must possess a Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized university or a Graduation Certificate from Defense/Paramilitary Forces.
  • Should have a minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience in a reputed academic institution or organization.

Security Supervisor

  • Candidate should be a retired individual from Defense or Paramilitary Forces.
  • Should have served at least as a Subedar in the Army or equivalent post in Navy, Air Force, BSF, CISF, CRPF, or other paramilitary forces.
  • Must possess a Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized university or a Graduation Certificate from Defense/Paramilitary Forces.
  • Should have a minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience in a reputed academic institution or organization.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of modern CCTV surveillance systems.
  • Minimum 3 years of work experience in a reputed academic institution, with at least 3 years at the level of Security Supervisor.
  • Must meet the Shape-I medical standard as per Defense or Central Paramilitary Force norms.
  • Must be proficient in Hindi and English.

Age Limit

The age limit for both posts is mentioned below:

  • Maximum Age: Below 58 years
  • Age, qualification, and experience will be considered as on 31 March 2026.

Salary

Selected candidates will receive a fixed consolidated monthly remuneration along with transportation allowance.

Senior Security Supervisor Rs. 65,000/- per month + Transportation Allowance of Rs. 4,000/- per month
Security Supervisor Rs. 40,000/- per month + Transportation Allowance of Rs. 4,000/- per month

Job Profile

Senior Security Supervisor

  • Will oversee all security arrangements for the MNIT Jaipur campus.
  • Will supervise the deployment of watch and ward staff.
  • Will coordinate with administrative authorities for event security arrangements.
  • Will liaise with local police stations to address security requirements.
  • Will perform any other related work assigned by the authorities from time to time.

Security Supervisor

  • Will be responsible for security arrangements during the assigned shift at the MNIT Jaipur campus.
  • Will supervise deployment of watch and ward staff.
  • Will coordinate with the Senior Security Supervisor and other administrative authorities for campus security arrangements.
  • Will handle any other related assignments as directed by the authorities.

Selection Process

The selection of candidates will be based on the following stages:

  • Screening of applications
  • Interview
  • The institute may also conduct a selection test apart from the interview depending on the number of applicants and requirement.

Written Examination (Objective Type MCQ)

  • Two parts: Part-A (Punjabi Language – Qualifying only, minimum 50% marks required)
  • Part-B (Main paper – Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in Part-B only)
  • Negative marking of ¼ mark for every wrong answer.

Merit List

  • Prepared only on the basis of Part-B marks.
  • In case of tie: Date of Birth (older candidate preferred) → Higher percentage in educational qualification → Matriculation marks.

Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

  • Only candidates who qualify the written exam will be called for PMT & PET (in order of merit and category-wise vacancies).

Document Verification / Counseling

  • Original documents and certificates will be verified.
  • Final selection is subject to verification and medical fitness.

Important: Qualifying PMT/PET does not guarantee appointment. Final appointment depends on document verification and merit.

  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in written exam, PMT, PET or counseling.
  • All updates (exam date, admit card, result, merit list) will be uploaded only on the official website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in. Candidates must keep checking the website regularly.
  • No individual letters will be sent.
  • Any false information or incomplete application will lead to rejection at any stage.

Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

  • Any dispute will be subject to the Courts having jurisdiction in Hyderabad only.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

(Engineering) in the relevant discipline.

  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 25 years for Jr. Technician posts, 28 years for B-3/B-4 level posts, and 30 years for Supervisor posts, as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10–15 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on regular posts with pay scales as per the company's pay structure along with applicable allowances.

Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).
  • SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee but are required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹200/- towards service expenses.
  • Payment can be made online through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The online application process for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 will start from 28th March 2026 and the last date to submit the IGM online application form is 27th April 2026. Candidates must visit the official website igmnoida.spmcil.com, open the career page and complete their IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form within the given dates.

While filling the India Government Mint application form 2026, candidates should register with a valid email ID and mobile number, enter personal and educational details, upload scanned documents, pay the examination fee (if applicable) and finally submit and download the IGM online form for future reference.

Click to Apply for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026

How to Apply for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for the India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 must submit their application forms through the online mode only within the specified dates. Follow the step-by-step process given below to fill the IGM online application form correctly.

  • Eligible candidates for IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the company's official website within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to http://igmnoida.spmcil.com, click on "Discover SPMCIL" and navigate to the CAREERS page to find the IGM Recruitment 2026 link.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create login credentials, and proceed to the IGM online application form 2026.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form: Enter personal details, address, educational qualifications, category, unit preference (Mumbai/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Noida), and post applied for carefully, ensuring all data matches your original certificates.

ESIC SSH Sanathnagar Faculty Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Candidates applying for ESIC Super Specialty Hospital Sanathnagar Faculty Recruitment 2026 must fulfil all eligibility conditions of age, qualification and experience as per NMC norms on the date of walk‑in‑interview.
  • Age Limit: The upper age limit for all faculty posts (Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor) at ESIC SSH Sanathnagar is 69 years, and no person shall serve as faculty beyond the age of 70 years. Age will be reckoned on the date of the respective walk‑in‑interview.
  • Educational Qualification & Experience: Faculty eligibility must be as per Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations 2025 (NMC Gazette Notification dated 30.06.2025), including required MD/MS/DM/M.Ch/DNB qualifications and prescribed teaching/clinical experience for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor in the concerned super speciality.
  • DNB Equivalence: DNB (Broad Specialties) and DNB (Super Specialties) granted in institutions/hospitals with 500 or more beds are treated as equivalent to corresponding MD/MS and DM/M.Ch for teaching purposes; in other cases, one additional year of senior residency in a medical college is required for equivalence.
  • Flexibility Across Posts: Candidates eligible for a higher post (Professor/Associate Professor) may be considered against lower posts (Associate Professor/Assistant Professor) and vice versa, with temporary up‑gradation or down‑gradation of the post as per ESIC guidelines and recommendations of the selection board.

ESIC SSH Sanathnagar Faculty Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ESIC Super Specialty Hospital Sanathnagar Faculty Recruitment 2026 will be paid consolidated remuneration as per ESIC’s latest contractual faculty pay structure.
  • Professor Salary: Consolidated remuneration for Professor is fixed at Rs. 2,56,671/- per month, inclusive of NPA, Dearness Allowance (DA) and House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per applicable rates.
  • Associate Professor Salary: Consolidated remuneration for Associate Professor is Rs. 1,70,681/- per month, including applicable NPA, DA and HRA components.
  • Assistant Professor Salary: Consolidated remuneration for Assistant Professor is Rs. 1,46,638/- per month, inclusive of NPA, DA and HRA as per ESIC norms.
  • Allowances & Revisions: Faculty will also be entitled to Transport Allowance with DA on Transport Allowance as per rules, and the consolidated remuneration will be revised whenever DA rates are revised for Central Government employees. For non‑medical faculty, the same base rates apply but without the NPA component.
